en: to give a document for approval
toeic: Please submit your report by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在星期五前提交報告。

en: the final date to complete something
toeic: We must meet the deadline for this project.
toeic_zh: 我們必須趕上這個項目的截止日期。

en: a person who works with you
simple: My colleague helps me with the project.
toeic: I discussed the proposal with my colleagues.
toeic_zh: 我與同事討論了該提案。

en: a person who directs and controls workers
simple_zh: 我的主管批准了我的請求。
toeic: You should report this issue to your supervisor.
toeic_zh: 你應該向主管報告這個問題。

en: to give a task or responsibility
simple: The manager assigns tasks to the team.
simple_zh: 經理將任務分配給團隊。
toeic: I was assigned to work on the sales report.
toeic_zh: 我被分配了銷售報告的工作。

en: to fasten or include with something
simple: I attach the file to the email.
simple_zh: 我將文件附加到郵件中。
toeic: Please attach the invoice with your proposal.
toeic_zh: 請將發票附加到您的提案中。

en: a list of items to be discussed at a meeting
toeic: Please send me the meeting agenda in advance.
toeic_zh: 請提前向我發送會議議程。

en: to delay something to a later time
simple: We postpone the meeting to next week.
simple_zh: 我們將會議延期到下週。
toeic: The company postponed the launch due to technical issues.
toeic_zh: 由於技術問題，公司延期了發布。

en: able to be used; not busy
toeic: Is the manager available for a meeting this afternoon?
toeic_zh: 經理今天下午有時間開會嗎？

en: to verify that something is correct or true
toeic: Please confirm receipt of this email.
toeic_zh: 請確認已收到此電郵。

en: materials or equipment needed for work
simple: We order office supplies every month.
simple_zh: 我們每月訂購辦公用品。
toeic: The department needs more office supplies.
toeic_zh: 該部門需要更多辦公用品。

en: to repay money spent by someone else
toeic: I will reimburse you for the office supplies you purchased.
toeic_zh: 我會報銷你購買的辦公用品費用。

en: people employed in an organization
simple_zh: 人力資源部門處理招聘。
toeic: All personnel must attend the safety training.
toeic_zh: 所有人員必須參加安全培訓。

en: a section of an organization
simple: She works in the marketing department.
toeic: The finance department must approve all major expenses.
toeic_zh: 財務部門必須批准所有主要支出。

en: a short message about business matters
simple: I send a memo to the team.
toeic: The manager distributed a memo regarding the new policy.
toeic_zh: 經理分發了關於新政策的備忘錄。

en: an official rule or principle of an organization
simple: Our policy requires approval for all expenses.
simple_zh: 我們的政策要求所有支出都經批准。
toeic: Company policy prohibits using company equipment for personal use.
toeic_zh: 公司政策禁止將公司設備用於個人用途。

en: to formally agree that something is good or acceptable
toeic: The proposal was approved by senior management.
toeic_zh: 該提案已獲得高級管理層批准。

en: to inform someone of something
simple: I notify my team about the changes.
simple_zh: 我通知我的團隊有關更改。
toeic: Please notify your supervisor if you cannot attend the meeting.
toeic_zh: 如果您無法參加會議，請通知主管。

en: working in a quick and organized manner
toeic: An efficient workflow helps meet deadlines.
toeic_zh: 高效的工作流程有助於按時完成。

en: to arrange things in a methodical manner
simple: I organize the files by date.
toeic: Please organize the documents before the audit.
toeic_zh: 請在審計前整理文件。

en: lasting for a limited time only
toeic: We hired temporary staff for the peak season.
toeic_zh: 我們為旺季雇用了臨時員工。

en: a building or structure for a particular purpose
simple: Our facility is modern and efficient.
simple_zh: 我們的設施現代且高效。
toeic: The company invested in new facilities to improve production.
toeic_zh: 公司投資了新設施以提高產能。

en: tools or machines needed for work
simple_zh: 我們需要新的辦公設備。
toeic: All equipment must be properly maintained.
toeic_zh: 所有設備必須得到適當維護。

en: something that helps you remember something
simple: I send a reminder about the meeting.
toeic: The system sends you a reminder before the deadline.
toeic_zh: 系統在截止日期前向你發送提醒。

en: quick; done without delay
toeic: Your prompt attention to this matter is appreciated.
toeic_zh: 感謝你對此事的迅速關注。

en: a gathering of people to discuss something
simple: We have a meeting at 2 PM.
toeic: The client meeting was rescheduled to next Tuesday.
toeic_zh: 客戶會議被重新安排到下週二。

en: a large formal meeting or assembly
simple: The annual conference attracts many speakers.
simple_zh: 年度會議吸引了許多演講者。
toeic: I attended the international business conference last month.
toeic_zh: 我上個月參加了國際商業會議。

en: a speech or demonstration of something
simple: I prepare a presentation for the team.
toeic: Your presentation should include key findings and recommendations.
toeic_zh: 你的演示應包括關鍵發現和建議。

en: to be present at an event
simple: I attend the meeting every Monday.
toeic: You are required to attend the mandatory training session.
toeic_zh: 你需要參加強制性培訓課程。

en: a plan showing when something will happen
simple: The schedule is on the bulletin board.
toeic: Please check the project schedule before scheduling your meeting.
toeic_zh: 在安排會議前，請檢查項目時間表。

en: a person who takes part in something
simple_zh: 所有參與者都收到了證書。
toeic: Participants should bring relevant documents to the meeting.
toeic_zh: 參與者應將相關文件帶到會議中。

en: a place where an event is held
simple: The venue is near the train station.
toeic: We need to confirm the venue for the upcoming conference.
toeic_zh: 我們需要確認即將舉行的會議的地點。

en: a written record of what was discussed at a meeting
simple: I take minutes at the meeting.
toeic: The meeting minutes should be distributed to all participants.
toeic_zh: 會議紀錄應發送給所有參與者。

en: a group of people who discuss or decide something
simple: The panel consists of five experts.
toeic: The expert panel will address questions from the audience.
toeic_zh: 專家小組將回答觀眾的問題。

en: conversation about a topic
toeic: During the discussion, several important issues were raised.
toeic_zh: 在討論過程中，提出了幾個重要問題。

en: to make something known publicly
simple: The manager announces the new policy.
toeic: The company announced record profits for the quarter.
toeic_zh: 公司宣布了本季度創紀錄的利潤。

en: the subject of discussion or writing
simple: The topic of the meeting is budget planning.
simple_zh: 會議的主題是預算規劃。
toeic: Can we discuss another topic related to market expansion?
toeic_zh: 我們可以討論與市場擴展相關的另一個主題嗎？

en: to make something easier or help it happen
simple: I facilitate the discussion among team members.
simple_zh: 我促進團隊成員之間的討論。
toeic: The coordinator will facilitate the workshop sessions.
toeic_zh: 協調員將主持研討會課程。

en: to take part in something
toeic: I participated in the brainstorming session yesterday.
toeic_zh: 我昨天參加了腦力激蕩會。

en: one subject to be discussed at a meeting
simple: The first agenda item is financial review.
simple_zh: 第一個議程項目是財務審查。
toeic: Please add this to the agenda for the next meeting.
toeic_zh: 請將此添加到下次會議的議程中。

en: to lead a meeting or discussion
simple: The director chairs the monthly meeting.
toeic: Ms. Smith will chair the committee meeting this quarter.
toeic_zh: 史密斯女士將主持本季度的委員會會議。

en: to end or stop a meeting temporarily or permanently
simple: We adjourn the meeting until next week.
toeic: The chairman adjourned the session after two hours.
toeic_zh: 主席在兩小時後宣布休會。

en: a piece of work to be done
simple: Each team member has a task.
simple_zh: 每個團隊成員都有一個任務。
toeic: Your task is to complete the report by Thursday.
toeic_zh: 你的任務是在週四前完成報告。

en: a large piece of work with a specific goal
simple: Our new project starts next month.
simple_zh: 我們的新項目下個月開始。
toeic: The project requires coordination between multiple departments.
toeic_zh: 該項目需要多個部門之間的協調。

en: an important event or achievement in a project
simple: We reached a major milestone today.
simple_zh: 我們今天達到了一個主要里程碑。
toeic: Meeting this milestone will keep us on schedule.
toeic_zh: 達到這個里程碑將使我們按時進行。

en: a detailed account of something
toeic: The financial report shows significant growth this year.
toeic_zh: 財務報告顯示今年增長顯著。

en: a written piece of information
toeic: Please save all documents in the shared folder.
toeic_zh: 請將所有文檔保存在共享文件夾中。

en: a document or collection of documents
simple: I organize my files by project.
toeic: Please file this report in the appropriate folder.
toeic_zh: 請將此報告歸檔在適當的文件夾中。

en: a document with blank spaces to fill in information
simple: Please fill out this form completely.
toeic: All employees must complete the expense report form.
toeic_zh: 所有員工必須填寫費用報告表。

en: a standard pattern to be copied
simple: We use a standard template for reports.
simple_zh: 我們使用標準範本進行報告。
toeic: Use this template as a guide for creating your proposal.
toeic_zh: 使用此範本作為創建提案的指南。

en: to store documents for long-term keeping
simple: We archive old files in the basement.
simple_zh: 我們將舊文件存檔在地下室。
toeic: Please archive this year's documents before the fiscal year ends.
toeic_zh: 請在財政年度結束前存檔今年的文檔。

en: a first version of a document
simple: I review the draft of the proposal.
toeic: Please provide a draft for my review before the final submission.
toeic_zh: 在最終提交前，請提供草稿供我審查。

en: a person's name written in their own handwriting
simple: I need your signature on this document.
simple_zh: 我需要你在這份文檔上簽名。
toeic: The contract requires authorized signature and approval.
toeic_zh: 合同需要授權簽名和批准。

en: confirmation that something is true or correct
toeic: The system requires verification of your identity before proceeding.
toeic_zh: 系統要求在繼續前驗證您的身份。

en: a duplicate or reproduction of something
simple: I make a copy of the report.
toeic: Please provide a copy of the original document for our records.
toeic_zh: 請為我們的記錄提供原始文檔的副本。

en: the way in which something is arranged or organized
simple: The format of the document is important.
toeic: Please ensure all documents follow the standard format.
toeic_zh: 請確保所有文檔都遵循標準格式。

en: a brief statement of the main points
simple: I write a summary of the meeting.
toeic: The executive summary should highlight key findings and recommendations.
toeic_zh: 執行摘要應突出關鍵發現和建議。

en: the information contained in something
simple: The content of the email is important.
toeic: Make sure the content of your proposal is clear and concise.
toeic_zh: 確保你的提案的內容清晰簡潔。

en: a source of information or a mention of something
simple: Please include all references in your paper.
simple_zh: 請在論文中包含所有參考資料。
toeic: For reference, please see the attached guidelines.
toeic_zh: 供參考，請查看附加的指南。

en: a list of all topics in a document with page numbers
simple: The table of contents shows all chapters.
toeic: Refer to the table of contents to find the section you need.
toeic_zh: 參考目錄查找您需要的部分。

en: additional information at the end of a document
simple: The detailed data is in the appendix.
toeic: Additional supporting documents are provided in the appendix.
toeic_zh: 附錄中提供了其他支持文檔。

en: a note at the bottom of a page
toeic: See the footnote for additional clarification.
toeic_zh: 有關其他說明，請查看腳註。

en: a final decision or opinion based on facts
toeic: In conclusion, the project was successful and exceeded expectations.
toeic_zh: 總之，該項目成功並超出了預期。

en: a suggestion about the best thing to do
simple: My recommendation is to hire more staff.
simple_zh: 我的建議是聘請更多員工。
toeic: Based on the analysis, we recommend proceeding with the expansion plan.
toeic_zh: 根據分析，我們建議繼續推進擴展計劃。

en: electronic message sent over the internet
simple: I send an email to my colleague.
toeic: Please send me an email with the updated information.
toeic_zh: 請向我發送包含更新信息的電郵。

en: information sent from one person to another
toeic: Your message will be delivered immediately.
toeic_zh: 你的信息將立即發送。

en: the title of an email message
simple: The subject line should be clear.
toeic: Write a descriptive subject line so the recipient understands the email's purpose.
toeic_zh: 寫一個描述性的主題行，以便收件人了解電郵的目的。

en: to write or create something
toeic: Please compose your response and send it before the meeting.
toeic_zh: 請撰寫你的回覆並在會議前發送。

en: a person who receives something
toeic: Make sure the recipient is correct before sending.
toeic_zh: 發送前確保收件人正確。

en: to send a copy of an email to someone
simple: I cc the manager on this email.
simple_zh: 我將這封電郵抄送給經理。
toeic: Please cc all relevant stakeholders on this message.
toeic_zh: 請將此信息抄送給所有相關利益方。

en: to send a blind copy of email without others knowing
simple: I bcc this person for confidentiality.
simple_zh: 我為了保密密件抄送此人。
toeic: Use bcc when you need to send copies confidentially.
toeic_zh: 需要機密發送副本時，請使用密件抄送。

en: to transmit something to someone
simple: I send the report to the client.
toeic: Please send this document to the accounting department.
toeic_zh: 請將此文檔發送給會計部門。

en: to bring or hand over something to someone
simple: I deliver the package to the office.
simple_zh: 我將包裹交付到辦公室。
toeic: The courier will deliver the documents by tomorrow.
toeic_zh: 快遞員明天將交付文檔。

en: proof that something has been received or is correct
simple: I need a confirmation of receipt.
toeic: Please send a confirmation once you receive this email.
toeic_zh: 收到此電郵後，請發送確認。

en: a document showing that something was received
simple: I keep the receipt for records.
toeic: Please provide a receipt for the office supplies purchased.
toeic_zh: 請提供購買辦公用品的收據。

en: to send a message to someone else
simple: I forward the email to my colleague.
simple_zh: 我將電郵轉發給我的同事。
toeic: Please forward this information to the relevant department.
toeic_zh: 請將此信息轉發給相關部門。

en: to respond to a message
simple: I reply to all emails promptly.
toeic: Please reply to this email with your availability.
toeic_zh: 請回覆此電郵告知你的時間安排。

en: new or recent information
simple: I send a status update to the team.
simple_zh: 我向團隊發送狀態更新。
toeic: Please provide an update on the project's progress.
toeic_zh: 請提供項目進展的更新。

en: an action taken to continue or reinforce something
simple: I send a follow-up email after the meeting.
simple_zh: 會議後我發送後續電郵。
toeic: A follow-up meeting will be scheduled for next week.
toeic_zh: 下週將安排後續會議。

en: exchange of information between people
simple: Good communication is important for teamwork.
simple_zh: 良好的溝通對團隊合作很重要。
toeic: Clear communication helps prevent misunderstandings.
toeic_zh: 清晰的通信有助於防止誤解。

en: a file sent with an email
simple: I add an attachment to the email.
toeic: Please include the necessary attachments with your email.
toeic_zh: 請在電郵中包含必要的附件。

en: unwanted email messages
simple: These emails are spam and should be deleted.
simple_zh: 這些電郵是垃圾郵件，應該刪除。
toeic: Use the spam filter to automatically delete unwanted emails.
toeic_zh: 使用垃圾郵件過濾器自動刪除不需要的電郵。

en: where unsent emails are temporarily saved
simple: My draft folder contains several unsent messages.
simple_zh: 我的草稿文件夾包含幾條未發送的信息。
toeic: Save your work in the draft folder if you need to finish it later.
toeic_zh: 如果需要稍後完成，請在草稿文件夾中保存你的工作。

en: not yet read; seen for the first time
toeic: Mark this email as unread if you need to address it later.
toeic_zh: 如果需要稍後解決，請將此電郵標記為未讀。

en: happening four times a year; every three months
toeic: The quarterly report shows our financial performance.
toeic_zh: 季度報告顯示了我們的財務績效。

en: happening once a month or every month
toeic: Monthly performance reviews help track employee progress.
toeic_zh: 每月績效審查有助於跟踪員工進展。

en: happening once a year
simple: Our annual conference is in June.
simple_zh: 我們的年度會議在六月。
toeic: The annual budget must be approved by the board.
toeic_zh: 年度預算必須由董事會批准。

en: detailed examination of something
toeic: The data analysis reveals important trends.
toeic_zh: 數據分析揭示了重要趨勢。

en: information collected for analysis
simple_zh: 數據顯示了積極的結果。
toeic: We need to collect more data before making a decision.
toeic_zh: 在做決定前，我們需要收集更多數據。

en: a visual representation of data
toeic: Use a chart to visualize the quarterly results.
toeic_zh: 使用圖表可視化季度結果。

en: a general direction or tendency
simple: There is an upward trend in sales.
toeic: The latest market trend shows increased demand for our products.
toeic_zh: 最新市場趨勢顯示對我們產品的需求增加。

en: a result discovered through investigation or research
toeic: Key findings from the survey will be presented tomorrow.
toeic_zh: 調查的主要發現將在明天提出。

en: a numerical fact or data
simple_zh: 統計數據顯示了我們的進展。
toeic: According to statistics, customer satisfaction increased this quarter.
toeic_zh: 根據統計，本季度客戶滿意度有所提高。

en: how well someone or something does
toeic: We will evaluate your performance at the annual review.
toeic_zh: 我們將在年度審查時評估你的績效。

en: a standard measurement or unit
simple_zh: 我們跟踪幾個關鍵指標。
toeic: The marketing team uses specific metrics to measure campaign success.
toeic_zh: 營銷團隊使用特定指標來衡量活動的成功。

en: a deep understanding or realization
simple_zh: 此數據提供了寶貴的洞察。
toeic: Customer insights are essential for product development.
toeic_zh: 客戶洞察對產品開發至關重要。

en: a prediction about future events
simple: We forecast increased sales next quarter.
simple_zh: 我們預測下個季度銷售增加。
toeic: The financial forecast indicates steady growth for the company.
toeic_zh: 財務預測表明公司將穩定增長。

en: the difference between expected and actual results
toeic: Explain the variance between projected and actual revenue.
toeic_zh: 解釋預計收入和實際收入之間的差異。

en: a standard used for comparison or measurement
simple: We set a benchmark for quality.
toeic: Industry benchmarks help us evaluate our competitive position.
toeic_zh: 行業基準幫助我們評估我們的競爭地位。

en: a plan showing how money will be spent
simple: We create a budget for each department.
simple_zh: 我們為每個部門創建預算。
toeic: The project budget was approved by management.
toeic_zh: 項目預算已獲得管理層批准。

en: the price of something or money spent
simple: The cost of the project is high.
toeic: We need to reduce operational costs to improve profitability.
toeic_zh: 我們需要降低運營成本以提高盈利能力。

en: money spent on something
toeic: Please document all business expenses for reimbursement.
toeic_zh: 請記錄所有業務費用以便報銷。

en: money given to pay for something
toeic: We have received the payment for the invoice.
toeic_zh: 我們已收到發票的付款。

en: a document showing goods sold and payment due
simple: I issue an invoice to the client.
toeic: The invoice must include all items and pricing details.
toeic_zh: 發票必須包含所有項目和定價詳情。

en: relating to money or finance
simple: We discuss financial matters at the meeting.
simple_zh: 我們在會議上討論財務事項。
toeic: Strong financial performance is essential for business success.
toeic_zh: 強勁的財務績效對業務成功至關重要。

en: money set aside for a specific purpose
simple: We allocate funds for the project.
toeic: The company established a fund for employee training.
toeic_zh: 公司為員工培訓設立了基金。

en: a thorough examination of accounts or procedures
toeic: An external audit ensures compliance with financial regulations.
toeic_zh: 外部審計確保符合財務法規。

en: money earned after costs are deducted
simple_zh: 我們今年的利潤增加了。
toeic: The company reported record profits for the fiscal year.
toeic_zh: 公司報告了財政年度的創紀錄利潤。

en: income generated from sales or services
toeic: Quarterly revenue increased 15% compared to last year.
toeic_zh: 季度收入比去年增加了15%。

en: process of comparing invoices with records
simple_zh: 發票對帳每月進行一次。
toeic: The accounting team completed invoice reconciliation for Q3.
toeic_zh: 會計團隊完成了第三季度的發票對帳。

en: document authorizing the purchase of goods
simple: I submit a purchase order for supplies.
simple_zh: 我提交了購買用品的採購單。
toeic: All purchases over $500 require a signed purchase order.
toeic_zh: 所有超過500美元的採購都需要簽署的採購單。

en: list of employees and their salaries
simple: The payroll is processed every two weeks.
toeic: The finance department manages payroll and benefits administration.
toeic_zh: 財務部門管理薪資和福利管理。

en: to move money from one place to another
toeic: Please transfer the payment to the vendor account by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在星期五前將付款轉帳到供應商帳戶。

en: to give official permission or approval
toeic: Only authorized personnel can approve expenses over $5000.
toeic_zh: 只有授權人員可以批准超過5000美元的費用。

en: to make sure accounts match
simple: We reconcile the bank account monthly.
simple_zh: 我們每月對帳銀行帳戶。
toeic: The accounting team must reconcile all invoices before month-end.
toeic_zh: 會計團隊必須在月末前對帳所有發票。

en: decrease in value of an asset over time
toeic: Calculate the depreciation for office equipment.
toeic_zh: 計算辦公設備的折舊。

en: official acceptance or permission
simple_zh: 該項目需要主任的批准。
toeic: Final approval from the board is needed before launch.
toeic_zh: 需要董事會的最終批准才能啟動。

en: official permission or power to do something
toeic: Authorization codes are required for all system access.
toeic_zh: 所有系統訪問都需要授權代碼。

en: consent or approval to do something
simple: Do I have permission to leave early?
toeic: You need permission from your manager to work remotely.
toeic_zh: 你需要經理的許可才能遠程工作。

en: an act of asking for something
simple: I submit a request for vacation.
toeic: Your request for equipment has been approved.
toeic_zh: 你的設備請求已被批准。

en: to refuse or say no to a request
toeic: The manager denied the overtime request.
toeic_zh: 經理拒絕了加班請求。

en: to free someone from an obligation
simple: The team is exempt from the new policy.
toeic: Certain employees are exempt from the dress code policy.
toeic_zh: 某些員工不受著裝規範政策約束。

en: to follow rules or requirements
simple: All employees must comply with safety regulations.
simple_zh: 所有員工必須遵守安全規定。
toeic: The department must comply with the new financial reporting standards.
toeic_zh: 部門必須遵守新的財務報告標準。

en: something that is needed or necessary
simple: The requirement is to submit by Friday.
simple_zh: 要求是在星期五前提交。
toeic: All job applicants must meet the minimum requirements.
toeic_zh: 所有工作申請人必須符合最低要求。

en: official rules or restrictions
toeic: The new regulation affects all companies in this industry.
toeic_zh: 新法規影響該行業的所有公司。

en: an official level of quality or achievement
toeic: The industry standard requires annual audits of all financial records.
toeic_zh: 行業標準要求對所有財務記錄進行年度審計。

en: a series of steps to follow
toeic: The onboarding procedure takes approximately two weeks.
toeic_zh: 入職程序大約需要兩週。

en: a series of actions or steps
toeic: The document review process must be completed before submission.
toeic_zh: 文檔審查過程必須在提交前完成。

en: the sequence of tasks or operations in a job
simple_zh: 我們的工作流程組織良好。
toeic: Improving workflow efficiency reduces production time.
toeic_zh: 提高工作流程效率可減少生產時間。

en: to put a plan or system into operation
simple: We implement the new system next month.
simple_zh: 我們下個月實施新系統。
toeic: The company will implement the new policy starting January.
toeic_zh: 公司將從1月開始實施新政策。

en: to examine or check something carefully
toeic: Please review the proposal and provide feedback.
toeic_zh: 請審查提案並提供反饋。

en: to make something better
toeic: The new system helps improve productivity and efficiency.
toeic_zh: 新系統有助於提高生產力和效率。

en: to make something as good as possible
toeic: Optimizing the distribution network will reduce costs.
toeic_zh: 優化配送網絡將降低成本。

en: to watch or check something carefully
simple_zh: 我們每天監控項目進展。
toeic: Systems are in place to monitor employee productivity.
toeic_zh: 已建立系統來監控員工生產力。

en: to assess the value or effectiveness of something
simple_zh: 我們每年評估員工績效。
toeic: The marketing team will evaluate campaign effectiveness.
toeic_zh: 營銷團隊將評估活動的有效性。

en: to change or modify something slightly
simple: We adjust the schedule as needed.
simple_zh: 我們根據需要調整時間表。
toeic: Please adjust the report figures based on the latest data.
toeic_zh: 請根據最新數據調整報告數字。

en: a group of people working together
simple_zh: 我們的團隊非常有才華。
toeic: The project team will meet every Monday.
toeic_zh: 項目團隊將每週一開會。

en: a person who belongs to a group
simple: Each team member has an important role.
simple_zh: 每個團隊成員都有重要角色。
toeic: All team members are required to attend the training.
toeic_zh: 所有團隊成員都需要參加培訓。

en: a person responsible for directing employees
simple_zh: 我的經理批准我的日程表。
toeic: Managers are responsible for meeting departmental targets.
toeic_zh: 經理負責實現部門目標。

en: a senior leader responsible for a company or division
toeic: The executive director will present the annual results.
toeic_zh: 執行主任將呈現年度結果。

en: a senior manager in a company
toeic: Company executives meet quarterly to review performance.
toeic_zh: 公司高管每季度開會審查績效。

en: all the employees of an organization
toeic: The company hired additional staff for the expansion.
toeic_zh: 公司為擴展聘請了額外員工。

en: to employ someone to work for you
simple: We hire new employees every quarter.
simple_zh: 我們每季度聘請新員工。
toeic: The company plans to hire 50 new staff members this year.
toeic_zh: 公司計劃今年聘請50名新員工。

en: to quit a job
toeic: Two senior managers resigned from the company last month.
toeic_zh: 上個月兩名高管從公司辭職了。

en: to assign a task to someone else
simple: I delegate tasks to my team.
simple_zh: 我將任務委派給我的團隊。
toeic: Effective managers know how to delegate responsibility.
toeic_zh: 有效的經理知道如何委派責任。

en: to work together with others
toeic: Teams collaborate across departments to solve complex problems.
toeic_zh: 團隊跨部門協作以解決複雜問題。

en: to arrange or organize different activities
toeic: The project manager will coordinate all team activities.
toeic_zh: 項目經理將協調所有團隊活動。

en: requiring immediate action or attention
toeic: The urgent emails are marked with red flags.
toeic_zh: 緊急電郵用紅旗標記。

en: a pause or postponement
toeic: Project delays can impact our annual timeline.
toeic_zh: 項目延遲可能影響我們的年度時間表。

en: past the time when something should happen
toeic: Overdue payments will incur a 5% penalty charge.
toeic_zh: 逾期付款將收取5%的罰款。

en: to move or act quickly or hurriedly
simple: We rush to complete the project.
toeic: Please don't rush through the quality assurance process.
toeic_zh: 請不要倉促進行質量保證過程。

en: an additional time allowed to complete something
simple: I request an extension for the deadline.
toeic: The project deadline extension was approved by management.
toeic_zh: 項目截止日期延期已獲管理層批准。

en: a schedule showing when things will happen
toeic: All project milestones are shown on the timeline.
toeic_zh: 所有項目里程碑都顯示在時間線上。

en: movement or development towards success
simple: We make good progress on the project.
simple_zh: 我們在項目上取得了很好的進展。
toeic: Project progress will be reviewed at the next meeting.
toeic_zh: 項目進展將在下次會議上審查。

en: to finish something
toeic: Please complete the form and submit it by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請填寫表格並在星期五前提交。

en: to make something final or complete
toeic: Please finalize the budget before month-end.
toeic_zh: 請在月末前定稿預算。

en: something that is more important than other things
simple: The project is our top priority.
simple_zh: 該項目是我們的首要任務。
toeic: Meeting customer needs is our highest priority.
toeic_zh: 滿足客戶需求是我們的首要任務。

en: information about how someone did something
toeic: Please provide feedback on the training program.
toeic_zh: 請提供對培訓計劃的反饋。

en: the action of working together
toeic: Effective collaboration between teams leads to innovation.
toeic_zh: 團隊之間的有效協作導致創新。

en: the ability to do something without waste
toeic: Improving operational efficiency reduces costs.
toeic_zh: 提高運營效率降低成本。

en: teaching or instruction in skills or knowledge
simple: We provide ongoing training for staff.
simple_zh: 我們為員工提供持續培訓。
toeic: New employees must complete the orientation training.
toeic_zh: 新員工必須完成入職培訓。

en: growth or improvement over time
toeic: The company invests in employee development programs.
toeic_zh: 公司投資於員工發展計劃。

en: a new plan or program to achieve a goal
toeic: The sustainability initiative aims to reduce our carbon footprint.
toeic_zh: 可持續發展計劃旨在減少我們的碳足跡。

en: the introduction of new ideas or methods
toeic: The company promotes a culture of innovation and creativity.
toeic_zh: 公司提倡創新和創意文化。

en: process to ensure products meet standards
toeic: Our quality assurance team tests every product before shipment.
toeic_zh: 我們的質量保證團隊在發貨前測試每件產品。

en: assistance provided to customers
toeic: The customer service team is available 24/7.
toeic_zh: 客戶服務團隊全天候可用。

en: transfer of responsibility from one person to another
toeic: The project handover to the operations team is scheduled for next week.
toeic_zh: 項目交接給運營團隊定於下週進行。

en: written material providing information or procedures
toeic: Complete documentation is required for all processes.
toeic_zh: 所有流程都需要完整文檔。

en: movement or distribution through a group
toeic: The document is in circulation for approval.
toeic_zh: 文檔正在傳閱以待批准。

en: the action of keeping or holding something
toeic: The company has a retention policy for all employee records.
toeic_zh: 公司對所有員工記錄有保留政策。

en: the state of being safe or protected
toeic: All employees must follow security protocols.
toeic_zh: 所有員工必須遵循安全協議。

en: the state of keeping something secret
simple: Confidentiality is required in this role.
toeic: All information must be handled with strict confidentiality.
toeic_zh: 所有信息必須嚴格保密。

en: responsibility for one's actions
simple: Accountability is important in our workplace.
simple_zh: 問責在我們的工作場所很重要。
toeic: Each manager is accountable for their team's performance.
toeic_zh: 每位經理對其團隊的績效負責。

en: openness and clarity in dealings
simple_zh: 我們重視溝通的透明度。
toeic: Organizational transparency builds employee trust.
toeic_zh: 組織透明度建立員工信任。

en: honesty and moral principles
simple_zh: 誠正對領導力至關重要。
toeic: The company is known for its integrity and ethical practices.
toeic_zh: 公司以其誠正和倫理實踐而聞名。

en: ability to meet present needs without harming the future
simple_zh: 可持續性是我們的優先事項。
toeic: The company is committed to environmental sustainability.
toeic_zh: 公司致力於環境可持續性。

en: the action of complying with rules or standards
simple: Compliance is mandatory for all employees.
simple_zh: 所有員工都必須遵守合規。
toeic: Regular audits ensure compliance with regulations.
toeic_zh: 定期審計確保合規性。

en: rules for how documents should be created
toeic: All reports must comply with company documentation standards.
toeic_zh: 所有報告必須符合公司文檔標準。

en: the action of checking or proving validity
toeic: All data requires validation before processing.
toeic_zh: 所有數據在處理前都需要驗證。

en: rules or procedures to follow
toeic: All communication must follow established protocols.
toeic_zh: 所有通信都必須遵循既定協議。

en: the process of making something more serious or severe
simple: Issue escalation follows a clear process.
simple_zh: 問題升級遵循明確的過程。
toeic: Customer complaints follow an escalation procedure.
toeic_zh: 客戶投訴遵循升級程序。

en: the action of solving a problem or conflict
toeic: Customer issue resolution should be handled within 48 hours.
toeic_zh: 客戶問題解決應在48小時內處理。

en: a record of customer support request
toeic: Each customer issue is tracked through a support ticket.
toeic_zh: 每個客戶問題都通過支持票進行跟踪。

en: steps to follow when a problem becomes serious
toeic: Follow the escalation procedure if the issue cannot be resolved.
toeic_zh: 如果無法解決問題，請遵循升級程序。

en: a provision for something that might happen
toeic: Contingency plans ensure business continuity.
toeic_zh: 應急計劃確保業務連續性。

en: the action of returning to normal state
toeic: Disaster recovery procedures are tested quarterly.
toeic_zh: 災難恢復程序每季度測試一次。

en: the state of being redundant or no longer needed
toeic: We maintain redundancy for critical systems.
toeic_zh: 我們為關鍵系統維護冗餘。

en: the length of time a system is working properly
simple_zh: 我們的正常運行時間是99.9%。
toeic: System uptime is critical for business operations.
toeic_zh: 系統正常運行時間對業務運營至關重要。

en: time when a system is not working
toeic: Minimize downtime by conducting maintenance during off-hours.
toeic_zh: 通過在非工作時間進行維護來最小化停機時間。

en: a failure in the supply of something
toeic: System outages must be reported immediately.
toeic_zh: 系統故障必須立即報告。

en: process of documenting problems or accidents
toeic: All workplace incidents must be reported within 24 hours.
toeic_zh: 所有工作場所事件必須在24小時內報告。

en: process of finding the underlying cause of a problem
toeic: Conduct root cause analysis to prevent future incidents.
toeic_zh: 進行根本原因分析以防止將來的事件。

en: steps taken to fix a problem
toeic: Corrective actions must be documented and tracked.
toeic_zh: 糾正措施必須記錄並跟踪。

en: action taken to prevent something bad from happening
toeic: Implement preventive measures to avoid system failures.
toeic_zh: 實施預防措施以避免系統故障。

en: measurements used to evaluate quality
simple_zh: 我們密切跟踪質量指標。
toeic: Quality metrics must meet industry standards.
toeic_zh: 質量指標必須符合行業標準。

en: measure of how satisfied customers are
toeic: We measure customer satisfaction through regular surveys.
toeic_zh: 我們通過定期調查衡量客戶滿意度。

en: a person with an interest in a business or project
toeic: Key stakeholders must approve the project proposal.
toeic_zh: 關鍵利益相關者必須批准項目提案。

en: Writing materials such as pens, paper, and envelopes.
simple: I need new stationery for school.
toeic: Please order more stationery before the supply cabinet runs out.
toeic_zh: 請在文具櫃用完之前多訂購一些文具。

en: Extra hours worked beyond the normal working schedule.
simple: My father works overtime on Fridays.
toeic: Employees who work overtime will be paid at one and a half times their rate.
toeic_zh: 加班的員工將以一點五倍的薪資計算。

en: The amount of work a person or team has to do.
simple: My workload is heavy this week.
toeic: The manager hired two assistants to reduce the team's workload.
toeic_zh: 經理聘請了兩名助理以減輕團隊的工作量。

en: a person who is present at an event
simple: Every attendee must sign the attendance sheet.
simple_zh: 每位參加者都必須簽到。
toeic: The attendees received a welcome package upon arrival.
toeic_zh: 參加者在到達時收到歡迎禮包。

en: a space in a building that is enclosed by walls
simple: The meeting room is on the third floor.
toeic: Conference room B will be available from 2 to 4 p.m.
toeic_zh: B會議室將從下午2點到4點可用。

en: the choice of when something should happen
simple: The timing of the meeting was perfect for everyone.
simple_zh: 會議的時機對每個人都很完美。
toeic: Proper timing is crucial for project launch success.
toeic_zh: 適當的時機對項目推出成功至關重要。

en: to decide that something planned will not happen
simple: We had to cancel the meeting because of bad weather.
simple_zh: 由於天氣惡劣，我們不得不取消會議。
toeic: All outdoor events have been cancelled due to the storm.
toeic_zh: 由於暴風雨，所有戶外活動已被取消。

en: a written record of the important points discussed at a meeting
simple: The minutes from last meeting are attached to the email.
simple_zh: 上次會議的記錄已附在電子郵件中。
toeic: Meeting minutes will be distributed to all participants within 24 hours.
toeic_zh: 會議記錄將在24小時內分發給所有參與者。

en: a meeting for discussion or training on a particular topic
simple: The HR department organized a seminar on workplace safety.
simple_zh: 人力資源部組織了一場關於工作場所安全的研討班。
toeic: Employees attended a professional development seminar last week.
toeic_zh: 員工上週參加了專業發展研討班。

en: a meeting at which a group of people engages in intensive discussion or training
simple: The software workshop teaches advanced coding techniques.
simple_zh: 軟件工作坊教授高級編碼技術。
toeic: Our company hosts quarterly workshops for skills development.
toeic_zh: 我們的公司每季度舉辦技能發展工作坊。

en: a person who presents or introduces a show or program
simple: The presenter explained the new product features clearly.
simple_zh: 主講人清楚地解釋了新產品的功能。
toeic: Our top presenter will lead tomorrow's training session.
toeic_zh: 我們的頂級主講人將主持明天的培訓課程。

en: a person who makes a speech or gives a talk
simple: The keynote speaker shared valuable insights about innovation.
simple_zh: 主旨演講者分享了關於創新的寶貴見解。
toeic: We invited three distinguished speakers for the conference.
toeic_zh: 我們邀請了三位傑出的演講者參加會議。

en: to talk about something with another person or group
simple: We need to discuss the budget for next year.
simple_zh: 我們需要討論明年的預算。
toeic: The team will discuss the project timeline in tomorrow's meeting.
toeic_zh: 團隊將在明天的會議上討論項目時間表。

en: a formal discussion on a particular topic with opposing viewpoints
simple: There was a debate about the best approach to solve this problem.
simple_zh: 對於解決此問題的最佳方法有辯論。
toeic: The board engaged in a lengthy debate before making the decision.
toeic_zh: 董事會在做出決定前進行了冗長的辯論。

en: an arrangement to meet or visit someone at a specified time
simple: I have an appointment with the doctor at 3 p.m.
simple_zh: 我下午3點與醫生有約會。
toeic: Please schedule an appointment with our sales team to discuss pricing.
toeic_zh: 請與我們的銷售團隊預約以討論定價。

en: the length of time that something continues
simple: The duration of the meeting is two hours.
simple_zh: 會議的持續時間是兩小時。
toeic: The project duration has been extended by three months.
toeic_zh: 項目持續時間已延長三個月。

en: to arrange something for a different time
simple: Can we reschedule the meeting to next Monday?
simple_zh: 我們能把會議改期到下週一嗎？
toeic: The client requested to reschedule the presentation due to prior commitments.
toeic_zh: 由於先前的承諾，客戶要求重新安排演示。

en: a person who arranges and plans an event or activity
simple: The organizer prepared everything for the conference.
simple_zh: 組織者為會議準備了一切。
toeic: Contact the event organizer for any questions about registration.
toeic_zh: 有任何關於註冊的問題，請聯繫活動組織者。

en: a person who organizes the activities of different people
simple: The project coordinator manages all team communications.
simple_zh: 項目協調員管理所有團隊溝通。
toeic: Contact the event coordinator to arrange the meeting room.
toeic_zh: 聯繫活動協調員安排會議室。

en: a person who helps a group or process progress
simple: The facilitator guided the discussion toward a solution.
simple_zh: 推動者引導討論走向解決方案。
toeic: An experienced facilitator will conduct tomorrow's workshop.
toeic_zh: 一位經驗豐富的推動者將主持明天的工作坊。

en: a person who presides over a discussion or meeting
simple: The moderator kept the discussion focused on the main points.
simple_zh: 主持人使討論集中在要點上。
toeic: Our team leader will serve as moderator for the panel discussion.
toeic_zh: 我們的團隊領導將擔任座談會的主持人。

en: a person who is invited to an event
simple: All invitees received the meeting invitation by email.
simple_zh: 所有受邀人都通過電子郵件收到了會議邀請。
toeic: Invitees are expected to RSVP within two business days.
toeic_zh: 受邀人應在兩個工作日內回覆。

en: a request for the recipient to confirm attendance
simple: Please RSVP by sending an email to the organizer.
simple_zh: 請通過發送電子郵件給組織者來RSVP。
toeic: The invitation requires RSVP by the end of this week.
toeic_zh: 邀請要求在本週末之前RSVP。

en: a place or position
simple: The location for the meeting is Building B, Room 201.
toeic: Our office location has changed to a new building.
toeic_zh: 我們的辦公室地點已改為新大樓。

en: the details of where a place can be found or correspondence sent
simple: Please provide the address of the conference venue.
simple_zh: 請提供會議場地的地址。
toeic: The company address is listed on the official website.
toeic_zh: 公司地址列在官方網站上。

en: a person who provides a service to others
simple: The attendant will help check everyone in.
simple_zh: 服務員將幫助所有人簽到。
toeic: Flight attendants will assist passengers during the conference trip.
toeic_zh: 空乘人員將在會議旅行期間協助乘客。

en: a speech that sets the tone for an event
simple: The keynote speaker is a famous technology entrepreneur.
simple_zh: 主旨演講者是著名的科技企業家。
toeic: The keynote address will be delivered at 9 a.m. tomorrow.
toeic_zh: 主旨演講將於明天上午9點進行。

en: a meeting of heads of state or senior officials
simple: The international summit brought together world leaders.
simple_zh: 國際峰會聚集了世界領導人。
toeic: The annual business summit showcases innovation and industry trends.
toeic_zh: 年度商業峰會展示創新和行業趨勢。

en: a large meeting where members of a group gather
simple: The convention attracts thousands of participants annually.
simple_zh: 大會每年吸引數千名參與者。
toeic: Our industry convention will feature keynote speeches and networking.
toeic_zh: 我們的行業大會將提供主旨演講和交流機會。

en: a meeting at which specialists deliver short addresses on a topic
simple: The medical symposium featured experts from across Europe.
simple_zh: 醫學研討會邀請了來自歐洲各地的專家。
toeic: Register for the annual symposium on environmental sustainability.
toeic_zh: 報名參加年度環境可持續性研討會。

en: a meeting or medium for discussion of topics of interest
simple: The online forum allows participants to ask questions anytime.
simple_zh: 在線論壇允許參與者隨時提問。
toeic: Join the international forum to share best practices.
toeic_zh: 加入國際論壇以分享最佳實踐。

zh: 網路研討會；網絡研討班
en: a seminar conducted over the internet
simple: The webinar on digital marketing attracted 500 participants.
simple_zh: 關於數位行銷的網路研討會吸引了500名參與者。
toeic: Register for next week's webinar on cloud computing solutions.
toeic_zh: 報名參加下週關於雲計算解決方案的網路研討會。

en: a period of time devoted to a particular activity
simple: The training session lasts three hours.
toeic: Breakout sessions will run concurrently with the main conference.
toeic_zh: 分組會議將與主會議同時進行。

en: a pause or rest from work or activity
simple: We'll take a 15-minute break after the first session.
simple_zh: 第一堂課後我們會休息15分鐘。
toeic: Coffee and refreshments will be provided during the break.
toeic_zh: 休息時間將提供咖啡和茶點。

en: a period of time when something stops for a break
simple: The committee called for a recess to review the proposal.
simple_zh: 委員會呼籲休會以審查該提案。
toeic: During recess, participants can network and exchange contact information.
toeic_zh: 在休會期間，參與者可以交流並交換聯繫信息。

en: a formal proposal made during a meeting
simple: The motion was approved by a majority vote.
simple_zh: 該動議獲得多數票批准。
toeic: Any committee member can introduce a motion for consideration.
toeic_zh: 任何委員會成員都可以提出動議供考慮。

en: a plan or idea put forward for consideration
simple: The proposal received support from most team members.
simple_zh: 該提案獲得了大多數團隊成員的支持。
toeic: The marketing department submitted a budget proposal for review.
toeic_zh: 市場部提交了預算提案供審查。

en: a change to a motion, law, or document
simple: An amendment to the proposal was suggested.
simple_zh: 提議對該提案進行修正案。
toeic: The amendment was accepted and added to the official record.
toeic_zh: 修正案被接受並添加到官方記錄中。

en: general agreement among group members
simple: We reached a consensus on the project timeline.
simple_zh: 我們就項目時間表達成了共識。
toeic: The team worked to build consensus before implementing changes.
toeic_zh: 團隊在實施變更前努力建立共識。

en: the fact or condition of being in accord
simple: The team came to an agreement on the budget.
simple_zh: 團隊在預算上達成了協議。
toeic: Both parties signed the agreement after the meeting concluded.
toeic_zh: 會議結束後，雙方簽署了協議。

en: lack of consensus or a difference of opinion
simple: There was disagreement about the sales strategy.
simple_zh: 對於銷售策略有意見不合。
toeic: The disagreement between departments delayed the project decision.
toeic_zh: 部門之間的意見不合延遲了項目決定。

en: an expression of disagreement or disapproval
simple: No objections were raised during the meeting.
toeic: The manager addressed the team's objections to the new policy.
toeic_zh: 經理解決了團隊對新政策的異議。

en: prolonged public disagreement or heated debate
simple: The controversy over the new policy divided the team.
simple_zh: 關於新政策的爭議分裂了團隊。
toeic: The project faced controversy regarding its environmental impact.
toeic_zh: 該項目因其環境影響而面臨爭議。

en: a disagreement or argument
simple: The dispute was resolved through mediation.
simple_zh: 爭執通過調解得到解決。
toeic: The labor dispute led to a meeting with senior management.
toeic_zh: 勞資爭執導致與高級管理層的會議。

en: serious disagreement or incompatibility
simple: The conflict between two departments needs to be addressed.
simple_zh: 兩個部門之間的衝突需要解決。
toeic: Managing workplace conflict is part of the manager's role.
toeic_zh: 管理工作場所衝突是經理角色的一部分。

en: a formal expression of choice or opinion
simple: The vote on the proposal passed 8-2.
simple_zh: 關於提案的投票以8:2通過。
toeic: Each committee member has one vote on decisions.
toeic_zh: 每位委員會成員在決定上有一票。

en: a conclusion or resolution reached after consideration
simple: The decision was made after careful consideration.
simple_zh: 經過仔細考慮做出了決定。
toeic: The board will announce its final decision next week.
toeic_zh: 董事會將於下週宣布最終決定。

en: a written or printed version of words spoken
simple: The meeting transcript is available for download.
toeic: Participants can request a transcript of the webinar.
toeic_zh: 參與者可以要求網路研討會的逐字稿。

en: a task that must be completed following a meeting
simple: The action items from the meeting are due next Friday.
simple_zh: 會議的待辦項於下週五截止。
toeic: Each team member was assigned specific action items.
toeic_zh: 每位團隊成員被分配了具體的待辦項。

en: the state of being accountable for something
simple: The responsibility for the project falls on our team.
simple_zh: 項目的責任落在我們團隊身上。
toeic: Team member responsibility for tasks was clearly defined.
toeic_zh: 清楚地定義了團隊成員對任務的責任。

en: a task or piece of work allocated to someone
simple: The assignment requires completing a detailed report.
simple_zh: 這項任務要求完成詳細報告。
toeic: Team members received their assignments at the beginning of the project.
toeic_zh: 團隊成員在項目開始時收到了他們的任務分配。

en: the object of a person's ambition or effort
simple: The team's goal is to increase sales by 20%.
simple_zh: 團隊的目標是增加20%的銷售。
toeic: Long-term goals were discussed during the strategy session.
toeic_zh: 長期目標在戰略會議中進行了討論。

en: an objective or result that one is trying to achieve
simple: The sales target for this quarter is $2 million.
simple_zh: 本季度的銷售目標是200萬美元。
toeic: We are on track to meet our annual targets.
toeic_zh: 我們正在按軌道實現年度目標。

en: key performance indicator; a measure of success
simple: Employee satisfaction is one of our important KPIs.
simple_zh: 員工滿意度是我們重要的關鍵績效指標之一。
toeic: The KPIs will be reviewed quarterly by the management team.
toeic_zh: 關鍵績效指標將由管理團隊每季度審查一次。

en: a plan of action designed to achieve a goal
simple: Our marketing strategy focuses on digital channels.
simple_zh: 我們的行銷策略集中在數位渠道上。
toeic: The business strategy was presented during the board meeting.
toeic_zh: 商業策略在董事會會議上進行了展示。

en: an action or strategy carefully planned to achieve an end
simple: The sales team used different tactics to close deals.
simple_zh: 銷售團隊使用不同的戰術來成交。
toeic: Negotiation tactics were discussed in the training session.
toeic_zh: 談判戰術在培訓課程中進行了討論。

en: a way of dealing with or considering something
simple: Our approach to problem-solving is collaborative.
simple_zh: 我們解決問題的方法是合作的。
toeic: The new approach to customer service improved satisfaction scores.
toeic_zh: 客戶服務的新方法提高了滿意度分數。

en: a way of doing something
simple: The new method is more efficient than before.
simple_zh: 新方法比以前更有效率。
toeic: The method used in this project differs from our standard approach.
toeic_zh: 此項目中使用的方法與我們的標準方法不同。

en: a public or formal statement
simple: The announcement was made during this morning's meeting.
simple_zh: 公告在今天上午的會議中發布。
toeic: An announcement regarding schedule changes will be posted tomorrow.
toeic_zh: 關於日程變更的公告將於明天發布。

en: formal notification or information
simple: Please give two weeks' notice before resigning.
simple_zh: 請在辭職前提前兩週通知。
toeic: Notice of the meeting cancellation was sent to all participants.
toeic_zh: 會議取消的通知已發送給所有參與者。

en: an individual article or unit
simple: The last item on the agenda was budget approval.
simple_zh: 議程上的最後一項是預算批准。
toeic: Each item in the proposal needs careful review.
toeic_zh: 提案中的每一項都需要仔細審查。

en: a detail or particular aspect
simple: The speaker made an important point about revenue growth.
simple_zh: 演講者談到了關於收入增長的一個重要要點。
toeic: The key point of the presentation was innovation strategy.
toeic_zh: 演示的要點是創新戰略。

en: information, suggestions, or contributions
simple: We welcome your input on this matter.
simple_zh: 我們歡迎您對此事的意見。
toeic: The team requested client input before finalizing the proposal.
toeic_zh: 團隊在最終確定提案前請求客戶的意見。

en: a remark or observation about something
simple: The manager's comment highlighted the key issue.
simple_zh: 經理的評論突出了關鍵問題。
toeic: Participants are welcome to make comments during the Q&A session.
toeic_zh: 歡迎參與者在提問環節發表評論。

en: a thing that requires an answer or explanation
simple: Do you have any questions about the agenda?
simple_zh: 您對議程有任何疑問嗎？
toeic: Participants submitted questions to the Q&A coordinator.
toeic_zh: 參與者向提問協調員提交了問題。

en: a response to a question
simple: The presenter provided a clear answer to the question.
simple_zh: 主講人對該問題提供了明確的答案。
toeic: All questions received thorough answers from the expert panel.
toeic_zh: 所有問題都從專家組得到了全面的回答。

en: a reply or reaction to something
simple: The response from the team was positive.
toeic: We received responses from 80% of meeting invitees.
toeic_zh: 我們從80%的會議邀請者那裡收到了回覆。

en: the action of making something clearer or easier to understand
simple: Please provide clarification on the budget figures.
toeic: Clarification on the project scope was requested.
toeic_zh: 要求澄清項目範圍。

en: a statement that makes something clear
simple: The explanation of the new system was thorough.
simple_zh: 對新系統的解釋很周全。
toeic: An explanation of the changes will be provided at the meeting.
toeic_zh: 將在會議上提供變更的解釋。

en: an explanation of the meaning of something
simple: The interpretation of the data requires careful analysis.
simple_zh: 對數據的解釋需要仔細分析。
toeic: Different interpretations of the policy led to confusion.
toeic_zh: 對政策的不同解釋導致了混亂。

en: matter or substance of which something is made
simple: Reading materials will be provided for the seminar.
simple_zh: 研討班將提供閱讀材料。
toeic: All presentation materials should be submitted in advance.
toeic_zh: 所有演示材料應提前提交。

en: a source of supply or support that can be drawn upon
simple: Our team has limited resources for this project.
simple_zh: 我們的團隊為這個項目的資源有限。
toeic: Meeting resources include conference rooms and video conferencing.
toeic_zh: 會議資源包括會議室和視頻會議。

en: a thing made for a particular purpose
simple: Please turn off your mobile devices during the meeting.
simple_zh: 會議期間請關閉您的行動設備。
toeic: Electronic devices must be silenced in the conference room.
toeic_zh: 電子設備在會議室中必須靜音。

en: the application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes
simple: Modern technology has changed how we conduct meetings.
simple_zh: 現代技術改變了我們舉行會議的方式。
toeic: The company invests heavily in meeting technology.
toeic_zh: 公司在會議技術上投入巨資。

en: a set of connected things working together
simple: The new scheduling system is easy to use.
simple_zh: 新的日程系統易於使用。
toeic: The meeting management system streamlined the booking process.
toeic_zh: 會議管理系統簡化了預訂流程。

en: a raised structure for standing or a forum for discussion
simple: The platform allows users to schedule virtual meetings.
simple_zh: 該平臺允許用戶安排虛擬會議。
toeic: Our company uses a cloud-based platform for remote meetings.
toeic_zh: 我們的公司使用基於雲的平臺進行遠程會議。

en: not physically existing but made to appear by software
simple: Virtual meetings save travel time and costs.
simple_zh: 虛擬會議節省旅行時間和成本。
toeic: The company held a virtual conference with 5,000 participants.
toeic_zh: 公司舉行了一次有5000名參與者的虛擬會議。

en: situated far away or able to be accessed from a distance
simple: Remote attendance is available for the meeting.
simple_zh: 會議提供遠程出席的選項。
toeic: Remote participants can join via video conference link.
toeic_zh: 遠程參與者可以通過視頻會議鏈接加入。

en: connected to, served by, or available through the internet
simple: The online meeting platform supports screen sharing.
simple_zh: 在線會議平臺支持屏幕共享。
toeic: Register for the online workshop by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在星期五前報名參加在線工作坊。

en: involving or relating to information in the form of digits
simple: Digital calendars help organize our schedules.
simple_zh: 數位日曆幫助我們組織日程。
toeic: The company uses digital tools for meeting coordination.
toeic_zh: 公司使用數位工具進行會議協調。

en: relating to or made using electronics
simple: Electronic invitations are more efficient than paper ones.
simple_zh: 電子邀請比紙質邀請更有效率。
toeic: Electronic signatures are acceptable on contracts.
toeic_zh: 電子簽名在合同上是可接受的。

en: operated by automatic machinery or process
simple: Automated reminders help attendees remember meetings.
simple_zh: 自動提醒幫助出席者記住會議。
toeic: The automated system sends confirmations to all invitees.
toeic_zh: 自動系統向所有邀請者發送確認。

en: successful in producing intended result
simple: This strategy has proven effective for engagement.
simple_zh: 這項策略已被證明對參與度有效。
toeic: Effective communication is essential in meetings.
toeic_zh: 有效的溝通在會議中是必不可少的。

en: producing much fruit or vegetation; creative
simple: The meeting was very productive and informative.
simple_zh: 會議非常有成效且內容豐富。
toeic: Productive discussions led to actionable solutions.
toeic_zh: 富有成效的討論導致了可行的解決方案。

en: arranged or organized in a logical order
simple: An organized meeting runs on schedule.
simple_zh: 有組織的會議按時進行。
toeic: The well-organized conference impressed all participants.
toeic_zh: 組織良好的會議給所有參與者留下了深刻印象。

en: organized into a clear structure
simple: A structured agenda helps keep meetings focused.
simple_zh: 結構化的議程幫助會議保持專注。
toeic: Structured meetings produce better outcomes.
toeic_zh: 結構化的會議產生更好的成果。

en: done in a methodical and organized way
simple: A systematic approach prevents overlooking important topics.
simple_zh: 系統的方法可以防止遺漏重要主題。
toeic: Systematic review of all proposals was completed.
toeic_zh: 對所有提案的系統審查已完成。

en: done in a careful and ordered manner
simple_zh: 有方法的規劃確保會議成功。
toeic: The speaker used a methodical approach to present data.
toeic_zh: 演講者使用有方法的方法來呈現數據。

en: capable of reasoning correctly
simple: The logical flow of the presentation was easy to follow.
simple_zh: 演示的邏輯流程很容易跟進。
toeic: A logical conclusion was reached after careful analysis.
toeic_zh: 經過仔細分析後得出了合理的結論。

en: based on reason or logic
simple: A rational decision was made after considering all options.
simple_zh: 在考慮所有選項後做出了合理的決定。
toeic: The rational basis for the decision was explained clearly.
toeic_zh: 決定的理性基礎得到了明確解釋。

en: fairly good, moderate, or fair
simple: A reasonable timeline was set for project completion.
simple_zh: 為項目完成設定了合理的時間表。
toeic: Reasonable expectations were communicated to all participants.
toeic_zh: 向所有參與者傳達了合理的期望。

en: open and clear, easy to perceive or understand
simple: Transparent communication builds trust in meetings.
simple_zh: 透明的溝通在會議中建立信任。
toeic: The company maintains transparent reporting to stakeholders.
toeic_zh: 公司對利益相關者保持透明報告。

en: easy to perceive, understand, or see
simple: Clear instructions were provided for the meeting registration.
simple_zh: 會議報名提供了清楚的指示。
toeic: A clear presentation style keeps audience engaged.
toeic_zh: 清晰的演示風格使觀眾保持參與。

en: easily perceived or understood
simple: The obvious choice was to postpone the meeting.
simple_zh: 明顯的選擇是延期會議。
toeic: The obvious benefits of the proposal were discussed.
toeic_zh: 討論了提案的明顯好處。

en: clearly visible or understood
simple: It was evident that the meeting was successful.
toeic: The need for change was evident from the data.
toeic_zh: 從數據中可以看出需要變革。

en: happening at the same time
simple: Concurrent sessions allow attendees to choose their preferences.
simple_zh: 並行會議允許參與者選擇他們的偏好。
toeic: Multiple concurrent workshops will run during the conference.
toeic_zh: 會議期間將進行多個並行工作坊。

en: occurring, done, or existing at the same time
simple: Simultaneous translation is provided in multiple languages.
simple_zh: 提供多種語言的同時翻譯。
toeic: Simultaneous sessions allow broader coverage of topics.
toeic_zh: 同時進行的會議允許更廣泛的主題覆蓋。

en: occurring or existing at the same time
simple: Parallel projects are managed by different teams.
simple_zh: 並行項目由不同的團隊管理。
toeic: Parallel tracks were offered for different skill levels.
toeic_zh: 為不同技能水平提供了並行軌道。

en: happening or existing at the same time
simple: Synchronous meetings require everyone to attend at the same time.
simple_zh: 同步會議要求所有人同時參加。
toeic: Synchronous communication was preferred for urgent decisions.
toeic_zh: 對於緊急決定，同步通信是首選。

en: not synchronized; not occurring at the same time
simple: Asynchronous communication allows flexibility in schedules.
simple_zh: 非同步通信允許日程中的靈活性。
toeic: Asynchronous meetings can be recorded for later viewing.
toeic_zh: 非同步會議可以記錄以供稍後查看。

en: capable of being adapted to new circumstances
simple: A flexible meeting schedule accommodates different time zones.
simple_zh: 靈活的會議日程適應不同的時區。
toeic: Our company offers flexible meeting arrangements for remote employees.
toeic_zh: 我們的公司為遠程員工提供靈活的會議安排。

en: able to change to suit new conditions
simple: An adaptable agenda can address unexpected issues.
simple_zh: 適應性的議程可以解決意外問題。
toeic: Adaptable meeting formats serve various organizational needs.
toeic_zh: 適應性的會議格式服務於各種組織需求。

en: able to be adjusted
simple: Adjustable meeting times work for different schedules.
simple_zh: 可調整的會議時間適合不同的日程。
toeic: Adjustable equipment allows comfortable seating for all participants.
toeic_zh: 可調整的設備為所有參與者提供舒適的座位。

en: not consistent or having a fixed pattern
simple: Variable meeting times sometimes create scheduling conflicts.
simple_zh: 可變的會議時間有時會造成日程衝突。
toeic: The variable cost of virtual meetings depends on platform choice.
toeic_zh: 虛擬會議的可變成本取決於平臺選擇。

en: agreeing or accordant
simple: Consistent meeting times help establish routine.
simple_zh: 一致的會議時間幫助建立常規。
toeic: Consistent communication style builds credibility with stakeholders.
toeic_zh: 一致的溝通風格與利益相關者建立信譽。

en: not varying; the same in all cases
simple_zh: 統一的會議程序確保公平性。
toeic: Uniform standards were applied across all meeting formats.
toeic_zh: 統一的標準適用於所有會議格式。

en: occurring continuously; remaining the same
simple: Constant communication keeps the team aligned.
simple_zh: 不斷的溝通使團隊保持一致。
toeic: The constant flow of information keeps everyone informed.
toeic_zh: 信息的不斷流動使每個人都了解情況。

en: from the Latin  'continuus', meaning 'unbroken'.
simple: Continuous improvement of meeting processes is our goal.
simple_zh: 不斷改進會議流程是我們的目標。
toeic: Continuous feedback helps optimize meeting effectiveness.
toeic_zh: 連續的反饋幫助優化會議效果。

en: continuing to develop or happen
simple: Ongoing discussions will continue after the meeting.
toeic: Ongoing projects require regular status update meetings.
toeic_zh: 進行中的項目需要定期狀態更新會議。

en: arriving or doing something at the expected time
simple: Punctual arrival is expected at all meetings.
simple_zh: 所有會議都期望守時到達。
toeic: Punctual presentation of reports is required.
toeic_zh: 需要準時提交報告。

en: occurring at or done at an opportune or useful moment
simple: Timely information delivery is essential for good decisions.
simple_zh: 及時的信息傳遞對做出好決定至關重要。
toeic: Timely notification of changes prevents confusion.
toeic_zh: 及時通知變更可防止混亂。

zh: 關鍵的；臨界的；批評性的
en: at a point of crisis; of vital importance
simple: Critical issues must be addressed immediately.
simple_zh: 關鍵問題必須立即解決。
toeic: Critical feedback from the review session was documented.
toeic_zh: 評審會議的關鍵反饋已記錄。

en: absolutely necessary or important
simple: Clear communication is vital for project success.
simple_zh: 清晰的溝通對項目成功至關重要。
toeic: Vital information must not be delayed in meetings.
toeic_zh: 重要信息在會議中不能延遲。

en: absolutely necessary; vitally important
simple: An agenda is essential for a productive meeting.
simple_zh: 議程對於有成效的會議至關重要。
toeic: Essential documents were distributed before the meeting.
toeic_zh: 必要的文件在會議前已分發。

en: of great importance; critical
simple: Timing is crucial for the project launch meeting.
simple_zh: 時機對於項目啟動會議至關重要。
toeic: Crucial decisions require input from all stakeholders.
toeic_zh: 關鍵決定需要所有利益相關者的意見。

en: relating to or affecting the basic nature of something
simple: A fundamental agreement was reached on core values.
simple_zh: 在核心價值觀上達成了基本協議。
toeic: Fundamental principles guide our meeting procedures.
toeic_zh: 基本原則指導我們的會議程序。

en: relating to or forming an essential part of something
simple: Basic meeting etiquette should always be followed.
simple_zh: 應始終遵守基本的會議禮儀。
toeic: Basic requirements for attendance were communicated.
toeic_zh: 已傳達了出席的基本要求。

zh: 主要的；初級的；第一位的
en: first in order of importance or position
simple: The primary goal of the meeting is to solve the problem.
simple_zh: 會議的主要目標是解決問題。
toeic: Primary concerns about the project were addressed.
toeic_zh: 解決了對項目的主要關注。

en: of less importance than something else
simple: Secondary concerns were discussed after main topics.
simple_zh: 在主要主題之後討論了次要問題。
toeic: Secondary priority items may be rescheduled.
toeic_zh: 次要優先項可能被改期。

zh: 輕微的；未成年人；未成年的
en: not serious or significant
simple_zh: 輕微的問題迅速得到解決。
toeic: Minor modifications were made to the proposal.
toeic_zh: 對提案進行了輕微的修改。

en: lower in rank or position
simple: Subordinate staff attended the department meeting.
simple_zh: 下屬人員參加了部門會議。
toeic: Subordinate details were handled by the committee.
toeic_zh: 委員會處理了從屬細節。

en: providing additional or supplementary help
simple: Auxiliary support is available for technical issues.
simple_zh: 技術問題可獲得輔助支持。
toeic: Auxiliary functions ensure smooth meeting operations.
toeic_zh: 輔助功能確保會議順利進行。

en: added as a supplement or extra
simple: Supplementary materials were sent via email.
simple_zh: 補充材料通過電子郵件發送。
toeic: Supplementary information can be requested after the meeting.
toeic_zh: 會議後可以要求補充信息。

en: extra or added
simple: Additional attendees were accommodated in the room.
simple_zh: 房間中容納了額外的與會者。
toeic: Additional meetings may be scheduled if needed.
toeic_zh: 如需要，可能會安排額外的會議。

en: complete and including everything that is necessary
toeic: Comprehensive training covers all meeting management aspects.
toeic_zh: 全面的培訓涵蓋了所有會議管理方面。

en: done in a careful and complete manner
simple: Thorough review of proposals is required.
simple_zh: 需要對提案進行徹底審查。
toeic: Thorough preparation ensures meeting success.
toeic_zh: 周密的準備確保會議成功。

en: showing great attention to detail; very careful
simple: Meticulous note-taking captures all important points.
simple_zh: 一絲不苟的筆記捕捉所有重要要點。
toeic: Meticulous planning resulted in a flawless conference.
toeic_zh: 精心規劃導致了完美的會議。

en: exact and accurate
simple: Precise timing is needed for the agenda.
toeic: Precise communication prevents misunderstandings.
toeic_zh: 精確的溝通可防止誤解。

en: correct and without errors
simple_zh: 準確的記錄確保了問責制。
toeic: Accurate reporting of meeting decisions is essential.
toeic_zh: 準確報告會議決定至關重要。

en: completely accurate; precise
simple: The exact time of the meeting is 3 p.m.
simple_zh: 會議的確切時間是下午3點。
toeic: The exact details were confirmed before announcement.
toeic_zh: 在宣布前確認了確切細節。

en: clearly defined or identified
simple: Specific objectives were set for the task force.
simple_zh: 為工作小組設定了具體目標。
toeic: Specific requirements must be communicated in advance.
toeic_zh: 必須提前傳達具體要求。

en: relating to a single person or thing rather than others
simple: This particular issue requires immediate attention.
simple_zh: 這個特定的問題需要立即關注。
toeic: No particular format is required for the proposal.
toeic_zh: 提案不需要特定格式。

en: containing many details
simple: Detailed instructions were provided for participants.
simple_zh: 為參與者提供了詳細的指示。
toeic: A detailed breakdown of costs was presented.
toeic_zh: 提交了成本的詳細分析。

zh: 簡短的；扼要的；案情摘要
en: short in duration; concise
simple: A brief summary concluded the meeting.
simple_zh: 簡短的摘要結束了會議。
toeic: Brief updates were provided for each project status.
toeic_zh: 為每個項目狀態提供了簡要更新。

en: brief and clear
simple: A concise agenda keeps meetings focused.
simple_zh: 簡潔的議程使會議保持專注。
toeic: Concise communication is valued in business meetings.
toeic_zh: 簡潔的溝通在商務會議中受到重視。

en: closely packed together; occupying little space
simple: The compact meeting room fits ten people.
simple_zh: 緊湊的會議室可容納10人。
toeic: A compact schedule maximizes productivity.
toeic_zh: 緊湊的日程最大化了生產力。

en: covering a wide range; comprehensive
simple_zh: 廣泛的研究支持了該提案。
toeic: Extensive documentation was prepared for the committee.
toeic_zh: 為委員會準備了廣泛的文檔。

en: comprehensive; leaving no detail unexamined
simple: An exhaustive search found the missing document.
simple_zh: 詳盡的搜索找到了丟失的文件。
toeic: Exhaustive review of all submissions was conducted.
toeic_zh: 對所有提交進行了詳盡的審查。

en: having all elements in proportion
simple: A balanced approach considers all viewpoints.
simple_zh: 平衡的方法考慮了所有觀點。
toeic: Balanced representation ensures fair decision-making.
toeic_zh: 平衡的代表確保了公正的決策。

en: treating people equally; just
simple: Fair representation is important in committee decisions.
simple_zh: 在委員會決定中公平的代表很重要。
toeic: Fair evaluation criteria were established for all proposals.
toeic_zh: 為所有提案制定了公平的評估標準。

en: free from bias or favoritism
simple: Equitable distribution of resources was agreed upon.
simple_zh: 同意了資源的公平分配。
toeic: Equitable treatment ensures participant satisfaction.
toeic_zh: 公平的對待確保了參與者滿意度。

en: not biased or prejudiced
simple: An impartial judge oversaw the selection process.
simple_zh: 公正的評委監督了選拔過程。
toeic: Impartial decisions were made by the review committee.
toeic_zh: 審查委員會做出了公正的決定。

en: not influenced by personal feelings or opinions
simple: An unbiased assessment was provided by the expert.
simple_zh: 專家提供了無偏見的評估。
toeic: Unbiased analysis of the data was conducted.
toeic_zh: 對數據進行了無偏見的分析。

en: not influenced by personal feelings
simple: Objective criteria were used for selection.
toeic: An objective review ensures fairness for all candidates.
toeic_zh: 客觀的審查確保了對所有候選人的公平性。

en: not supporting either side in a conflict
simple: A neutral position is maintained during disputes.
simple_zh: 在爭議中保持中立立場。
toeic: Neutral ground provides a safe space for negotiations.
toeic_zh: 中立的地點為談判提供了安全的空間。

en: involving cooperation between parties
simple: Collaborative efforts led to innovative solutions.
simple_zh: 協作的努力導致了創新解決方案。
toeic: A collaborative approach encourages team participation.
toeic_zh: 協作的方法鼓勵團隊參與。

en: relating to cooperation between parties
simple: Cooperative participants made the meeting run smoothly.
simple_zh: 樂於配合的參與者使會議順利進行。
toeic: A cooperative spirit is essential for project success.
toeic_zh: 合作精神對項目成功至關重要。

en: relating to two or more people equally
simple: Mutual respect among team members is important.
simple_zh: 團隊成員之間的相互尊重很重要。
toeic: Mutual agreement was reached on project terms.
toeic_zh: 就項目條款達成了相互同意。

en: relating to mutual action or influence
simple: Reciprocal support builds strong team bonds.
simple_zh: 相互支持建立了強大的團隊紐帶。
toeic: Reciprocal benefits are key to partnership success.
toeic_zh: 相互受益是伙伴關係成功的關鍵。

en: used by two or more people
simple_zh: 共享資源降低了項目成本。
toeic: Shared values align team objectives.
toeic_zh: 共享價值觀使團隊目標保持一致。

en: relating to all the members of a group together
simple: Collective decisions were made through voting.
simple_zh: 通過投票做出了集體決定。
toeic: The collective input shaped the final strategy.
toeic_zh: 集體意見塑造了最終戰略。

en: joined together for a single purpose
simple: Combined efforts of all teams achieved results.
simple_zh: 所有團隊的聯合努力取得了成果。
toeic: Combined expertise led to breakthrough solutions.
toeic_zh: 聯合的專業知識導致了突破性解決方案。

en: unified into a unified whole
simple: An integrated approach combines multiple strategies.
simple_zh: 綜合的方法結合了多種策略。
toeic: Integrated systems improve meeting coordination.
toeic_zh: 集成系統改善了會議協調。

en: relating to the whole system rather than parts
simple: A holistic review considers all aspects.
simple_zh: 全面的審查考慮了所有方面。
toeic: Holistic evaluation of proposals is necessary.
toeic_zh: 對提案的全面評估是必要的。

en: including all types or categories
simple: An inclusive meeting welcomes all opinions.
simple_zh: 包容的會議歡迎所有意見。
toeic: Inclusive practices ensure diverse participation.
toeic_zh: 包容的做法確保了多樣化的參與。

en: transparent and welcoming to different ideas
simple: Open discussion allows for honest feedback.
simple_zh: 開放的討論允許誠實的反饋。
toeic: An open forum was created for suggestions.
toeic_zh: 為建議創建了一個開放的論壇。

related.zh: 易於接受的；感受敏銳的

en: willing to listen and consider new ideas
simple_zh: 願意接納的經理鼓勵員工參與。
toeic: A receptive audience engaged with the presentation.
toeic_zh: 易於接受的觀眾參與了演示。

en: willing to allow or approve something
simple_zh: 接受的態度促進了問題解決。
toeic: Accepting diverse viewpoints strengthens decisions.
toeic_zh: 接受多元觀點強化了決定。

en: providing support or assistance
toeic: Supportive colleagues make work meetings productive.
toeic_zh: 支持的同事使工作會議有成效。

en: giving confidence or support
simple_zh: 鼓勵的反饋激勵了團隊績效。
toeic: The manager's encouraging words boosted morale.
toeic_zh: 經理的鼓勵話語提升了士氣。

en: having the effect of inspiring someone
simple: The speaker's inspiring message resonated with attendees.
simple_zh: 演講者鼓舞人心的信息與與會者產生共鳴。
toeic: Inspiring leadership transforms team dynamics.
toeic_zh: 鼓舞人心的領導力改變了團隊動態。

en: providing impetus or reason to act
simple_zh: 激勵的激勵措施促進了項目完成。
toeic: Motivating goals align team efforts.
toeic_zh: 激勵性目標使團隊努力保持一致。

en: attracting and holding someone's interest
simple: An engaging presentation maintains audience attention.
simple_zh: 引人入勝的演示保持了觀眾的注意力。
toeic: Engaging content encourages active participation.
toeic_zh: 吸引人的內容鼓勵積極參與。

related.zh: 令人信服的；引人注目的

en: arousing curiosity or interest
simple_zh: 有趣的主題使與會者保持專注。
toeic: An interesting case study illustrated the concept.
toeic_zh: 一個有趣的案例研究說明了這一概念。

en: worth a lot of money or highly esteemed
simple: Valuable insights were shared during the discussion.
simple_zh: 在討論中分享了寶貴的見解。
toeic: Valuable feedback improves future meetings.
toeic_zh: 寶貴的反饋改進了未來的會議。

en: favorable or promoting wellbeing
simple_zh: 會議後實施了有益的變更。
toeic: Beneficial partnerships enhance business growth.
toeic_zh: 有益的伙伴關係促進了業務增長。

en: giving or ready to give help
simple_zh: 有幫助的建議改進了提案。
toeic: Helpful resources were provided to all attendees.
toeic_zh: 為所有與會者提供了有幫助的資源。

en: able to be used for a practical purpose
simple_zh: 有用的模板簡化了會議準備。
toeic: A useful framework guides project planning.
toeic_zh: 有用的框架指導項目規劃。

en: relevant or suitable; can be applied
simple: Applicable rules are enforced during meetings.
simple_zh: 在會議期間執行了適用的規則。
toeic: Applicable standards ensure consistent quality.
toeic_zh: 適用的標準確保了一致的質量。

en: to suggest a plan or idea
toeic: Mr. Cho proposed a change to the work schedule.
toeic_zh: 周先生提議更改工作時程。

en: the act of putting your name on a list
toeic: Online registration for the workshop closes on June 5.
toeic_zh: 工作坊的線上報名在 6 月 5 日截止。
family: register (v), registered (adj); registration fee 報名費

en: to plan or organize something
toeic: The assistant arranged a meeting with the new supplier.
toeic_zh: 助理安排了與新供應商的會議。

en: to make something longer
toeic: The company extended the deadline by two days.
toeic_zh: 公司把截止日期延長了兩天。

en: to happen
toeic: The delay occurred because of bad weather.
toeic_zh: 延誤是因為天氣不好才發生的。

en: to think that something will happen
simple_zh: 我預期會收到一封電子郵件。
toeic: We expect the client to arrive at ten.
toeic_zh: 我們預計客戶十點到達。

en: a request to come to an event
toeic: Thank you for your invitation to the opening ceremony.
toeic_zh: 謝謝您邀請我參加開幕典禮。

en: The minimum number of members needed to hold a valid meeting.
simple: We need a quorum to start.
simple_zh: 我們需要法定人數才能開始。
toeic: The board could not vote because the meeting lacked a quorum.
toeic_zh: 由於缺乏法定人數，董事會無法進行表決。

en: To be in charge of a meeting or event.
simple: She will preside over the meeting.
toeic: The vice president will preside at tomorrow's budget meeting.
toeic_zh: 副總裁將主持明天的預算會議。

en: A short summary of the main points.
simple: Please give me a quick recap.
simple_zh: 請給我簡短的重點回顧。
toeic: Marcus began the session with a recap of last week's decisions.
toeic_zh: 馬庫斯以上週決議的重點回顧開始這場會議。

en: To continue longer than the planned time.
simple_zh: 今天的會議可能會超時。
toeic: If the discussion overruns, we will skip the final agenda item.
toeic_zh: 如果討論超時，我們將跳過最後一項議程。

en: Not final; likely to change.
simple_zh: 我們有一個暫定的計畫。
toeic: The tentative schedule will be confirmed by the end of the week.
toeic_zh: 暫定的時程將在本週結束前確認。

en: Happening again and again at regular times.
simple_zh: 這是一個定期重複的會議。
toeic: Please add the recurring meeting to everyone's calendar every Monday.
toeic_zh: 請把這個定期會議加入每個人每週一的行事曆。

en: To share many ideas quickly in a group.
simple_zh: 我們每週五腦力激盪想點子。
toeic: The team will brainstorm solutions during the afternoon workshop.
toeic_zh: 團隊將在下午的工作坊中腦力激盪尋找解決方案。

en: To go on with a plan or activity.
simple: Let us proceed to the next item.
simple_zh: 我們繼續進行下一項吧。
toeic: Once everyone arrives, we can proceed with the quarterly review.
toeic_zh: 大家到齊後，我們就可以繼續進行季度檢討。

en: To delay something until a later time.
simple: Let's defer the decision until Monday.
simple_zh: 我們把決定延到週一吧。
toeic: The committee decided to defer the vote until the next meeting.
toeic_zh: 委員會決定把表決延到下次會議。

en: A short, informal meeting of a small group.
simple: The team had a quick huddle.
simple_zh: 團隊開了一個簡短的小會。
toeic: We held a ten-minute huddle before the client call.
toeic_zh: 客戶來電前，我們開了十分鐘的小型會議。

en: A step-by-step explanation of a process or plan.
simple_zh: 他為我們做了逐步說明。
toeic: The manager gave a walkthrough of the new schedule system.
toeic_zh: 經理逐步說明了新的排程系統。

en: The official start of a project or event.
toeic: The project kickoff is scheduled for Tuesday morning in Room 4.
toeic_zh: 專案啟動會議排定在週二早上於四號會議室舉行。

en: A set period of time for an activity.
toeic: Please choose a time slot that works for all attendees.
toeic_zh: 請選擇一個所有與會者都方便的時段。

en: To schedule two events for the same time by mistake.
simple_zh: 我有時會重複預約下午的時間。
toeic: Please check the calendar so we do not double-book the conference room.
toeic_zh: 請檢查行事曆，以免重複預約會議室。

en: To cover part of the same time or area.
toeic: The sales meeting may overlap with the training session.
toeic_zh: 業務會議可能與培訓課程時間重疊。

en: Not present at a place or event.
toeic: Two directors were absent from the annual general meeting.
toeic_zh: 有兩位董事缺席年度股東會。

en: Agreed by everyone without exception.
toeic: The board reached a unanimous decision to approve the merger.
toeic_zh: 董事會一致決議通過合併案。

en: More than half of a group.
toeic: A majority of the committee supported the new meeting policy.
toeic_zh: 委員會多數成員支持新的會議政策。

en: To formally accept a plan or idea.
toeic: The committee voted to adopt the revised meeting schedule.
toeic_zh: 委員會投票通過了修訂後的會議時程。

en: To make something shorter in time or length.
toeic: We need to shorten the meeting to thirty minutes.
toeic_zh: 我們需要把會議縮短為三十分鐘。

en: To move an event to a later time.
toeic: Can we push back the deadline review to Thursday?
toeic_zh: 我們可以把截止日期的檢討延到週四嗎？

en: To cancel something that was planned.
toeic: The organizers had to call off the seminar because of the storm.
toeic_zh: 由於暴風雨，主辦單位不得不取消研討會。

en: To bring a meeting or task to an end.
toeic: Let's wrap up the meeting and assign the action items.
toeic_zh: 讓我們結束會議並分配待辦事項。

en: To be behind the planned time.
toeic: I will run late, so please start the meeting without me.
toeic_zh: 我會晚到，請不用等我先開始會議。

en: A meeting held by phone or video with people in different places.
toeic: The quarterly review will be a teleconference for overseas staff.
toeic_zh: 季度檢討會將以電話會議方式讓海外員工參加。

en: Earlier than the planned time.
toeic: The design team finished the prototype ahead of schedule.
toeic_zh: 設計團隊比預定時間提早完成了原型。

en: To move an event to an earlier time.
toeic: Can we bring forward the board meeting to Wednesday morning?
toeic_zh: 我們能把董事會提前到週三早上嗎？

en: to find and hire people for a job
simple_zh: 我們在全球招聘工程師。
toeic: The HR department recruits candidates through various recruitment channels.
toeic_zh: 人力資源部門通過各種招聘渠道招聘候選人。

en: a person applying for a job
simple: Three candidates applied for the position.
simple_zh: 三名候選人申請了該職位。
toeic: All candidates must submit their resumes before the deadline.
toeic_zh: 所有候選人必須在截止日期前提交履歷。

en: a meeting where someone asks questions to evaluate a person for a job
toeic: The interview process includes a phone screening and a face-to-face meeting.
toeic_zh: 面試過程包括電話篩選和面對面會議。

en: an achievement or quality that makes someone suitable for a job
toeic: All candidates must meet the minimum qualifications listed in the job description.
toeic_zh: 所有候選人必須滿足職位描述中列出的最低資格。

en: a document listing someone's work experience and education
toeic: Your resume should highlight relevant experience and achievements.
toeic_zh: 你的履歷應該突出相關經驗和成就。

en: skill and knowledge gained by working in a job
simple: She has five years of experience.
toeic: Candidates with relevant experience in sales are preferred.
toeic_zh: 具有相關銷售經驗的候選人優先考慮。

en: a legal agreement between an employer and employee
toeic: Employees receive a formal employment contract outlining terms and conditions.
toeic_zh: 員工收到概述條款和條件的正式就業合同。

en: additional pay or services provided to employees
simple_zh: 這份工作提供良好的福利。
toeic: Employee benefits include health insurance and a retirement pension plan.
toeic_zh: 員工福利包括健康保險和退休養老金計畫。

en: regular payment for work
toeic: The starting salary for this position is competitive and based on experience.
toeic_zh: 這個職位的起始薪水具有競爭力，並根據經驗而定。

en: advancement to a higher job position
toeic: Employees with strong performance reviews are eligible for promotion within the company.
toeic_zh: 績效評價優異的員工有資格在公司內晉升。

en: to integrate a new employee into the company
simple_zh: 我們快速為新員工入職。
toeic: The HR team onboards new hires with orientation sessions and system access setup.
toeic_zh: 人力資源團隊通過方向課程和系統訪問設置為新員工入職。

en: to remove someone from employment
toeic: Employees may be dismissed for violating company policies or misconduct.
toeic_zh: 違反公司政策或行為不當的員工可能被解僱。

en: a formal request for a job or admission
toeic: Completed applications must include a resume and a cover letter.
toeic_zh: 完整的申請必須包括履歷和求職信。

en: an unfilled job position
simple: There is a vacancy in our team.
simple_zh: 我們的團隊有一個空缺。
toeic: The company announced three job vacancies in the marketing department.
toeic_zh: 公司在市場行銷部門宣布了三個空缺。

en: a public announcement of an available job
toeic: The job posting clearly outlines the responsibilities and required qualifications.
toeic_zh: 職位公告清楚地列出了職責和所需資格。

en: process of reviewing applications to identify qualified candidates
toeic: Initial screening filters candidates based on education and experience.
toeic_zh: 初步篩選根據教育和經驗篩選候選人。

en: to choose the most promising candidates for interviews
toeic: After reviewing applications, the team shortlisted ten candidates for the next round.
toeic_zh: 審查申請後，團隊為下一輪入選了十名候選人。

en: a person whose job is to find and hire new employees
simple_zh: 招聘人員今天給我打電話。
toeic: Our company recruiter visited universities to find top talent for internship programs.
toeic_zh: 我們公司的招聘人員訪問了大學，為實習計畫尋找頂級人才。

en: a recruiter who finds senior-level employees
simple_zh: 獵頭找到了一位首席執行官。
toeic: A headhunter approached him about an executive position at a major corporation.
toeic_zh: 獵頭就一家大公司的執行職位聯繫了他。

en: an initial interview conducted by telephone
simple: I had a phone interview yesterday.
simple_zh: 我昨天進行了電話面試。
toeic: The phone interview is the first step in our recruitment process.
toeic_zh: 電話面試是我們招聘過程的第一步。

en: an interview conducted by multiple interviewers
toeic: In the panel interview, candidates answer questions from managers and team members.
toeic_zh: 在小組面試中，候選人回答來自經理和團隊成員的問題。

en: an award given by a university after completing a course of study
simple: She has a degree in engineering.
toeic: Most applicants for this position have a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.
toeic_zh: 該職位的大多數申請人具有學士學位或同等資格。

en: an official document proving someone has skills in a particular area
toeic: Industry certifications strengthen your resume and improve job prospects.
toeic_zh: 行業認證加強你的履歷並改善就業前景。

en: the ability to do something well
simple_zh: 他具有強大的技術技能。
toeic: The job requires excellent communication skills and proficiency in data analysis.
toeic_zh: 該工作需要優異的溝通技能和數據分析能力。

en: a demonstrated ability to perform tasks
toeic: Core competencies for this role include communication and problem-solving.
toeic_zh: 公司通過定期績效評估來評估員工能力。

en: a qualification or achievement showing someone's ability
simple_zh: 她的證書令人印象深刻。
toeic: Candidates should present relevant credentials such as certifications and awards.
toeic_zh: 候選人應提供相關證書，如認證和獎項。

en: introduction and training for new employees
toeic: New employees attend an orientation program to learn company policies and procedures.
toeic_zh: 新員工參加介紹計畫以了解公司政策和程序。

en: process of introducing new employees to the company
simple: The induction process helps employees adjust.
simple_zh: 入職過程幫助員工適應。
toeic: A comprehensive induction program includes company history, culture, and workplace safety.
toeic_zh: 全面的入職計畫包括公司歷史、文化和工作場所安全。

en: formal assessment of an employee's performance
toeic: The annual appraisal includes feedback on strengths and areas for improvement.
toeic_zh: 年度評估包括對優勢和改進領域的反饋。

en: process of assessing someone's value or performance
simple_zh: 績效評估每年進行兩次。
toeic: Regular evaluations help managers identify employee strengths and development needs.
toeic_zh: 定期評估幫助經理識別員工優勢和發展需求。

en: evaluation of how well an employee does their job
toeic: Performance reviews evaluate work quality, punctuality, and teamwork throughout the year.
toeic_zh: 績效評論評估全年的工作質量、準時性和團隊合作。

en: a job or role in an organization
toeic: The marketing position requires three years of experience and strong analytical skills.
toeic_zh: 市場行銷職位需要三年經驗和強大的分析能力。

en: a specific job or function within an organization
toeic: In this role, you will manage a team of five engineers and oversee project deadlines.
toeic_zh: 在這個角色中，你將管理五名工程師的團隊並監督項目截止日期。

en: a person who works for an organization in exchange for pay
toeic: Full-time employees receive comprehensive benefits and are eligible for advancement opportunities.
toeic_zh: 全職員工獲得全面福利並有資格獲得晉升機會。

en: a person or company that employs people
toeic: Employers must provide a safe and comfortable work environment for all employees.
toeic_zh: 雇主必須為所有員工提供安全舒適的工作環境。

en: working or studying for the normal number of hours per week
toeic: Full-time positions require a commitment of 40 hours per week and include health insurance.
toeic_zh: 全職職位需要每週承諾40小時工作並包括健康保險。

en: working or studying for fewer hours than normal
