toeic: Part-time positions are available for students and those seeking flexible work schedules.
toeic_zh: 兼職職位適用於學生和尋求靈活工作時間的人。

en: lasting or intended to last indefinitely
toeic: The company offers permanent positions to candidates who demonstrate strong performance.
toeic_zh: 公司向表現出色的候選人提供永久職位。

en: payment for work, usually paid hourly or weekly
toeic: Hourly wages are competitive with industry standards and based on experience level.
toeic_zh: 時薪與行業標準相競爭，並根據經驗水平而定。

en: additional payment given for good performance or special occasions
toeic: Performance bonuses are awarded quarterly to employees who exceed their targets.
toeic_zh: 績效獎金按季度授予超出目標的員工。

en: payment based on the percentage of sales
toeic: Sales representatives earn a base salary plus commission on each sale they complete.
toeic_zh: 銷售代表獲得基本薪水加上每筆銷售的傭金。

en: regular payment to a retired person from their employer or the government
toeic: The company pension plan provides retirement income based on years of service.
toeic_zh: 公司養老金計畫根據服務年限提供退休收入。

en: protection against loss or damage through a regular payment
toeic: The company provides comprehensive health insurance coverage for all full-time employees.
toeic_zh: 公司為所有全職員工提供全面的健康保險保範。

en: services for treating and preventing illness
simple_zh: 醫療保健福利包括在內。
toeic: Comprehensive healthcare benefits include dental, vision, and prescription medication coverage.
toeic_zh: 全面的醫療保健福利包括牙科、眼科和處方藥物保險。

en: a sum of money provided for a specific purpose
toeic: Monthly allowances for transportation and meals are provided to field representatives.
toeic_zh: 為外場代表提供月度運輸和膳食津貼。

en: something offered to encourage or motivate someone
simple: The company uses incentives to motivate employees.
simple_zh: 公司使用獎勵來激勵員工。
toeic: Performance incentives include bonuses, stock options, and professional development opportunities.
toeic_zh: 績效獎勵包括獎金、股票期權和專業發展機會。

en: to end an employment relationship
toeic: Employees may be terminated for violation of company policies or unsatisfactory performance.
toeic_zh: 員工可因違反公司政策或績效不滿意而被終止。

en: to stop working permanently, usually at an old age
toeic: Employees can retire at age 65 and receive a full company pension and benefits.
toeic_zh: 員工可以在65歲時退休並獲得全額公司養老金和福利。

en: to dismiss employees due to lack of work or economic reasons
simple: Companies may lay off employees during economic downturns.
toeic: During economic downturns, companies may lay off workers to reduce operating costs.
toeic_zh: 在經濟衰退期間，公司可能會裁員以降低運營成本。

en: to grow or progress in skill and knowledge
toeic: The company is committed to developing employee skills through training and mentorship programs.
toeic_zh: 公司致力於通過培訓和指導計畫來發展員工技能。

en: the place where someone works
toeic: A positive workplace culture encourages collaboration, innovation, and employee satisfaction.
toeic_zh: 積極的工作場所文化鼓勵協作、創新和員工滿意度。

en: a room or building where work is done
simple_zh: 我們的辦公室在市中心。
toeic: The company recently moved to a new office with modern facilities and collaborative work spaces.
toeic_zh: 公司最近搬遷到了一個新辦公室，配備現代設施和協作工作空間。

en: all the people employed in a company or industry
toeic: The company is developing strategies to attract younger talent to its aging workforce.
toeic_zh: 公司正在制定戰略以吸引年輕人才到其老化的勞動力隊伍。

en: to help someone develop skills and abilities
toeic: Experienced mentors coach new employees through ongoing feedback and professional guidance.
toeic_zh: 經驗豐富的導師通過持續反饋和專業指導輔導新員工。

en: an experienced person who guides and advises someone
toeic: A mentor provides guidance and support to help junior employees navigate career advancement.
toeic_zh: 導師提供指導和支持，幫助初級員工尋求職業進步。

en: to be extremely good at doing something
toeic: Employees who excel in their roles are recognized through awards and advancement opportunities.
toeic_zh: 在其角色中表現出色的員工通過獎項和晉升機會獲得認可。

en: exceptionally good or impressive
toeic: Outstanding performance in this quarter exceeded all expectations and contributed to company growth.
toeic_zh: 本季度的傑出績效超越了所有期望並促進了公司增長。

en: meeting requirements or expectations adequately
toeic: Employees with satisfactory performance reviews maintain their current salary and benefits.
toeic_zh: 績效評估令人滿意的員工保持其目前的薪水和福利。

en: extremely good; of high quality
toeic: Employees with excellent ratings on their performance reviews receive priority for promotion.
toeic_zh: 績效評估中獲得優異評分的員工獲得晉升優先權。

en: to perform below expected standards
toeic: Employees who consistently underperform may face performance improvement plans or termination.
toeic_zh: 績效持續不足的員工可能面臨績效改進計畫或終止。

en: investigation of a person's history before employment
toeic: All candidates must pass a background check including criminal history and reference verification.
toeic_zh: 所有候選人必須通過背景檢查，包括犯罪歷史和參考驗證。

en: having the knowledge and ability to do something successfully
simple_zh: 他是一位有能力的工程師。
toeic: A competent workforce with strong technical skills is essential for company success.
toeic_zh: 具有強大技術技能的有能力的勞動力對公司成功至關重要。

en: to adjust to new conditions or circumstances
toeic: The ability to adapt to changing work environments and technologies is increasingly important.
toeic_zh: 適應不斷變化的工作環境和技術的能力變得越來越重要。

en: the action of guiding and influencing others
simple_zh: 她表現出強大的領導力。
toeic: Effective leadership is demonstrated through clear communication, decision-making, and mentoring skills.
toeic_zh: 有效的領導力通過清晰的溝通、決策和指導技能來表現。

en: cooperative effort by a group of people working together
simple_zh: 團隊合作使成功成為可能。
toeic: Strong teamwork and collaboration are essential qualities valued by the company.
toeic_zh: 強大的團隊合作和協作是公司重視的基本品質。

en: discussion aimed at reaching an agreement
toeic: Successful negotiation skills help HR professionals secure better employment terms and benefits.
toeic_zh: 成功的談判技能幫助人力資源專業人士獲得更好的就業條款和福利。

en: process of resolving disagreements between people
toeic: HR specialists trained in conflict resolution help address disputes between employees and management.
toeic_zh: 接受衝突解決培訓的人力資源專家幫助解決員工與管理層之間的爭議。

en: the state of being different and including many types
toeic: Workplace diversity promotes innovation and creativity by bringing different perspectives to the team.
toeic_zh: 工作場所多樣性通過為團隊帶來不同觀點來促進創新和創造力。

en: the practice of including and welcoming all people
simple_zh: 包容是公司的優先事項。
toeic: Inclusion of diverse perspectives strengthens team outcomes.
toeic_zh: 包容性的工作場所文化歡迎多元化員工並提供平等的晉升機會。

en: principles of right and wrong behavior
toeic: Company ethics standards require employees to maintain professional integrity and confidentiality.
toeic_zh: 公司倫理標準要求員工保持專業誠信和保密性。

en: the degree to which something succeeds in producing results
toeic: The effectiveness of training programs is measured through employee performance improvements.
toeic_zh: 培訓計畫的有效性通過員工績效改進來衡量。

en: the quality of being productive and accomplishing tasks
toeic: Employee productivity is tracked through performance metrics and output measurements.
toeic_zh: 員工生產力通過績效指標和產出測量進行追蹤。

en: something accomplished, usually by effort and skill
toeic: Employee achievements are celebrated through awards programs and public recognition events.
toeic_zh: 員工成就通過獎項計畫和公開認可活動而受到慶祝。

en: increase in size, amount, or degree
toeic: Professional growth opportunities include advanced degrees, certifications, and leadership training programs.
toeic_zh: 專業增長機會包括高級學位、認證和領導力培訓計畫。

en: the process of moving forward in position or rank
toeic: Career advancement is achieved through consistent performance, skill development, and leadership demonstration.
toeic_zh: 職業進步通過持續績效、技能發展和領導力表現而實現。

en: the capacity to develop in a specific way or become something
toeic: Identifying and developing employee potential is crucial for building a strong future workforce.
toeic_zh: 識別和發展員工潛力對於建立強大的未來勞動力至關重要。

en: natural skill or ability in a particular area
toeic: Attracting and retaining top talent requires competitive compensation packages and career development opportunities.
toeic_zh: 吸引和留住頂級人才需要有競爭力的薪酬方案和職業發展機會。

en: the act of leaving a job or organization
toeic: Employee departure procedures include exit interviews and knowledge transfer to ensure continuity.
toeic_zh: 員工離職程序包括離職面試和知識轉移以確保連續性。

en: the rate at which employees leave a job or organization
toeic: High employee turnover increases recruitment and training costs for the organization.
toeic_zh: 高員工離職率增加了組織的招聘和培訓成本。

en: the reason or reasons for doing something
toeic: Employee motivation is influenced by compensation, recognition, and opportunities for career development.
toeic_zh: 員工動力受薪酬、認可和職業發展機會的影響。

en: the state of being content or pleased
toeic: Employee satisfaction surveys measure engagement and identify areas for workplace improvements.
toeic_zh: 員工滿意度調查衡量參與度並識別工作場所改進領域。

en: the degree of enthusiasm and commitment to a job
toeic: High employee engagement correlates with better performance, retention, and customer satisfaction.
toeic_zh: 高員工參與與更好的績效、保留和客戶滿意度相關聯。

en: the state of being dedicated to a person or cause
toeic: Employee commitment increases when they see opportunities for growth and feel valued by the organization.
toeic_zh: 當員工看到增長機會並感到受到組織重視時，員工承諾會增加。

en: the competence and skill expected in a professional person
toeic: Maintaining professionalism in all interactions builds trust and credibility with colleagues and clients.
toeic_zh: 在所有互動中保持專業精神與同事和客戶建立信任和信譽。

en: a task or action that someone is required to do
simple: It is your duty to comply.
toeic: Employee duty includes completing assignments on time.
toeic_zh: 員工義務包括完成分配的任務、滿足截止日期和保持專業行為。

en: a commitment or requirement to do something
toeic: Both employers and employees have legal obligations defined in the employment contract and labor laws.
toeic_zh: 雇主和員工在就業合同和勞動法中都有法律義務。

en: to cause someone to suffer a penalty for wrongdoing
toeic: The company punishes violations of workplace conduct policies through warnings or suspension.
toeic_zh: 公司通過警告或暫停來懲罰違反工作場所行為政策的行為。

en: orderly behavior and adherence to rules
simple_zh: 工作場所紀律是必要的。
toeic: Workplace discipline procedures ensure consistent enforcement of company policies and employee conduct standards.
toeic_zh: 工作場所紀律程序確保公司政策和員工行為標準的一致執行。

en: advice that danger or harm may occur
toeic: Written warnings are documented and placed in employee files as part of disciplinary procedures.
toeic_zh: 書面警告被記錄並放入員工文件中作為紀律程序的一部分。

en: temporary removal from a position or activity
simple: Suspension can be a disciplinary measure.
simple_zh: 暫停可以是一項紀律措施。
toeic: Employee suspension without pay is a serious disciplinary action for serious misconduct violations.
toeic_zh: 無薪員工暫停是針對嚴重不當行為違規的嚴肅紀律措施。

en: a formal complaint about unjust treatment
toeic: Employee grievances are formally documented and investigated by HR to ensure fair resolution.
toeic_zh: 員工申訴被正式記錄並由人力資源部調查以確保公平解決。

en: an expression of dissatisfaction about something
toeic: Employee complaints about workplace harassment or discrimination are taken seriously and investigated promptly.
toeic_zh: 關於工作場所騷擾或歧視的員工投訴得到重視並迅速調查。

en: repeated unwanted behavior that causes distress
toeic: Workplace harassment policies strictly prohibit unwanted behavior based on protected characteristics.
toeic_zh: 工作場所騷擾政策嚴格禁止基於受保護特徵的不想要行為。

en: unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people
toeic: Zero-tolerance discrimination policies ensure equal treatment regardless of race, gender, or age.
toeic_zh: 零容忍歧視政策確保不分種族、性別或年齡的平等待遇。

en: an inclination or prejudice for or against something
toeic: Reducing unconscious bias in hiring decisions requires training and structured interview processes.
toeic_zh: 減少招聘決策中的無意識偏見需要培訓和結構化面試流程。

en: educational programs to promote understanding and respect among diverse groups
simple_zh: 多樣性培訓是強制性的。
toeic: Annual diversity training helps employees recognize and address unconscious bias and discrimination.
toeic_zh: 年度多樣性培訓幫助員工識別和解決無意識偏見和歧視。

en: formal training leading to a recognized credential
toeic: HR certification programs provide credentials in recruitment, compensation, and employee relations management.
toeic_zh: 人力資源認證計畫在招聘、薪酬和員工關係管理方面提供證書。

en: work arrangement allowing employees control over when and where they work
toeic: Flexible work arrangements including remote work and flexible hours improve employee satisfaction and retention.
toeic_zh: 靈活的工作安排，包括遠程工作和靈活時間，改善員工滿意度和保留。

en: work performed from a location other than the office
toeic: Remote work policies have expanded to include full-time and part-time options for eligible positions.
toeic_zh: 遠程工作政策已擴展為符合條件職位的全職和兼職選項。

en: work arrangement combining office and remote work
simple_zh: 混合工作現在很受歡迎。
toeic: Many companies adopt hybrid work models allowing employees to split time between office and home.
toeic_zh: 許多公司採用混合工作模式，允許員工在辦公室和家庭之間分配時間。

en: equilibrium between time spent on career and personal life
simple_zh: 工作生活平衡對員工很重要。
toeic: Maintaining work-life balance prevents burnout and improves long-term employee productivity and wellbeing.
toeic_zh: 保持工作生活平衡防止倦怠並改善長期員工生產力和福祉。

en: the state of being in good physical and mental health
toeic: Comprehensive wellness programs include fitness classes, mental health support, and nutrition counseling.
toeic_zh: 全面的健康計畫包括健身課程、心理健康支持和營養諮詢。

en: emotional exhaustion caused by prolonged stress at work
toeic: Employee burnout results from excessive workload and lack of support, leading to decreased productivity.
toeic_zh: 員工職業倦怠源於過度的工作量和缺乏支持，導致生產力下降。

en: techniques to reduce and handle work-related stress
toeic: Effective stress management training helps employees cope with workplace pressures and maintain wellbeing.
toeic_zh: 有效的壓力管理培訓幫助員工應對工作場所壓力並保持福祉。

en: structured program pairing experienced and developing employees
toeic: Structured mentorship programs connect junior employees with senior leaders for guidance and career development.
toeic_zh: 結構化的導師計畫將初級員工與資深領導者連接起來以獲得指導和職業發展。

en: process of identifying and developing future leaders
toeic: Strategic succession planning ensures business continuity by developing internal talent for key leadership roles.
toeic_zh: 戰略繼任規劃通過為關鍵領導職位培養內部人才來確保業務連續性。

en: shared values and beliefs of an organization
toeic: Strong workplace culture fosters collaboration, innovation, and employee loyalty to the organization.
toeic_zh: 強大的工作場所文化促進協作、創新和員工對組織的忠誠。

en: formal system for acknowledging employee achievements
toeic: Employee recognition programs celebrate achievements and reinforce desired company values.
toeic_zh: 員工認可計畫慶祝成就並強化所需的公司價值觀。

en: acknowledgment of someone's achievements or service
toeic: Employee recognition programs celebrate achievements and reinforce desired behaviors and company values.
toeic_zh: 員工認可計畫慶祝成就並強化所需行為和公司價值觀。

en: something given in appreciation for achievement or service
toeic: Performance rewards including bonuses and promotions incentivize employees to achieve company objectives.
toeic_zh: 包括獎金和晉升的績效獎勵激勵員工實現公司目標。

en: total compensation including salary, benefits, and incentives
simple_zh: 有競爭力的薪酬方案吸引人才。
toeic: Comprehensive compensation packages benchmark against industry standards to attract and retain qualified employees.
toeic_zh: 全面的薪酬方案與行業標準進行基準測試以吸引和留住合格的員工。

en: organization that finds and places candidates in jobs
simple: We partner with recruitment agencies for specialized roles.
toeic: Recruitment agencies connect employers with qualified job seekers.
toeic_zh: 第三方招聘機構專門為專業和高級職位尋找合格候選人。

en: event where employers meet with job seekers
simple: We exhibited at the job fair.
toeic: Career job fairs connect employers with hundreds of qualified candidates for various positions.
toeic_zh: 職業招聘會將雇主與數百名合格候選人連接起來以填補各種職位。

en: building relationships for professional purposes
simple: Networking is valuable for career growth.
simple_zh: 聯絡對職業成長很有價值。
toeic: Professional networking through conferences and events expands contacts and career opportunities.
toeic_zh: 通過會議和活動的專業聯絡擴大聯繫和職業機會。

en: professional social media platform for job searching and networking
toeic: LinkedIn is widely used by recruiters to search for candidates and by job seekers to build professional profiles.
toeic_zh: 招聘人員廣泛使用領英搜索候選人，求職者使用領英建立專業資料。

en: letter introducing applicant and expressing interest in a job
toeic: A strong cover letter highlights relevant skills and explains why the candidate is interested in the position.
toeic_zh: 一封強有力的求職信突出了相關技能並解釋了候選人對該職位的興趣原因。

en: collection of work samples showing skills and experience
simple: Bring your portfolio to the interview.
simple_zh: 帶上你的作品集去面試。
toeic: Portfolios of past projects demonstrate technical skills and experience relevant to the applied position.
toeic_zh: 過去項目的作品集展示了與申請職位相關的技術技能和經驗。

en: proposal to give someone a job or position
toeic: Job offers typically include information about salary, benefits, start date, and employment terms.
toeic_zh: 工作邀請通常包括薪水、福利、開始日期和就業條款的信息。

en: trial period to evaluate an employee's suitability for a job
simple: The probation period is three months.
toeic: During the probation period, new employees are evaluated on their skills, work quality, and cultural fit.
toeic_zh: 在試用期間，新員工根據其技能、工作質量和文化契合度進行評估。

en: progression of jobs or positions in a career
toeic: Clear career paths help employees understand advancement opportunities and plan their professional development goals.
toeic_zh: 明確的職業道路幫助員工了解進步機會並規劃其專業發展目標。

en: move to a different position at the same organizational level
simple: A lateral move offers new experience.
simple_zh: 平級調轉提供新的經驗。
toeic: Lateral moves allow employees to gain diverse experience while maintaining their current salary level.
toeic_zh: 平級調轉允許員工在保持當前薪水水平的同時獲得多樣化經驗。

en: expert skill or knowledge in a particular area
simple_zh: 她具有寶貴的專業知識。
toeic: Industry expertise is highly valued in senior positions and specialized technical roles.
toeic_zh: 行業專業知識在高級職位和專業技術職位中受到高度重視。

en: specific knowledge and abilities needed for a particular job
toeic: Continuing to develop technical skills keeps employees competitive in their fields and enhances career prospects.
toeic_zh: 持續發展技術技能使員工在其領域具有競爭力並增強職業前景。

en: personal attributes and interpersonal abilities
toeic: Critical soft skills include communication, teamwork, problem-solving, and adaptability in changing environments.
toeic_zh: 關鍵軟技能包括溝通、團隊合作、解決問題和適應不斷變化環境的能力。

en: ability to analyze and find solutions to problems
toeic: Strong problem-solving skills enable employees to handle workplace challenges independently and efficiently.
toeic_zh: 強大的問題解決技能使員工能夠獨立有效地處理工作場所挑戰。

en: ability to adjust to new conditions or circumstances
toeic: High adaptability helps employees thrive in rapidly changing work environments and economic conditions.
toeic_zh: 高適應性幫助員工在快速變化的工作環境和經濟條件中茁壯成長。

en: ability to recover from difficulties and adapt to change
toeic: Building employee resilience through support programs helps organizations weather challenging business periods.
toeic_zh: 通過支持計畫建立員工韌性幫助組織度過具有挑戰性的業務時期。

en: quality of being trustworthy and dependable
toeic: Employee reliability in meeting deadlines and commitments strengthens team trust and project outcomes.
toeic_zh: 員工在滿足截止日期和承諾方面的可靠性加強了團隊信任和項目成果。

en: independence and freedom to make decisions in one's work
toeic: Giving employees autonomy in decision-making improves engagement and develops leadership capabilities.
toeic_zh: 給員工決策自主權改善參與度並發展領導能力。

en: responsibility and control over one's work
toeic: Encouraging employees to take ownership of projects increases engagement and accountability.
toeic_zh: 鼓勵員工對項目承擔所有權增加參與度和問責。

en: working together willingly to achieve shared objectives
toeic: International cooperation between departments requires cultural sensitivity and clear communication protocols.
toeic_zh: 部門之間的國際合作需要文化敏感性和明確的溝通協議。

en: association of two or more people working together
toeic: Strategic partnerships between organizations expand market reach and combine complementary expertise.
toeic_zh: 組織之間的戰略夥伴關係擴大了市場範圍並結合了互補專業知識。

en: degree to which someone is noticed or known in an organization
toeic: Increasing visibility through presentations and projects showcases skills and accelerates career opportunities.
toeic_zh: 通過演示和項目增加能見度展示技能並加快職業機會。

en: experience of being exposed to something new or unfamiliar
simple: Exposure to different roles is valuable.
simple_zh: 接觸不同角色很有價值。
toeic: Exposure to diverse projects and teams broadens employee perspective and accelerates skill development.
toeic_zh: 接觸多樣化項目和團隊拓寬員工視角並加快技能發展。

en: relationship where an experienced person guides a developing person
simple_zh: 導師關係加快職業增長。
toeic: Strong mentorship relationships provide guidance, encouragement, and opportunities for professional advancement.
toeic_zh: 強大的導師關係提供指導、鼓勵和專業進步的機會。

en: advice or information about what should be done
toeic: Career guidance from senior leaders helps employees navigate organizational structures and plan advancement.
toeic_zh: 來自資深領導者的職業指導幫助員工導航組織結構並規劃進步。

en: help or assistance provided to someone
toeic: Comprehensive employee support programs include counseling, wellness initiatives, and career development resources.
toeic_zh: 全面的員工支持計畫包括諮詢、健康計畫和職業發展資源。

en: help or aid provided to someone
toeic: Technical assistance services help employees resolve IT issues and maximize use of workplace systems.
toeic_zh: 技術協助服務幫助員工解決IT問題並最大化工作場所系統的使用。

en: ongoing exchange of information for continuous improvement
toeic: Regular feedback loops between management and employees ensure alignment and support continuous improvement.
toeic_zh: 管理層和員工之間的定期反饋循環確保一致並支持持續改進。

en: conversation between two or more people
toeic: Regular dialogue between employees and management builds trust and identifies solutions to workplace issues.
toeic_zh: 員工和管理層之間的定期對話建立信任並找到工作場所問題的解決方案。

en: informal talk or exchange between people
simple: Have regular conversations with your manager.
simple_zh: 與你的經理進行定期對話。
toeic: One-on-one conversations between managers and employees create opportunities for feedback and goal alignment.
toeic_zh: 經理和員工之間的一對一對話創造反饋和目標一致的機會。

en: ability to generate new and original ideas
toeic: Supporting employee creativity and experimentation leads to breakthrough solutions and improved processes.
toeic_zh: 支持員工創意和實驗導致突破性解決方案和改進的流程。

en: ability to analyze and evaluate information objectively
toeic: Critical thinking skills enable employees to evaluate complex problems and make informed strategic decisions.
toeic_zh: 批判性思維技能使員工能夠評估複雜問題並做出明智的戰略決策。

en: standard measurement of employee work quality
toeic: Clear performance metrics help employees understand expectations and measure progress.
toeic_zh: 明確的績效指標幫助員工了解期望並衡量進度。

en: process of making something as good or effective as possible
toeic: Continuous optimization of workflows and systems increases employee productivity and organizational effectiveness.
toeic_zh: 工作流程和系統的持續優化提高了員工生產力和組織有效性。

en: process of making something better or more satisfactory
toeic: Employee suggestions for operational improvements are evaluated and implemented when feasible.
toeic_zh: 員工關於運營改進的建議在可行時進行評估和實施。

en: improvement or increase in value or quality
toeic: Career enhancement programs provide training and development opportunities to strengthen employee capabilities.
toeic_zh: 職業增強計畫提供培訓和發展機會以加強員工能力。

en: planned and designed to achieve specific goals
toeic: Strategic workforce planning aligns employee capabilities with organizational objectives and future growth.
toeic_zh: 戰略人力資源規劃將員工能力與組織目標和未來增長相一致。

en: detailed proposal for doing something
toeic: Individual career development plans are created jointly by employees and managers to guide advancement.
toeic_zh: 個人職業發展計畫由員工和經理共同製定以指導進步。

en: specific standards used to judge performance or suitability
toeic: Clear evaluation criteria help employees understand performance expectations and progress measurement.
toeic_zh: 明確的評估標準幫助員工了解績效期望和進度衡量。

en: examination of similarities and differences
toeic: Performance comparisons within teams help identify high performers and development areas for improvement.
toeic_zh: 團隊內的績效比較幫助識別高績效者和改進的發展領域。

en: happening or occurring once a week
toeic: Weekly one-on-one meetings between managers and employees provide opportunities for feedback and support.
toeic_zh: 經理和員工之間的每週一對一會議為反饋和支持提供機會。

en: happening or occurring every day
toeic: Daily stand-up meetings help teams coordinate work, identify obstacles, and maintain forward momentum.
toeic_zh: 每日站會幫助團隊協調工作、識別障礙並保持進展。

en: difficult situation or problem that requires effort
toeic: Taking on challenges develops new skills and competencies.
toeic_zh: 具有挑戰性的項目和分配幫助發展新技能並增加員工參與。

en: favorable situation for advancement or achievement
simple: Career opportunity for growth exists within the company.
toeic: New opportunities for advancement motivate employee retention.
toeic_zh: 技能發展和進步的職業機會是員工保留的關鍵因素。

en: achievement of desired aim or result
toeic: Defining success through clear objectives and metrics helps employees focus efforts and measure achievements.
toeic_zh: 通過明確的目標和指標定義成功幫助員工集中精力並衡量成就。

en: lack of success or inability to achieve a goal
toeic: Treating failures as learning opportunities encourages innovation and reduces fear of taking calculated risks.
toeic_zh: 將失敗視為學習機會鼓勵創新並減少對承擔計算風險的恐懼。

en: action or judgment that is incorrect or misguided
toeic: Psychological safety encourages employees to admit mistakes and learn from them without fear of punishment.
toeic_zh: 心理安全鼓勵員工承認並從錯誤中學習而不害怕懲罰。

en: state of being extremely good or outstanding
toeic: Pursuing excellence requires continuous improvement, high standards, and commitment to quality in all work.
toeic_zh: 追求卓越需要持續改進、高標準和對所有工作質量的承諾。

en: a person who asks for a job
simple: The applicant waits outside the office.
simple_zh: 應徵者在辦公室外等候。
toeic: Every applicant will be contacted within two weeks of the closing date.
toeic_zh: 每位應徵者都會在截止日後兩週內接獲通知。
family: apply (v); application (n); applicant (n); apply for a job 應徵工作

en: a student or new worker who learns a job for a short time
simple: The intern makes coffee for us.
toeic: Our intern will help the team with data entry this summer.
toeic_zh: 我們的實習生今年夏天會協助團隊進行資料輸入。
family: internship (n) 實習; summer intern 暑期實習生; intern (v) 實習

en: having the skills or training needed for a job
toeic: Only qualified candidates will be invited to a second interview.
toeic_zh: 只有符合資格的應徵者才會受邀參加第二次面試。
family: qualify (v); qualification (n); be qualified for 具備……的資格

en: having a lot of skill because you have done something for a long time
simple_zh: 他是一位經驗豐富的司機。
toeic: We are looking for an experienced accountant to join our finance team.
toeic_zh: 我們正在尋找一位有經驗的會計師加入財務團隊。

en: allowed to do or get something because you meet the rules
simple: You are eligible for this prize.
toeic: Staff who have worked here for a year are eligible for paid leave.
toeic_zh: 在此工作滿一年的員工可享有帶薪假。
family: eligibility (n); be eligible for 有……的資格; ineligible (adj)

en: to give someone a higher job in a company
simple: They will promote him next month.
simple_zh: 他們下個月會升他的職。
toeic: The board plans to promote Ms. Lin to regional director.
toeic_zh: 董事會打算將林女士升任為區域總監。
family: promotion (n); be promoted to 被升為; promotional (adj) 促銷的

en: a natural ability to do something well
simple: She has an aptitude for math.
toeic: Applicants must take an aptitude test before the final interview.
toeic_zh: 應徵者在最後面試前必須參加性向測驗。

en: money given to an employee who loses a job
simple: He got severance pay last month.
toeic: Employees laid off by the merger will receive three months of severance pay.
toeic_zh: 因合併而被裁員的員工將領到三個月的資遣費。

en: to reduce the number of employees in a company
simple: The shop will downsize this year.
toeic: The firm decided to downsize its sales department to cut costs.
toeic_zh: 公司決定縮編業務部門以降低成本。

en: the period of time someone holds a job
simple: His tenure here is ten years.
toeic: During her tenure as HR director, staff turnover fell sharply.
toeic_zh: 在她擔任人資主管期間，員工流動率大幅下降。

en: higher rank gained by length of service
simple: He has seniority in our office.
simple_zh: 他在我們辦公室資歷較深。
toeic: Promotions at the company are based on seniority and performance.
toeic_zh: 公司的升遷依據資歷與表現而定。

en: a recommendation of a person for a job
simple: I got this job by referral.
simple_zh: 我是經人推薦得到這份工作的。
toeic: Employees receive a bonus for every successful referral.
toeic_zh: 員工每成功推薦一人即可獲得獎金。

en: able to do something very well
toeic: Candidates should be proficient in spreadsheet software.
toeic_zh: 應徵者應精通試算表軟體。

en: able to speak a language easily and well
toeic: The position requires someone fluent in both English and Japanese.
toeic_zh: 此職位需要英語與日語都流利的人。

en: working for different companies, not one employer
simple_zh: 他做自由接案的設計工作。
toeic: We hired a freelance writer to update the company handbook.
toeic_zh: 我們聘請了一位自由撰稿人來更新公司手冊。

en: the total number of people employed
simple_zh: 我們的員工人數是五十人。
toeic: The board approved a freeze on headcount until next year.
toeic_zh: 董事會批准在明年前凍結人員編制。

en: time off work for a mother after birth
toeic: Employees are entitled to fourteen weeks of paid maternity leave.
toeic_zh: 員工享有十四週的有薪產假。

en: a list of duties for a particular job
toeic: The job description lists the main duties and required skills.
toeic_zh: 職務說明列出了主要職責與所需技能。

en: an organization that protects workers' rights
toeic: Management met with the labor union to discuss working conditions.
toeic_zh: 管理階層與工會會面討論工作條件。

en: a job that is available to apply for
simple: There is a job opening here.
toeic: We have a job opening in the accounting department.
toeic_zh: 我們會計部門有一個職缺。

en: the state of having no job
toeic: The government announced new programs to reduce unemployment.
toeic_zh: 政府宣布了降低失業率的新方案。

en: an increase in the money you earn
simple: I asked for a pay raise.
toeic: She received a pay raise after her excellent performance review.
toeic_zh: 她在優異的考績之後獲得加薪。

en: the official name of someone's position
toeic: Please include your name and job title on the application form.
toeic_zh: 請在申請表上填寫姓名與職稱。

en: the confidence and spirit of a group
toeic: Staff morale dropped after the company announced salary cuts.
toeic_zh: 公司宣布減薪後，員工士氣下降了。

en: a system where workers choose their own hours
toeic: The company introduced flextime to help employees balance work and family.
toeic_zh: 公司引進彈性工時，協助員工兼顧工作與家庭。

en: a move to a lower rank or position
toeic: The manager received a demotion after the project failed.
toeic_zh: 專案失敗後，那位經理被降職了。

en: bad or dishonest behavior at work
simple: Any misconduct can cost you your job.
simple_zh: 不當行為可能讓你丟掉工作。
toeic: He was dismissed for serious misconduct during the audit.
toeic_zh: 他因在查帳期間的嚴重不當行為而被解雇。

en: a period of learning a skill while working
simple: He began an apprenticeship at sixteen.
toeic: The factory offers a two-year apprenticeship for young technicians.
toeic_zh: 工廠為年輕技術人員提供為期兩年的學徒訓練。

en: able to speak two languages
simple: She is bilingual in two languages.
toeic: We are seeking a bilingual receptionist for our Taipei office.
toeic_zh: 我們正在為台北辦公室徵求一位雙語櫃檯人員。

en: the state of not being at work
toeic: Three days of unexplained absence may lead to disciplinary action.
toeic_zh: 無故缺勤三天可能導致懲處。

en: a record of hours an employee has worked
simple_zh: 今天請填好你的工時表。
toeic: Please submit your timesheet to payroll by Friday afternoon.
toeic_zh: 請在週五下午前將工時表交給薪資部門。

en: not having enough workers
toeic: The call center is understaffed during the holiday season.
toeic_zh: 客服中心在假期期間人手不足。

en: to pay another company to do work for you
toeic: The firm chose to outsource its payroll processing to a specialist.
toeic_zh: 公司選擇將薪資處理外包給專業業者。

en: a new offer made in reply to an offer
toeic: The candidate made a counteroffer asking for a higher salary.
toeic_zh: 該應徵者提出還價，要求更高的薪資。

en: the act of moving to a new place
toeic: The company will cover all relocation costs for the new manager.
toeic_zh: 公司將負擔新經理的所有搬遷費用。

en: to check someone carefully before hiring
simple_zh: 他們仔細審查每位新員工。
toeic: The agency will vet all candidates before sending their files to us.
toeic_zh: 仲介公司會在把檔案寄給我們之前審查所有應徵者。

en: a document sent electronically
toeic: Fax service is available 24/7.
toeic_zh: 傳真服務24/7可用。

en: a device for copying documents
toeic: Scanners produce high-quality images.
toeic_zh: 掃描器產生高質量圖像。

en: a device for producing printed documents
simple: The printer is out of paper.
toeic: Business centers provide printers.
toeic_zh: 商務中心提供印表機。

en: a device for duplicating documents
simple: Use the copy machine for forms.
toeic: Copy machines are available in lobbies.
toeic_zh: 大廳提供複印機。

en: a table for working or writing
toeic: Hotel desks have computer access.
toeic_zh: 飯店辦公桌有電腦訪問權限。

en: a space for group discussions
toeic: Meeting rooms have AV equipment.
toeic_zh: 會議室配備視聽設備。

en: tools for presentations and media
toeic: Audiovisual equipment requires technical support.
toeic_zh: 視聽設備需要技術支持。

en: a device that displays images
simple: Set up the projector for slides.
toeic: Projectors support multiple input formats.
toeic_zh: 投影儀支持多種輸入格式。

en: a display surface for images
toeic: Large screens improve visibility.
toeic_zh: 大屏幕提高了可視性。

en: a device for recording sound
toeic: Microphones amplify speaker voices.
toeic_zh: 麥克風放大演講者的聲音。

en: a blank surface for writing
toeic: Whiteboards facilitate brainstorming.
toeic_zh: 白板促進腦力激盪。

en: paper pads on a stand for presentations
simple: Present data on the flip chart.
simple_zh: 在翻轉圖表上展示數據。
toeic: Flip charts organize presentation points.
toeic_zh: 翻轉圖表組織演示要點。

en: printed materials distributed to attendees
toeic: Handouts summarize key information.
toeic_zh: 講義總結關鍵信息。

en: a product or result to be delivered
simple_zh: 按時完成所有可交付物。
toeic: Deliverables define project scope.
toeic_zh: 可交付物定義項目範圍。

en: a supplier of goods or services
toeic: Vendor agreements should be clear.
toeic_zh: 供應商協議應該清晰。

en: a unique identifier for an invoice
toeic: Invoice numbers track payments.
toeic_zh: 發票編號跟蹤付款。

en: an identifier for a receipt
toeic: Receipt numbers ensure accurate tracking.
toeic_zh: 收據編號確保準確跟蹤。

en: a code for identifying documents
simple: Use the reference number for tracking.
simple_zh: 使用參考編號進行追蹤。
toeic: Reference numbers streamline communication.
toeic_zh: 參考編號簡化溝通。

en: a code identifying a reservation
toeic: Booking references are required at check-in.
toeic_zh: 辦理登記時需要預訂參考。

en: an identifier for a planned journey
toeic: Itinerary numbers organize trip details.
toeic_zh: 行程號碼組織旅程詳情。

en: a code verifying a booking
toeic: Confirmation codes prevent double bookings.
toeic_zh: 確認代碼防止重複預訂。

en: a code for locating shipments
toeic: Tracking numbers update delivery status.
toeic_zh: 追蹤編號更新交付狀態。

zh: 乘客姓名記錄；旅客名單
en: Passenger Name Record for flights
simple: Your PNR is in the confirmation.
toeic: PNRs contain flight and payment details.
toeic_zh: PNR包含班機和付款詳情。

en: the planned path of a journey
toeic: Complex routings may have connections.
toeic_zh: 複雜的路線可能有轉接。

en: one flight leg of a journey
simple_zh: 每個航段是單獨的預訂。
toeic: Multi-segment trips allow exploration.
toeic_zh: 多航段旅行允許探索。

en: a journey returning to starting point
simple: Book a round trip for savings.
simple_zh: 預訂往返旅行以節省費用。
toeic: Round trip fares are often cheaper.
toeic_zh: 往返票價通常較便宜。

en: a round trip with different start/end
toeic: Open jaw itineraries are cost-effective.
toeic_zh: 開口票行程具有成本效益。

en: an extended stop during a journey
toeic: Stopovers often avoid extra charges.
toeic_zh: 停留通常避免額外費用。

en: a person who travels frequently by air
simple: I'm a frequent flyer with miles.
toeic: Frequent flyer benefits include upgrades.
toeic_zh: 常客權益包括升級。

en: a rewards system for regular customers
toeic: Loyalty programs offer exclusive benefits.
toeic_zh: 忠誠度計劃提供獨家優惠。

en: rewards earned from purchases
toeic: Points can be redeemed for upgrades.
toeic_zh: 點數可兌換升級。

en: distance-based rewards currency
simple_zh: 積累里程以獲得免費班機。
toeic: Miles expire after several years.
toeic_zh: 里程在幾年後過期。

en: membership level in rewards program
toeic: Higher tier status unlocks premium features.
toeic_zh: 更高的等級狀態解鎖高級功能。

en: special benefits or advantages
toeic: Premium members receive valuable perks.
toeic_zh: 高級會員獲得有價值的福利。

en: a person who travels in a vehicle but does not drive it
simple: The passenger sat by the window.
toeic: Each passenger must show a valid ID at the check-in counter.
toeic_zh: 每位乘客都必須在報到櫃檯出示有效的身分證件。
family: passenger seat; passenger list; airline passenger

en: the money you pay to travel by bus, train or plane
toeic: The airline fare includes one checked bag and a meal.
toeic_zh: 這張機票票價包含一件託運行李和一份餐點。
family: air fare; bus fare; full fare / half fare; fare increase

en: inside one country, not international
toeic: Domestic flights are usually cheaper than overseas ones.
toeic_zh: 國內班機通常比國外航班便宜。

en: to travel regularly between home and work
simple: I commute to work by train.
toeic: Many employees commute to the downtown office by subway.
toeic_zh: 許多員工搭地鐵通勤到市中心的辦公室。

en: between or involving different countries
toeic: Our international clients will arrive in Taipei on Friday.
toeic_zh: 我們的國際客戶將於週五抵達台北。

en: a bus or van that makes regular short trips between two places
toeic: A free shuttle runs between the airport and the hotel every thirty minutes.
toeic_zh: 免費接駁車每三十分鐘往返於機場與飯店之間。
family: shuttle bus / service; airport shuttle; shuttle (v) 往返運送

en: the bags and cases that a traveler carries
toeic: Checked baggage must not weigh more than twenty-three kilograms.
toeic_zh: 託運行李的重量不得超過二十三公斤。
family: 不可數名詞；baggage claim; baggage allowance; checked baggage

en: acceptable by law or rules; not out of date
toeic: Please make sure your passport is valid for at least six months.
toeic_zh: 請確認您的護照至少還有六個月的效期。
family: validity (n); validate (v); valid passport / ticket / ID

en: to ask for a seat, room or table to be kept for you
simple: I want to reserve a table.
toeic: Please reserve two seats on the morning flight to Osaka.
toeic_zh: 請預訂前往大阪的早班機兩個座位。
family: reservation (n); reserve a room / seat / table; reserved (adj)

en: going to a place and coming back again
toeic: A round-trip ticket to Seattle costs less when booked early.
toeic_zh: 提早訂購的西雅圖來回機票比較便宜。
family: round-trip ticket / fare / flight; round trip (n)

en: The time or process of leaving a hotel.
simple_zh: 我們的退房時間是中午。
toeic: Late check-out can be arranged for an additional fee at the front desk.
toeic_zh: 延後退房可至櫃檯加收費用安排。

en: Going to a place only, not coming back.
toeic: The one-way fare to Singapore is cheaper if booked a month early.
toeic_zh: 若提前一個月訂票，飛往新加坡的單程票價較便宜。

en: A flight you take after landing from another flight.
simple: My connecting flight leaves at noon.
simple_zh: 我的轉機航班中午起飛。
toeic: Please allow at least two hours between your arrival and your connecting flight.
toeic_zh: 抵達時間與轉機航班之間請至少預留兩小時。

en: To accept more reservations than there are seats or rooms.
simple: The hotel may overbook its rooms.
toeic: Airlines often overbook flights because some passengers fail to show up.
toeic_zh: 航空公司常會超賣機位，因為有些乘客不會出現。

en: A more comfortable airline seat class for working travelers.
toeic: Executives are entitled to business class on flights longer than six hours.
toeic_zh: 高階主管搭乘超過六小時的航班時可享有商務艙。

en: Visiting famous places as a tourist.
toeic: After the seminar, the clients went sightseeing around the old town.
toeic_zh: 研討會後，客戶們到舊城區四處觀光。

en: A short trip taken for pleasure, often in a group.
toeic: The conference fee includes an optional excursion to the nearby vineyard.
toeic_zh: 會議費用包含一項前往附近葡萄園的自選旅遊行程。

en: To get on a ship or plane, or start a journey.
toeic: Passengers should embark at Gate 12 thirty minutes before departure.
toeic_zh: 乘客應在起飛前三十分鐘於十二號登機門登機。

en: To get off a ship or plane.
toeic: Passengers must disembark through the front door and proceed to customs.
toeic_zh: 乘客須由前門下機，並前往海關。

en: A long strip where planes take off and land.
simple: The plane is on the runway.
toeic: Flights were delayed because heavy fog covered the runway this morning.
toeic_zh: 由於今早濃霧籠罩跑道，航班因此延誤。

en: Sold without tax, usually at airports.
toeic: Travelers may buy duty-free goods up to a limit set by customs.
toeic_zh: 旅客可購買免稅商品，但以海關規定的額度為限。

en: A group of people sent to represent a company or country.
simple: A delegation came to our office.
simple_zh: 一個代表團來到我們辦公室。
toeic: A delegation from Seoul will visit our factory next Tuesday.
toeic_zh: 一個來自首爾的代表團將於下週二參訪我們的工廠。

en: An overnight flight that arrives early in the morning.
toeic: I booked the red-eye to Chicago so I could attend the morning meeting.
toeic_zh: 我訂了飛往芝加哥的夜間航班，以便出席早上的會議。

en: A small item you keep to remember a trip.
simple: I bought a souvenir for Mom.
simple_zh: 我幫媽媽買了一份紀念品。
toeic: The hotel gift shop sells souvenirs made by local artists.
toeic_zh: 飯店禮品店販售當地藝術家製作的紀念品。

en: A thin printed booklet with information about a product or place.
simple_zh: 她拿了一本旅遊小冊子。
toeic: Please send me a brochure describing your corporate travel packages.
toeic_zh: 請寄給我一份介紹貴公司商務旅遊套裝行程的宣傳小冊。

en: A long journey, especially by sea or in space.
toeic: The cargo company reduced the length of each voyage by choosing a faster route.
toeic_zh: 貨運公司選擇更快的航線，縮短了每趟航程的時間。

en: A period of isolation to stop disease from spreading.
simple: He is in quarantine at home.
toeic: Travelers from affected areas must complete a seven-day quarantine upon arrival.
toeic_zh: 來自疫區的旅客抵達後須完成為期七天的隔離。

en: A longer route used to avoid a problem on the road.
toeic: Road construction forced the shuttle to take a detour to the airport.
toeic_zh: 道路施工迫使接駁車繞道前往機場。

en: A person paid to drive someone else's car.
toeic: The hotel will arrange a chauffeur to meet our guests at the airport.
toeic_zh: 飯店將安排專職司機到機場接待我們的貴賓。

en: A passenger or state waiting for a seat to open.
toeic: Since the flight was full, he flew on standby after missing his connection.
toeic_zh: 由於班機客滿，他在錯過轉機後以候補身分搭機。

en: A list of people waiting for a place to become free.
toeic: The seminar is full, but you can join the waitlist for cancellations.
toeic_zh: 研討會已額滿，但您可以登記候補名單等待取消名額。

en: A person who books a place but does not come.
toeic: The hotel charges a full night's fee for any no-show without notice.
toeic_zh: 對於未事先通知卻沒有出現的客人，飯店會收取一晚的全額費用。

en: Too crowded or full of traffic.
toeic: Leave early because the highway to the airport is often congested.
toeic_zh: 請提早出發，因為前往機場的高速公路常常壅塞。

en: A place where people go for a holiday.
simple: We stayed at a beach resort.
simple_zh: 我們住在海邊的度假村。
toeic: The company will hold its annual retreat at a mountain resort.
toeic_zh: 公司將在一處山區度假村舉辦年度員工旅遊。

en: A well-known building or place that is easy to recognize.
simple: The tower is a famous landmark.
toeic: Our office is near a landmark, so taxi drivers can find it easily.
toeic_zh: 我們辦公室靠近一處地標，所以計程車司機很容易找到。

en: The busiest time of year for travel or business.
toeic: Hotel rates rise sharply during peak season, so please book early.
toeic_zh: 旺季期間飯店房價大幅上漲，所以請提早訂房。

en: To move to a new place to live or work.
toeic: The firm offered to relocate her family when she accepted the overseas post.
toeic_zh: 當她接受海外職位時，公司提出協助她的家人搬遷。

en: exchange of goods for money
toeic: Our Q3 sales exceeded the quarterly target.
toeic_zh: 我們第三季度的銷售超過了季度目標。

en: to exchange something for money
toeic: The company sells office furniture to corporate clients.
toeic_zh: 該公司向企業客戶銷售辦公傢俱。

en: person who buys goods or services
toeic: Our customer satisfaction rate is above 95 percent.
toeic_zh: 我們的顧客滿意度超過95%。

en: demand for goods and services in a specific area
toeic: Our market share increased from 12 to 18 percent this year.
toeic_zh: 今年我們的市場佔有率從12%增至18%。

en: promotion of products to customers
simple_zh: 市場營銷對增長至關重要。
toeic: The marketing team launched a new campaign last week.
toeic_zh: 市場營銷團隊上週推出了新活動。

en: to make something known publicly
simple_zh: 我們在社交媒體上打廣告。
toeic: The company advertised the new product across multiple channels.
toeic_zh: 該公司在多個渠道宣傳新產品。

en: reduction in the regular price of something
toeic: Customers can receive a discount if they purchase in bulk.
toeic_zh: 如果客戶批量購買，可以獲得折扣。

en: amount of money for which something is sold
toeic: We will adjust prices based on market competition.
toeic_zh: 我們將根據市場競爭調整價格。

en: thing manufactured or produced for sale
toeic: The new product line features five distinct product categories.
toeic_zh: 新產品線包含五個不同的產品類別。

en: coordinated series of actions to achieve a goal
toeic: Our advertising campaign reached 2 million people online.
toeic_zh: 我們的廣告活動在線上吸引了200萬人。

en: name or symbol identifying a company's products
toeic: The brand recognition increased significantly after the rebrand.
toeic_zh: 品牌在重新品牌化後的認知度明顯提高。

en: person or company competing in the same market
simple_zh: 我們有強大的競爭對手。
toeic: Our main competitors offer similar products at lower prices.
toeic_zh: 我們的主要競爭對手以更低的價格提供類似產品。

en: business agreement or transaction
simple_zh: 我們達成了一筆很好的交易。
toeic: The company announced a major deal worth $50 million.
toeic_zh: 該公司宣佈了一筆價值5,000萬美元的重大交易。

en: to discuss terms to reach an agreement
toeic: Sales teams negotiate contracts with corporate clients.
toeic_zh: 銷售團隊與企業客戶協商合同。

en: person or organization that purchases goods
toeic: The bulk buyer received a special discount from our sales team.
toeic_zh: 批量購買者從我們的銷售團隊獲得了特別折扣。

en: person or company that sells goods or services
simple: The seller must deliver on time.
toeic: Our seller reputation is excellent across all platforms.
toeic_zh: 我們的賣家信譽在所有平台上都很好。

en: to buy something
toeic: The company purchased new equipment to increase production.
toeic_zh: 該公司購買了新設備以增加產量。

en: business deal or exchange of money and goods
toeic: Payment processing transactions increased by 300% this year.
toeic_zh: 今年支付處理交易增加了300%。

en: persuasive presentation of an idea or product
toeic: Our sales pitch emphasizes quality and customer service.
toeic_zh: 我們的銷售說辭強調質量和客戶服務。

en: potential customer or opportunity for a sale
toeic: The sales team followed up with 150 qualified leads.
toeic_zh: 銷售團隊跟進了150條符合資格的線索。

en: potential customer or future possibility
simple_zh: 這個潛在客戶看起來很有前景。
toeic: Our sales team will contact every prospect within one week.
toeic_zh: 我們的銷售團隊將在一週內聯繫每一位潛在客戶。

en: changing a potential customer into a paying customer
toeic: Our conversion rate from inquiry to sale is approximately 15%.
toeic_zh: 我們的詢問轉化為銷售的轉化率約為15%。

en: difference between cost and selling price
toeic: We need to maintain a minimum 30% gross margin.
toeic_zh: 我們需要保持至少30%的毛利率。

en: profit or benefit gained from investment
toeic: The marketing campaign delivered a 300% return on investment.
toeic_zh: 市場營銷活動帶來了300%的投資回報。

en: detailed examination of data to understand patterns
toeic: Our analytics team tracks customer behavior across all platforms.
toeic_zh: 我們的分析團隊追蹤所有平台上的客戶行為。

en: desire or need for a product or service
toeic: Market demand for our products continues to increase quarterly.
toeic_zh: 市場對我們產品的需求每季度都在增加。

en: amount of goods available for sale
toeic: Supply chain disruptions affected product availability this month.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈中斷影響了本月的產品可用性。

en: stock of goods held for sale or use
toeic: Our inventory management system tracks all products in real time.
toeic_zh: 我們的庫存管理系統實時追蹤所有產品。

en: goods kept for supply or available shares in a company
toeic: The company's stock price increased after strong sales announcements.
toeic_zh: 公司股價在宣佈強勁銷售後上漲。

en: process of supplying goods to customers
toeic: Our distribution network covers all major cities in the region.
toeic_zh: 我們的分銷網絡覆蓋該地區的所有主要城市。

en: route or method through which goods reach customers
simple_zh: 我們使用多個銷售渠道。
toeic: The company expanded into e-commerce channels this quarter.
toeic_zh: 該公司本季度擴展到電子商務渠道。

en: business that provides goods to another company
toeic: We maintain contracts with three major suppliers for raw materials.
toeic_zh: 我們與三家主要供應商簽訂了原材料合同。

en: company that produces goods using machines
toeic: Our manufacturer produces 10,000 units daily for distribution.
toeic_zh: 我們的製造商每天生產10,000件用於分銷。

en: person authorized to act on behalf of another
toeic: Our sales agents are trained in product knowledge and customer service.
toeic_zh: 我們的銷售代理接受了產品知識和客戶服務培訓。

en: person who arranges business transactions between parties
simple: Hire a broker for this deal.
toeic: The real estate broker negotiated favorable terms for the purchase.
toeic_zh: 房地產經紀人為購買談判了有利的條款。

en: person or company that buys and sells goods
toeic: The merchant displayed new inventory in the storefront.
toeic_zh: 商人在店面展示了新庫存。

en: person or company that buys and sells goods or securities
simple_zh: 交易商做出了明智的決定。
toeic: The grain trader negotiated contracts for the harvest season.
toeic_zh: 穀物交易商為收穫季節談判合同。

en: buying and selling of goods and services
toeic: Digital commerce now represents 40% of total retail transactions.
toeic_zh: 數字商務現在代表零售交易總額的40%。

en: guarantee that a product meets certain standards
toeic: Our products come with a two-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
toeic_zh: 我們的產品附帶針對製造缺陷的兩年保修。

en: promise that a product meets certain standards
toeic: The guarantee covers all manufacturing defects for five years.
toeic_zh: 保證涵蓋五年內所有製造缺陷。

en: set of questions to gather opinions or information
toeic: Our annual survey revealed that 92% of customers are satisfied.
toeic_zh: 我們的年度調查顯示92%的客戶感到滿意。

en: set of printed questions for gathering information
toeic: The questionnaire asks about customer satisfaction and product quality.
toeic_zh: 問卷詢問有關客戶滿意度和產品質量。

en: detailed study of something to discover information
toeic: Market research showed strong demand for eco-friendly products.
toeic_zh: 市場調研顯示對環保產品的強勁需求。

en: showing how something works or is done
toeic: The product demonstration convinced many customers to make purchases.
toeic_zh: 產品演示說服了許多客戶進行購買。

en: small amount of a product for testing or demonstration
toeic: Customers can request a sample of our product before purchasing.
toeic_zh: 客戶可以在購買前申請我們產品的樣品。

en: test of a product before deciding to buy
simple_zh: 嘗試我們的免費試用期。
toeic: New customers receive a 30-day free trial of our premium service.
toeic_zh: 新客戶可以獲得30天免費試用我們的高級服務。

en: try something to see if it works
toeic: We test all products thoroughly before release to customers.
toeic_zh: 我們在向客戶發布前徹底測試所有產品。

en: judgment or evaluation of value or worth
toeic: Our assessment of market conditions guided our pricing strategy.
toeic_zh: 我們對市場條件的評估指導了我們的定價策略。

en: classification or evaluation score given to something
toeic: The product rating improved from 3.2 to 4.5 stars after improvements.
toeic_zh: 改進後產品評分從3.2星提高到4.5星。

en: statement of praise or approval from a satisfied customer
toeic: Customer testimonials highlight our excellent service quality.
toeic_zh: 客戶證詞突出了我們優質的服務品質。

en: public perception of quality and reliability
toeic: Our company reputation for quality service attracts many new customers.
toeic_zh: 我們公司質量服務的聲譽吸引了許多新客戶。

en: quality of being trusted or believed
toeic: Our company's credibility increased after receiving industry awards.
toeic_zh: 獲得行業獎項後，我們公司的信任度提高了。

en: faithful support or devotion to a brand or company
toeic: Our loyalty program retains 85% of customers year-over-year.
toeic_zh: 我們的忠誠度計劃年度客戶保留率為85%。

en: process of obtaining or acquiring something
toeic: Our acquisition cost per customer decreased to $25 this quarter.
toeic_zh: 本季度我們每位客戶的獲得成本降至$25。

en: rate at which customers stop using a service
toeic: Our monthly customer churn rate decreased from 8% to 5%.
toeic_zh: 我們的月度客戶流失率從8%下降到5%。

en: length of time something or someone lives or lasts
toeic: Customer lifetime value averages $5,000 for our top tier members.
toeic_zh: 我們頂級成員的客戶終身價值平均為$5,000。

en: action or influence of people or things on each other
toeic: Customer interactions across social media are monitored daily.
toeic_zh: 每天監控跨社交媒體的客戶互動。

en: effort to establish relationships with a target audience
toeic: Community outreach programs increased brand awareness significantly.
toeic_zh: 社區外展計劃大幅提高了品牌知名度。

en: process of setting the cost of products or services
toeic: Our competitive pricing strategy attracts price-sensitive customers.
toeic_zh: 我們的競爭定價策略吸引對價格敏感的客戶。

en: pricing method where markup is added to cost
toeic: We employ a cost-plus pricing model with 40% markup.
toeic_zh: 我們採用成本加成定價模式，加價40%。

en: pricing strategy using low prices to enter market
toeic: Our penetration pricing attracted many new customers this quarter.
toeic_zh: 我們的滲透定價本季度吸引了許多新客戶。

en: pricing strategy using high prices at launch
toeic: We used skimming pricing for the premium product launch.
toeic_zh: 我們為高級產品推出採用了撇脂定價。

en: constantly changing or adjusting based on conditions
toeic: Our dynamic pricing algorithm adjusts prices based on demand.
toeic_zh: 我們的動態定價算法根據需求調整價格。

en: unchanging or established at a set level
toeic: Our fixed pricing remains constant throughout the year.
toeic_zh: 我們的固定價格全年保持不變。

en: involving or related to competition
toeic: Our competitive advantage lies in superior customer service.
toeic_zh: 我們的競爭優勢在於優質的客戶服務。

en: pricing based on perceived value to customer
toeic: Our value-based pricing strategy emphasizes quality benefits.
toeic_zh: 我們基於價值的定價策略強調質量優勢。

en: related to mental processes and behavior
toeic: Psychological pricing uses price points like $9.99 for perception.
toeic_zh: 心理定價使用$9.99等價位點進行感知。

en: starting point or reference used in negotiations
toeic: Our anchor price influences customer perception of value.
toeic_zh: 我們的錨點價格影響客戶對價值的感知。

en: large quantity or volume purchase
toeic: Our bulk pricing offers significant savings for large orders.
toeic_zh: 我們的批量定價為大訂單提供顯著節省。

en: amount or quantity of goods sold
toeic: Our sales volume increased by 40% compared to last year.
toeic_zh: 與去年相比，我們的銷售量增加了40%。

en: lowest amount or level allowed
toeic: Our minimum order quantity is 100 units for wholesale.
toeic_zh: 我們的批發最少訂單量為100件。

en: highest amount or level allowed
toeic: There is no maximum purchase limit for our premium members.
toeic_zh: 我們的高級成員沒有購買限制。

en: level or point at which something begins
toeic: Orders exceeding the threshold receive automatic discounts.
toeic_zh: 超過門檻的訂單自動獲得折扣。

en: point at which revenue equals costs
toeic: We reach breakeven after selling 500 units monthly.
toeic_zh: 我們每月銷售500件後達到盈虧平衡。

en: total amount before deductions
toeic: Our gross margin this quarter is 45% before overhead costs.
toeic_zh: 本季度我們的毛利率在開銷前為45%。

en: remaining after all deductions
toeic: Our net profit margin increased to 25% this fiscal year.
toeic_zh: 本財年我們的淨利潤率提高到25%。

en: amount each product contributes to covering fixed costs
toeic: Each product's contribution margin helps cover fixed costs.
toeic_zh: 每件產品的貢獻邊際幫助覆蓋固定成本。

en: ongoing costs not directly tied to production
toeic: Reducing overhead expenses will improve our profit margin.
toeic_zh: 降低開銷支出將改進我們的利潤率。

en: immediate or firsthand connection
toeic: Direct production costs are easily traceable to each product.
toeic_zh: 直接生產成本可以輕易追溯到每件產品。

en: not direct or obvious connection
toeic: Indirect costs include rent, utilities, and administrative salaries.
toeic_zh: 間接成本包括租金、水電和行政工資。

en: related to regular business activities
toeic: Operating expenses include salaries, rent, and utilities.
toeic_zh: 營運開支包括工資、租金和水電費。

en: money or assets used to start or expand business
toeic: The company invested $2 million in capital for expansion.
toeic_zh: 該公司投資了200萬美元的資本用於擴展。

en: amount of money spent on something
toeic: Annual marketing expenditure reached $500,000 this year.
toeic_zh: 今年年度市場營銷支出達到50萬美元。

en: time needed to recover investment
toeic: The marketing campaign has a payback period of 6 months.
toeic_zh: 市場營銷活動的回本期限是6個月。

en: annualized return rate of an investment
toeic: Our project IRR exceeded 25% annually.
toeic_zh: 我們的項目IRR年度超過25%。

en: portion or percentage of market
toeic: Our market share grew from 8% to 12% this year.
toeic_zh: 我們的市場佔有率今年從8%增長到12%。

en: physical dimensions or overall extent
toeic: The total addressable market size is $500 million.
toeic_zh: 總可尋址市場規模為5億美元。

en: condition or circumstance favorable to success
toeic: Our technological advantage gives us a competitive edge.
toeic_zh: 我們的技術優勢給了我們競爭優勢。

en: plan or suggestion presented to someone
toeic: Our unique value proposition emphasizes quality and innovation.
toeic_zh: 我們獨特的價值主張強調質量和創新。

en: making something distinct or different
toeic: Our differentiation strategy focuses on superior customer service.
toeic_zh: 我們的差異化戰略專注於優質客戶服務。

en: way a company presents itself in market
toeic: Our market positioning targets affluent consumers seeking premium quality.
toeic_zh: 我們的市場定位針對尋求高級質量的富裕消費者。

en: key communication points about a product
toeic: Our marketing messaging emphasizes innovation and sustainability.
toeic_zh: 我們的市場營銷信息強調創新和可持續性。

en: estimate or calculation for future
toeic: Our revenue projections for next year are $10 million.
toeic_zh: 我們明年的收入預計為1,000萬美元。

en: series of processes or customers in various stages
toeic: Our sales pipeline contains $5 million in qualified opportunities.
toeic_zh: 我們的銷售漏斗包含500萬美元的符合資格的機會。

en: process showing how customers progress through sales stages
toeic: Our marketing funnel converts 15% of visitors to customers.
toeic_zh: 我們的市場營銷漏斗將15%的訪客轉化為客戶。

en: knowledge or understanding of something
toeic: Our brand awareness campaign reached 2 million people.
toeic_zh: 我們的品牌認知活動接觸了200萬人。

en: stage where customers evaluate options
simple_zh: 將潛在客戶轉移到考慮階段。
toeic: During the consideration stage, customers compare our products.
toeic_zh: 在考慮階段，客戶比較我們的產品。

en: deed or process of doing something
toeic: Our call-to-action buttons drive immediate customer action.
toeic_zh: 我們的行動呼籲按鈕推動立即客戶行動。

en: happening again or continuing multiple times
toeic: Our loyalty program encourages repeat purchases.
toeic_zh: 我們的忠誠度計劃鼓勵重複購買。

en: selling a more expensive or better version
toeic: Our sales team upsells customers to premium packages.
toeic_zh: 我們的銷售團隊向客戶向上銷售高級套餐。

en: selling complementary or related products
toeic: Our system recommends cross-sell products to customers.
toeic_zh: 我們的系統向客戶推薦交叉銷售產品。

en: combination of products sold together
toeic: Our product bundles offer better value than individual purchases.
toeic_zh: 我們的產品捆綁提供了比單獨購買更好的價值。

en: combination of features or products offered
toeic: Our premium package includes priority support.
toeic_zh: 我們的高級套餐包括優先支持。

en: organized system or scheme with specific goals
toeic: Our membership program has 50,000 active members.
toeic_zh: 我們的會員計劃有50,000名活躍成員。

en: status of being a member of organization
toeic: Our VIP membership includes exclusive discounts.
toeic_zh: 我們的VIP會籍包括獨家折扣。

en: regular payment for continued access or service
toeic: Our subscription service offers monthly billing options.
toeic_zh: 我們的訂閱服務提供月度帳單選項。

en: level or rank in a system
toeic: Our tiered pricing structure offers options for all budgets.
toeic_zh: 我們的分級定價結構為所有預算提供選項。

en: luxurious or exceptionally high quality
toeic: Our deluxe package includes all premium features.
toeic_zh: 我們的豪華套餐包括所有高級功能。

en: designed for beginners or lowest price point
toeic: Our entry-level product attracts first-time buyers.
toeic_zh: 我們的入門級產品吸引首次購買者。

en: inexpensive or budget-friendly version
toeic: Our economy tier appeals to price-conscious consumers.
toeic_zh: 我們的經濟等級吸引對價格敏感的消費者。

en: high quality at premium price
toeic: Our luxury line targets affluent customers worldwide.
toeic_zh: 我們的奢華系列針對全球富裕客戶。

en: only available to certain people or members
toeic: Exclusive members receive early access to new products.
toeic_zh: 獨家成員可以優先使用新產品。

en: restricted in quantity or time
toeic: Our limited edition product sold out in one week.
toeic_zh: 我們的限量版產品一週內銷售一空。

en: related to specific time of year
toeic: Our seasonal campaigns align with holiday shopping periods.
toeic_zh: 我們的季節性活動與假日購物期間一致。

en: not connected to the internet
toeic: Our offline retail stores complement online sales.
toeic_zh: 我們的線下零售店補充在線銷售。

en: selling goods directly to consumers
toeic: Our retail stores are located in major shopping centers.
toeic_zh: 我們的零售店位於主要購物中心。

en: selling goods in bulk at lower prices
toeic: Our wholesale division supplies 500 retail partners.
toeic_zh: 我們的批發部門為500家零售合作夥伴供應。

en: combining two different types or methods
toeic: Our hybrid retail model combines online and offline channels.
toeic_zh: 我們的混合零售模式結合了在線和線下渠道。

en: integrated across all customer touchpoints
toeic: Our omnichannel approach provides seamless customer experience.
toeic_zh: 我們的全渠道方法提供無縫客戶體驗。

en: any interaction between customer and business
toeic: We optimize every customer touchpoint for better experience.
toeic_zh: 我們優化每個客戶接觸點以獲得更好體驗。

en: path a customer takes through buying process
toeic: Understanding the customer journey improves conversion rates.
toeic_zh: 理解客戶旅程提高了轉化率。

en: to carry out or perform an action
toeic: Our team executes daily marketing tasks efficiently.
toeic_zh: 我們的團隊有效地執行日常市場營銷任務。

en: to follow or record progress of something
toeic: Our analytics platform tracks customer interactions automatically.
toeic_zh: 我們的分析平台自動追蹤客戶互動。

en: to modify something to suit specific needs
toeic: We customize solutions for each corporate client.
toeic_zh: 我們為每個企業客戶定制解決方案。

en: to modify for individual preferences
toeic: We personalize email marketing based on customer preferences.
toeic_zh: 我們根據客戶偏好個性化電子郵件市場營銷。

en: to obtain or gain possession of something
toeic: We acquire customers through multiple marketing channels.
toeic_zh: 我們通過多個市場營銷渠道獲得客戶。

en: to keep or continue to have something
toeic: We focus on retaining customers through loyalty programs.
toeic_zh: 我們透過忠誠度計劃著重保留客戶。

en: to increase size or capacity
toeic: We plan to scale our operations to 50 locations.
toeic_zh: 我們計劃將運營規模擴大到50個地點。

en: to start selling a new product to the public
simple: They launch a new phone today.
simple_zh: 他們今天推出一支新手機。
toeic: The company will launch its new line of sports shoes in March.
toeic_zh: 公司將在三月推出新的運動鞋系列。
family: launch (n) 上市；發表; product launch 新品發表; launch event 發表會

en: a person who buys and uses products or services
toeic: Consumer spending rose sharply during the holiday season.
toeic_zh: 假期期間消費者支出大幅上升。
family: consume (v) 消費；消耗; consumption (n) 消費量; consumer goods 消費性商品

en: a short phrase that a company uses in its advertising
simple: The shop has a funny slogan.
simple_zh: 這家店有一句很有趣的口號。
toeic: The new slogan is short, catchy, and easy to remember.
toeic_zh: 這句新標語簡短、朗朗上口又容易記住。
family: advertising slogan 廣告標語; catchy slogan 朗朗上口的標語; campaign slogan 活動標語

en: a large room where a company shows its products for sale
simple: The car showroom opens at nine.
toeic: Visit our showroom to see the complete range of kitchen appliances.
toeic_zh: 歡迎蒞臨我們的展示間，欣賞完整系列的廚房電器。
family: showroom (n) = show + room; car showroom 汽車展示間; furniture showroom 家具展示間

en: a small piece of paper that gives you a lower price
simple: I have a coupon for pizza.
toeic: Present this coupon at the checkout to receive ten percent off.
toeic_zh: 結帳時出示這張優惠券即可享九折。
family: redeem a coupon 兌換優惠券; coupon code 優惠碼; discount coupon 折價券

en: to say publicly that you like and support a product
simple: A famous singer will endorse the shoes.
simple_zh: 一位知名歌手將為這雙鞋代言。
toeic: The company paid a famous athlete to endorse its new sports drink.
toeic_zh: 公司付錢請一位知名運動員為其新運動飲料代言。
family: endorsement (n) 代言；背書; endorser (n) 代言人; celebrity endorsement 名人代言

en: something you buy for less than its usual price
toeic: At only $20, the jacket was a real bargain.
toeic_zh: 這件外套只要二十美元，真的很划算。
family: bargain (v) 討價還價; bargain price 特價; a good bargain 好買賣

en: to show how something works
simple: She will demonstrate the new phone.
toeic: The sales representative will demonstrate how the new vacuum cleaner works.
toeic_zh: 業務代表將示範這台新吸塵器如何運作。
family: demonstration (n) 示範；展示; demonstrator (n) 示範者; demonstrate how to

en: making more money than it costs
toeic: The new product line proved profitable within its first six months.
toeic_zh: 這條新產品線在最初六個月內就證明能夠獲利。
family: profit (n) 利潤; profitability (n) 獲利能力; unprofitable (adj) 無利可圖的

en: always supporting a person, company or brand
toeic: Loyal customers earn points every time they shop at our stores.
toeic_zh: 忠實顧客每次在我們的門市購物都能累積點數。
family: loyalty (n) 忠誠；loyalty program 會員忠誠計畫; loyal customer 忠實顧客; brand loyalty

en: A large outdoor sign used to display advertisements.
simple: I saw a big billboard on the road.
simple_zh: 我在路上看到一個大看板。
toeic: The company rented a billboard near the airport to promote its new service.
toeic_zh: 該公司在機場附近租了一面看板來宣傳新服務。

en: A single printed sheet handed out to advertise something.
simple: A man gave me a flyer.
simple_zh: 一位男士給了我一張傳單。
toeic: The marketing team will hand out flyers at the trade show on Monday.
toeic_zh: 行銷團隊將在週一的貿易展上發放傳單。

en: A book or list showing all the products a company sells.
simple: I looked through the shoe catalog.
toeic: Our new spring catalog will be mailed to all customers next week.
toeic_zh: 我們的春季新型錄將於下週寄給所有顧客。

en: A small printed paper that gives information or advertises.
simple: He read the leaflet at the door.
simple_zh: 他在門口讀了那張傳單。
toeic: A leaflet describing the sale was placed in every mailbox in the area.
toeic_zh: 描述特賣活動的傳單被放入該地區每個郵箱。

en: A long sign or web ad that displays a message.
simple: The shop hung a red banner.
simple_zh: 那家店掛了一面紅色橫幅。
toeic: We placed a banner on the website to announce the summer promotion.
toeic_zh: 我們在網站上放置橫幅廣告來宣布夏季促銷。

en: Attention given to someone or something by the media.
simple: The movie got a lot of publicity.
simple_zh: 那部電影得到很多宣傳。
toeic: The charity event generated valuable publicity for our brand.
toeic_zh: 這場慈善活動為我們的品牌帶來了寶貴的曝光。

en: To pay for an event or person in return for advertising.
simple: A bank will sponsor the game.
simple_zh: 一家銀行將贊助這場比賽。
toeic: Our firm decided to sponsor the annual marathon to increase brand awareness.
toeic_zh: 我們公司決定贊助年度馬拉松以提升品牌知名度。

en: To show products or works to the public.
simple_zh: 他們每年夏天都展出藝術品。
toeic: We plan to exhibit our latest models at the Tokyo trade fair.
toeic_zh: 我們計劃在東京貿易展上展出最新型號。

en: A small stand where products are shown or sold at an event.
simple: Our booth is next to the door.
toeic: Visit our booth at the expo to receive a free product sample.
toeic_zh: 歡迎到博覽會上的我們的攤位領取免費產品試用品。

en: To present something in a way that shows its best features.
simple: The shop will showcase new shoes.
toeic: The conference will showcase innovations from leading technology firms.
toeic_zh: 這場會議將展示領先科技公司的創新成果。

en: A group of people defined by age, income, or similar traits.
simple: Young people are our main demographic.
simple_zh: 年輕人是我們的主要客群。
toeic: The survey shows that our product appeals mostly to a younger demographic.
toeic_zh: 調查顯示我們的產品主要吸引較年輕的族群。

en: A person who visits stores to buy things.
simple_zh: 星期六有很多購物者來。
toeic: The store offers extended hours to attract holiday shoppers.
toeic_zh: 這家店延長營業時間以吸引假日購物者。

en: A person whose job is to sell products.
toeic: Each salesperson must submit a weekly report to the regional manager.
toeic_zh: 每位業務員都必須向區域經理提交每週報告。

en: Selling products or services by telephone.
simple_zh: 我不喜歡電話行銷的來電。
toeic: The company hired extra staff to expand its telemarketing department.
toeic_zh: 公司聘請額外人員來擴大電話行銷部門。

en: A sales call made to someone who does not expect it.
simple: I made a cold call today.
simple_zh: 我今天打了一通陌生電話。
toeic: New staff are trained to make a cold call with confidence.
toeic_zh: 新進員工接受訓練，能有自信地打陌生拜訪電話。

en: The final step of completing a sale or deal.
simple: The closing of the sale was fast.
simple_zh: 這筆交易很快就成交了。
toeic: The closing of the deal is scheduled for the end of the month.
toeic_zh: 這筆交易預定在月底完成。

en: A fixed amount of sales a person must reach.
toeic: Our team exceeded its quarterly quota by fifteen percent.
toeic_zh: 我們團隊的季度業績超出配額百分之十五。

en: A label showing the cost of an item.
simple: The price tag says ten dollars.
simple_zh: 價格標籤上寫著十美元。
toeic: Customers were surprised by the high price tag on the new model.
toeic_zh: 顧客對新款的高標價感到驚訝。

en: A business that buys goods to sell them again.
simple_zh: 那位經銷商在網路上賣手機。
toeic: We signed an agreement with a reseller to distribute our software in Asia.
toeic_zh: 我們與一家經銷商簽約，在亞洲經銷我們的軟體。

en: A right to sell a company's products under its name.
simple_zh: 他擁有一家披薩加盟店。
toeic: The firm plans to sell a franchise to investors in three new cities.
toeic_zh: 該公司計劃向投資人在三個新城市出售加盟權。

en: A small stand or booth where goods are sold.
simple: I bought water at the kiosk.
toeic: The mall installed an information kiosk near the main entrance.
toeic_zh: 購物中心在主要入口附近設置了資訊服務亭。

en: The front part of a shop facing the street.
simple_zh: 這個店面有很大的窗戶。
toeic: The owner redesigned the storefront to draw more walk-in customers.
toeic_zh: 老闆重新設計店面，以吸引更多自行上門的顧客。

en: Goods that are bought and sold.
toeic: All merchandise must be returned within thirty days with a receipt.
toeic_zh: 所有商品必須在三十天內附收據退回。

en: A free gift offered to attract customers.
simple: We had a giveaway at the fair.
simple_zh: 我們在園遊會上有送贈品。
toeic: The giveaway attracted hundreds of new followers to our social media page.
toeic_zh: 這項贈品活動為我們的社群頁面吸引了數百名新追蹤者。

en: Something given to customers at no cost.
simple: The shop gave me a freebie.
simple_zh: 那家店送了我一個免費小禮品。
toeic: Visitors to our booth received a freebie along with the brochure.
toeic_zh: 參觀我們攤位的訪客除了簡介外還得到一份免費小禮品。

en: A prize draw where people buy numbered tickets.
simple: I won the raffle at school.
toeic: Every customer who spends over fifty dollars can enter the raffle.
toeic_zh: 每位消費超過五十美元的顧客都可以參加抽獎。

en: A competition in which people try to win a prize.
toeic: The photo contest helped the brand connect with younger customers.
toeic_zh: 這場攝影比賽幫助品牌與年輕顧客建立聯繫。

en: A reduction in the price of an item.
simple: There is a markdown on shoes.
toeic: The store announced a markdown on all winter coats to clear space.
toeic_zh: 這家店宣布所有冬季外套降價，以騰出空間。

en: An opinion formed about something, or one view of an ad.
simple: The shop made a good impression.
simple_zh: 那家店給人留下好印象。
toeic: The ad generated two million impressions during the first week.
toeic_zh: 這則廣告在第一週產生了兩百萬次曝光。

en: A regular report sent to customers or members.
toeic: Subscribe to our newsletter to get exclusive offers every month.
toeic_zh: 訂閱我們的電子報，每月可獲得專屬優惠。

en: One marketing email sent to a very large list.
simple: We sent an email blast today.
simple_zh: 我們今天群發了一封電子郵件。
toeic: The sale was announced in an email blast to all registered users.
toeic_zh: 這項特賣活動透過群發電子郵件通知所有註冊用戶。

en: A big discount that lasts only a short time.
toeic: The retailer held a flash sale that sold out within two hours.
toeic_zh: 這家零售商舉辦的限時特賣在兩小時內銷售一空。

en: The highest or busiest point of a period.
simple: Summer is the peak of tourism.
toeic: Sales reach their peak during the holiday season each year.
toeic_zh: 銷售額每年在假期旺季達到高峰。

en: The quiet time of year when fewer people buy.
simple: Hotels are cheap in the off-season.
toeic: Many resorts offer lower rates during the off-season to fill rooms.
toeic_zh: 許多度假村在淡季提供較低價格以填滿客房。

en: To sell goods quickly, often at low prices.
simple: The shop must liquidate old stock.
simple_zh: 這家店必須變賣舊庫存。
toeic: The company had to liquidate its remaining inventory before closing.
toeic_zh: 公司在結束營業前必須變賣剩餘的庫存。

en: To fill shelves again with new goods.
simple: We restock the shelves every night.
toeic: We expect to restock the popular items by the end of the week.
toeic_zh: 我們預計在本週末前為熱門商品補貨。

en: A formal offer to supply goods or do work for a price.
simple: The firm sent a tender today.
simple_zh: 那家公司今天送出了標書。
toeic: Three companies submitted a tender for the office renovation project.
toeic_zh: 有三家公司為辦公室整修工程提交了標書。

en: To argue about the price of something.
simple: Do not haggle in this shop.
simple_zh: 在這家店不要討價還價。
toeic: Customers at the market often haggle over the price of handmade goods.
toeic_zh: 市場上的顧客常常對手工製品的價格討價還價。

en: To make someone agree to do or buy something.
simple: She tried to persuade her boss.
toeic: The salesperson was able to persuade the client to sign a longer contract.
toeic_zh: 業務員成功說服客戶簽下較長期的合約。

en: To attract someone with something pleasant or valuable.
simple_zh: 免費咖啡能吸引購物者。
toeic: The store uses low introductory prices to entice first-time buyers.
toeic_zh: 這家店用較低的開幕價格來吸引首次購買者。

en: The group of people an ad or product aims to reach.
simple_zh: 孩子是我們的目標受眾。
toeic: We must define our target audience before designing the advertising campaign.
toeic_zh: 在設計廣告活動之前，我們必須先界定目標受眾。

en: A small, specialized part of a market.
simple: They sell to a small niche.
simple_zh: 他們向一個小眾市場銷售。
toeic: The startup found a niche in eco-friendly office supplies.
toeic_zh: 這家新創公司在環保辦公用品領域找到了利基市場。

en: A short catchy song used in advertising.
simple: The jingle is easy to sing.
toeic: The radio jingle made our brand instantly recognizable to listeners.
toeic_zh: 這首電台廣告歌讓聽眾立刻認出我們的品牌。

en: A symbol or design that represents a company.
toeic: The new logo will appear on all packaging and printed materials.
toeic_zh: 新標誌將出現在所有包裝與印刷品上。

en: A legally registered name or symbol of a company.
toeic: The firm filed a trademark to protect its product name overseas.
toeic_zh: 該公司申請註冊商標，以在海外保護其產品名稱。

en: A short phrase that sums up a brand's message.
toeic: The agency created a memorable tagline for the product launch.
toeic_zh: 廣告公司為產品上市設計了令人難忘的標語。

en: A character used to represent a brand or team.
simple_zh: 那隻熊是我們的吉祥物。
toeic: The company introduced a friendly mascot to appeal to families.
toeic_zh: 公司推出一個親切的吉祥物來吸引家庭客群。

en: A person who speaks officially for a company or group.
simple_zh: 發言人回答了我們的問題。
toeic: A famous athlete was chosen as the spokesperson for the sportswear line.
toeic_zh: 一位知名運動員被選為這個運動服飾系列的代言人。

en: A person with many followers who can affect buying choices.
simple: The influencer showed her new bag.
simple_zh: 那位網紅展示了她的新包包。
toeic: We partnered with an influencer to promote our skincare line online.
toeic_zh: 我們與一位網紅合作，在網路上推廣我們的保養系列。

en: Spreading very quickly online among many people.
simple: The video went viral last night.
toeic: The viral video increased our website traffic by three hundred percent.
toeic_zh: 這支爆紅的影片使我們網站的流量增加了百分之三百。

en: Excited talk about a new product or event.
simple: The new phone has much buzz.
toeic: The teaser trailer created a lot of buzz before the film opened.
toeic_zh: 預告片在電影上映前引起了很大的話題熱度。

en: A short ad that gives a small preview of something.
simple_zh: 我們看了那部電影的預告。
toeic: The firm released a teaser to build excitement for its upcoming product.
toeic_zh: 該公司釋出預告以替即將推出的產品製造期待。

en: To show a new product to the public for the first time.
simple: They will unveil a new car.
toeic: The company will unveil its latest smartphone at a press conference tomorrow.
toeic_zh: 該公司明天將在記者會上發表最新款智慧型手機。

en: The first public appearance of a product or person.
simple: The song made its debut today.
toeic: The new tablet made its debut at the electronics show in January.
toeic_zh: 這款新平板電腦在一月的電子展上首次亮相。

en: A feature that makes people want to buy something.
simple: Low price is the selling point.
toeic: The main selling point of this laptop is its long battery life.
toeic_zh: 這台筆記型電腦的主要賣點是電池續航力長。

en: A product that sells in very large numbers.
toeic: The compact blender became our bestseller within just three months.
toeic_zh: 這款迷你果汁機在短短三個月內成為我們的暢銷商品。

en: Being the best or most important product or store.
toeic: The brand opened its flagship store in the city center last month.
toeic_zh: 該品牌上個月在市中心開設了旗艦店。

en: To sell at a lower price than a competitor.
toeic: Smaller firms often undercut larger rivals to win new customers.
toeic_zh: 小型公司常以更低的價格削弱大型對手，以贏得新客戶。

en: Cheap enough that most people can pay for it.
simple: The hotel is clean and affordable.
toeic: Our goal is to offer high-quality products at affordable prices.
toeic_zh: 我們的目標是以負擔得起的價格提供高品質產品。

en: Costing more than it is really worth.
toeic: Many reviewers said the product was overpriced compared with similar models.
toeic_zh: 許多評論者表示，與類似型號相比，這項產品定價過高。

en: public support from a famous person for a product
simple: The singer gave the shoes an endorsement.
simple_zh: 那位歌手為這雙鞋代言。
toeic: A celebrity endorsement helped the new beverage reach younger customers.
toeic_zh: 名人代言幫助這款新飲料接觸到更年輕的顧客。

en: how well people recognize and remember a brand
simple_zh: 廣告可以建立品牌知名度。
toeic: The campaign aims to increase brand awareness in overseas markets.
toeic_zh: 這項活動旨在提升海外市場的品牌知名度。

en: help or work provided by a company to a customer
toeic: Customer service representatives are trained to handle complaints professionally.
toeic_zh: 客服代表接受培訓專業地處理投訴。

en: a problem or concern that needs to be addressed
simple: What is the main issue with your order?
simple_zh: 您的訂單有什麼主要問題？
toeic: We take every customer issue very seriously and resolve it promptly.
toeic_zh: 我們非常認真對待每個顧客問題並及時解決。

en: to help someone or support them in an activity
simple: Can I assist you with anything?
toeic: Our staff is trained to assist customers with any questions or concerns.
toeic_zh: 我們的工作人員接受培訓以協助顧客解答任何問題或關注。

en: to answer or reply to a message or request
simple: Please respond to our email within 48 hours.
simple_zh: 請在48小時內回應我們的電郵。
toeic: Representatives must respond to customer inquiries within one business day.
toeic_zh: 代表必須在一個工作日內回應顧客查詢。

en: feeling annoyed or disappointed about something
simple: The frustrated customer demanded a refund.
toeic: Frustrated clients often escalate their complaints to management level.
toeic_zh: 沮喪的客戶常常將投訴升級到管理層。

en: to express regret or say sorry for something wrong
simple: We apologize for the delay in shipping.
toeic: The manager apologized sincerely and offered compensation for the mistake.
toeic_zh: 經理真誠地道歉並為錯誤提供了補償。

en: to pay someone money or give them something to make up for loss or damage
simple: We will compensate you for the damaged goods.
simple_zh: 我們將為損壞的商品補償您。
toeic: Customers who suffered damages are entitled to compensate through insurance claims.
toeic_zh: 遭受損害的顧客有權通過保險索賠獲得補償。

en: a fault or imperfection in something
simple: The product has a manufacturing defect.
toeic: Defects discovered within the warranty period are covered under our guarantee.
toeic_zh: 在保修期內發現的缺陷由我們的保證覆蓋。

en: to ask a question or seek information about something
simple: Customers can inquire about product availability online.
simple_zh: 顧客可以在線詢問產品可用性。
toeic: Please inquire about our premium membership benefits at the service desk.
toeic_zh: 請在服務台詢問我們的高級會員福利。

en: to make something clear or easier to understand
simple: Can you clarify what you mean by that?
toeic: Service representatives clarify product specifications to prevent misunderstandings.
toeic_zh: 服務代表澄清產品規格以防止誤解。

en: to increase in severity or intensity; to bring to a higher level
simple: If not resolved, we will escalate the issue.
simple_zh: 如果未解決，我們將升級問題。
toeic: Unresolved complaints are escalated to the management team.
toeic_zh: 未解決的投訴將升級至管理團隊。

en: to accept or admit the truth of something; to recognize receipt of
simple: We acknowledge receipt of your payment.
simple_zh: 我們確認收到您的付款。
toeic: Customer service representatives acknowledge complaints and document all details.
toeic_zh: 客服代表承認投訴並記錄所有詳情。

en: fitting in well with a person's needs; not troublesome
simple: Our store hours are very convenient for customers.
simple_zh: 我們的營業時間對顧客來說很方便。
toeic: Online shopping provides convenient access to products 24/7.
toeic_zh: 在線購物提供24/7方便的產品訪問。

en: polite and respectful in manner
simple: Our staff is always courteous to customers.
simple_zh: 我們的工作人員始終對顧客有禮貌。
toeic: Courteous treatment of upset customers can transform negative situations.
toeic_zh: 對不安的顧客的有禮貌對待可以轉變負面情況。

en: relating to a job requiring special training or relating to a person skilled in their work
simple: Professional staff handle all customer inquiries.
simple_zh: 專業工作人員處理所有顧客詢問。
toeic: Professional customer service requires training and excellent communication skills.
toeic_zh: 專業的客服需要培訓和優秀的溝通技能。

en: to keep something in good condition; to continue
simple: We maintain high service quality standards.
simple_zh: 我們維持高服務質量標準。
toeic: Maintaining customer relationships requires consistent and reliable service.
toeic_zh: 維持顧客關係需要持續和可靠的服務。

en: the standard of something measured against other things of a similar kind
simple: We guarantee the quality of all our products.
simple_zh: 我們保證所有產品的質量。
toeic: Quality assurance teams inspect products before delivery to customers.
