toeic: The government introduced a levy on large bank transactions.
toeic_zh: 政府對大額銀行交易徵收一項稅款。

en: Money taken from pay in advance to cover tax.
simple: My pay has withholding each month.
simple_zh: 我每個月的薪水都有預扣稅款。
toeic: Please check the withholding amount shown on your pay slip.
toeic_zh: 請檢查薪資單上顯示的預扣稅額。

en: Money paid to an owner for using their work or idea.
simple: The singer gets a royalty for each song.
simple_zh: 這位歌手每賣一首歌就能拿到版稅。
toeic: The firm pays a royalty to the inventor for every unit sold.
toeic_zh: 該公司每賣出一件產品就付權利金給發明者。

en: To send money as payment.
simple: Please remit the money by Friday.
toeic: Customers should remit payment to the account listed on the invoice.
toeic_zh: 客戶應將款項匯至發票上列出的帳戶。

en: To pay out money from a fund or account.
simple: The bank will disburse the money today.
simple_zh: 銀行今天會撥出這筆錢。
toeic: The committee will disburse the grant in two equal installments.
toeic_zh: 委員會將分兩期等額撥付這筆補助金。

en: A person who owns shares in a company.
simple: My uncle is a shareholder of that bank.
simple_zh: 我叔叔是那家銀行的股東。
toeic: Every shareholder will receive the annual report by mail.
toeic_zh: 每位股東都會收到郵寄的年度報告。

en: Financial papers like stocks and bonds that can be traded.
simple: He buys and sells securities at work.
toeic: The firm trades securities on behalf of its corporate clients.
toeic_zh: 該公司代表企業客戶買賣證券。

en: Making neither a profit nor a loss.
simple: The shop reached break-even this month.
simple_zh: 這家店這個月達到損益兩平。
toeic: We expect to reach the break-even point by the end of the year.
toeic_zh: 我們預計在年底前達到損益兩平點。

en: An amount of money spent on something.
simple: The first outlay was very small.
toeic: The new factory requires a large initial outlay of capital.
toeic_zh: 新工廠需要龐大的初期資金支出。

en: The final profit or loss figure of a company.
simple: The bottom line shows we made money.
simple_zh: 最終數字顯示我們賺錢了。
toeic: Lower shipping costs have improved our bottom line this year.
toeic_zh: 較低的運費改善了我們今年的淨利。

en: Money that is owed and should have been paid earlier.
simple: He is in arrears with his rent.
toeic: The tenant is three months in arrears on the monthly lease payment.
toeic_zh: 該房客已拖欠三個月的每月租金。

en: A person or bank that lends money.
simple: The lender gave us a small loan.
simple_zh: 貸款人借給我們一小筆錢。
toeic: The lender requires proof of income before approving the application.
toeic_zh: 放款機構在核准申請前要求提供收入證明。

en: A person or company that takes a loan.
simple: The borrower must pay every month.
simple_zh: 借款人每個月都必須還款。
toeic: Each borrower must submit tax records along with the loan form.
toeic_zh: 每位借款人都必須連同貸款表格一併提交稅務紀錄。

en: Money given by the government to help a business.
simple: The farm gets a subsidy every year.
simple_zh: 這座農場每年都拿到補助金。
toeic: The government offers a subsidy to firms that install solar panels.
toeic_zh: 政府對安裝太陽能板的公司提供補助金。

en: Money given for a special purpose that need not be repaid.
simple: She won a grant to study art.
simple_zh: 她獲得一筆補助款來學藝術。
toeic: The research team applied for a grant to fund its new project.
toeic_zh: 研究團隊申請補助款來資助新專案。

en: To list each item and its cost separately.
simple: Please itemize the bill for me.
simple_zh: 請幫我把帳單逐項列出。
toeic: Employees must itemize all travel costs on the expense report.
toeic_zh: 員工必須在費用報告上逐項列出所有差旅費用。

en: The total of part of a list of amounts.
toeic: The subtotal does not include shipping or sales tax.
toeic_zh: 小計不包含運費或銷售稅。

en: To find a number by using math.
simple: I can calculate the cost easily.
simple_zh: 我可以輕鬆計算出成本。
toeic: Please calculate the total cost before sending the quote to the client.
toeic_zh: 請在將報價寄給客戶前先計算總成本。

en: To judge the value of something officially.
simple: They will appraise our old house.
simple_zh: 他們會替我們的老房子估價。
toeic: An expert was hired to appraise the property before the sale.
toeic_zh: 在出售前聘請了一位專家來評估這處房產。

en: Careful about spending money.
toeic: The frugal manager cut costs without lowering product quality.
toeic_zh: 這位節儉的經理在不降低產品品質的情況下削減了成本。

en: To have enough money to pay for something.
simple: We cannot afford a new car.
toeic: Many small firms cannot afford to hire extra accounting staff.
toeic_zh: 許多小公司負擔不起多聘會計人員。

en: Producing a lot of money.
simple: He found a lucrative job in banking.
simple_zh: 他在銀行業找到一份高薪的工作。
toeic: The company signed a lucrative contract with an overseas retailer.
toeic_zh: 公司與一家海外零售商簽下獲利豐厚的合約。

en: To protect money from loss by making a second deal.
simple: Banks hedge to avoid losing money.
toeic: Exporters often hedge against currency changes with forward contracts.
toeic_zh: 出口商通常以遠期合約來對沖匯率變動。

en: Changing quickly and often, especially in price.
simple: Oil prices are volatile this week.
toeic: Investors are cautious because the market remains highly volatile.
toeic_zh: 由於市場仍然劇烈波動，投資人保持謹慎。

en: When one company buys control of another company.
simple: The takeover was in the news.
toeic: The board approved the takeover after reviewing the final offer.
toeic_zh: 董事會在審閱最終出價後核准了這項收購。

en: A share of ownership in a business.
simple: He has a small stake in the shop.
simple_zh: 他持有這家店的一小部分股份。
toeic: The investor bought a thirty percent stake in the startup.
toeic_zh: 這位投資人買下該新創公司百分之三十的股份。

en: The person who manages an organization's money.
simple: The treasurer counts the club money.
toeic: The treasurer will present the budget report at Monday's meeting.
toeic_zh: 財務長將在週一的會議上報告預算。

en: a request to purchase or supply goods
simple: I placed an order for new equipment.
simple_zh: 我下了一份新設備訂單。
toeic: The purchase order must be approved by the manager before shipping.
toeic_zh: 購買訂單必須在發貨前由經理批准。

en: the act of bringing goods to a destination
toeic: We offer free delivery for orders over 500 dollars.
toeic_zh: 我們為超過500美元的訂單提供免費交付。

en: a large building for storing goods
simple: The warehouse is located near the port.
toeic: We use automated systems in our warehouse for efficient inventory management.
toeic_zh: 我們在倉庫中使用自動化系統進行有效的庫存管理。

en: goods transported by vehicle, ship, or plane
simple: The freight cost is very high this month.
simple_zh: 這個月的貨運成本很高。
toeic: Freight charges are typically calculated based on weight and distance.
toeic_zh: 貨運費用通常根據重量和距離計算。

en: to examine something carefully
simple: We inspect all goods before accepting them.
simple_zh: 我們在接受所有商品前進行檢查。
toeic: Quality inspectors examine each shipment to ensure it meets specifications.
toeic_zh: 品質檢查員檢查每份貨運以確保符合規格。

en: to obtain or acquire goods or services
simple: Our team will procure the necessary materials.
simple_zh: 我們的團隊將採購必要的材料。
toeic: The procurement department procures all supplies needed for operations.
toeic_zh: 採購部門採購運營所需的所有物資。

en: a statement of price for goods or services
simple: Please send us a quote for this project.
simple_zh: 請給我們一份這個項目的報價。
toeic: Vendors provide detailed quotes including shipping and handling charges.
toeic_zh: 賣方提供詳細報價，包括運送和處理費用。

en: to speed up or hurry a process
simple: Can you expedite this order for me?
simple_zh: 你能為我加急這份訂單嗎？
toeic: Customers can pay extra to expedite shipping for urgent deliveries.
toeic_zh: 客戶可以支付額外費用以加急運送緊急交付。

en: to combine multiple shipments into one
simple: We consolidate orders to save on shipping costs.
simple_zh: 我們合併訂單以節省運送成本。
toeic: Shipping companies consolidate multiple shipments to reduce transportation costs.
toeic_zh: 運送公司合併多個貨運以降低運輸成本。

en: a detailed list of cargo in a shipment
simple: Check the manifest for the contents of this shipment.
simple_zh: 檢查這份貨運的清單內容。
toeic: The cargo manifest lists all items, quantities, and their destination.
toeic_zh: 貨物清單列出所有物品、數量和目的地。

en: the management of goods transport and storage
simple: Logistics is crucial for our business operations.
simple_zh: 物流對我們的業務運營至關重要。
toeic: Our logistics team coordinates warehousing, distribution, and customer delivery.
toeic_zh: 我們的物流團隊協調倉儲、分配和客戶交付。

en: the process of accepting delivered goods
simple: The receiving department checks all incoming shipments.
simple_zh: 接收部門檢查所有進貨。
toeic: Upon receiving, staff verify quantities and check for any damage.
toeic_zh: 接收時，員工驗證數量並檢查是否有任何損壞。

en: a company that distributes goods to retailers
simple: Our distributor ships products to stores nationwide.
simple_zh: 我們的分銷商向全國各地的商店運送產品。
toeic: We work with several distributors to reach different regional markets.
toeic_zh: 我們與多個分銷商合作以達到不同的地區市場。

en: the process of sending bills to customers
simple: Billing errors need to be corrected immediately.
simple_zh: 帳單錯誤需要立即更正。
toeic: Our billing department sends invoices within 24 hours of shipment.
toeic_zh: 我們的帳單部門在發貨後24小時內發送發票。

en: a system allowing payment at a later date
simple: We offer payment on credit for regular customers.
simple_zh: 我們為常客提供信用付款。
toeic: Trade credit allows businesses to purchase goods and pay later.
toeic_zh: 商業信用允許企業購買商品並稍後支付。

en: a condition or requirement in an agreement
simple: Read the terms and conditions before purchasing.
simple_zh: 購買前請閱讀條款和條件。
toeic: Payment terms specify when invoices must be paid by customers.
toeic_zh: 付款條款指定客戶必須支付發票的時間。

en: a company that transports goods
simple: Our carrier delivers packages to all regions.
simple_zh: 我們的承運人將包裹送到所有地區。
toeic: We use multiple carriers to ensure reliable and timely deliveries.
toeic_zh: 我們使用多個承運人以確保可靠和及時的交付。

en: a person who delivers messages or parcels
simple: The courier arrived with your package.
simple_zh: 快遞員帶著您的包裹到達了。
toeic: Our couriers offer same-day delivery for urgent shipments.
toeic_zh: 我們的快遞員為緊急貨運提供當日交付。

en: a tag or sticker with information
simple: Check the label for expiration date.
simple_zh: 檢查標籤上的過期日期。
toeic: Shipping labels contain address, tracking number, and handling instructions.
toeic_zh: 運送標籤包含地址、追蹤號碼和搬運說明。

en: a wooden platform for stacking goods
simple: Load the boxes onto the pallet.
toeic: Pallets are used to organize and transport large quantities of goods.
toeic_zh: 棧板用於組織和運輸大量商品。

en: a wooden box for shipping goods
simple: Pack the equipment in a wooden crate.
toeic: Heavy machinery is shipped in protective crates to prevent damage.
toeic_zh: 重型機械用保護板條箱運送以防止損壞。

en: to cover something with protective material
toeic: All products are wrapped in bubble wrap to protect them during transit.
toeic_zh: 所有產品都用氣泡膜包裝以在運輸中保護。

en: to close or fasten something tightly
toeic: All packages are sealed with tamper-proof tape to ensure integrity.
toeic_zh: 所有包裹都用防篡改膠帶密封以確保完整性。

en: bill of lading, a shipping document
simple: The BOL lists all cargo details.
simple_zh: 提單列出所有貨物詳細信息。
toeic: The bill of lading serves as proof of shipment and cargo receipt.
toeic_zh: 提單是運送證明和貨物收據。

en: a tax or fee on goods
simple: The tariff on imported electronics is very high.
simple_zh: 進口電子產品的稅率非常高。
toeic: Import tariffs affect the final cost of products to consumers.
toeic_zh: 進口稅率影響產品對消費者的最終成本。

en: to state or announce officially
simple: You must declare all items at customs.
simple_zh: 您必須在海關申報所有物品。
toeic: Importers must declare goods value for duty calculation purposes.
toeic_zh: 進口商必須申報貨物價值以計算關稅。

en: official permission or approval
simple: The shipment is pending customs clearance.
toeic: Customs clearance can delay international deliveries by several days.
toeic_zh: 海關清關可能會延遲國際交付數天。

en: an official document certifying something
simple: This product has a certificate of authenticity.
toeic: Quality certificates prove that products meet industry standards.
toeic_zh: 品質證書證明產品符合行業標準。

en: to bring goods from another country
toeic: Importing goods requires compliance with customs regulations.
toeic_zh: 進口商品需要遵守海關規定。

en: to send goods to another country
simple_zh: 我們將產品出口到世界各地。
toeic: Exporting goods requires proper documentation and compliance.
toeic_zh: 出口商品需要適當的文件和遵從。

en: the exchange of goods between countries
toeic: Trade agreements facilitate smoother cross-border transactions.
toeic_zh: 貿易協議促進跨境交易更加順利。

en: an increase in price above cost
simple: The retail markup on this item is 50%.
toeic: Retailers add markup to cover operating costs and generate profit.
toeic_zh: 零售商加價以支付運營成本並產生利潤。

en: a partial refund or discount
simple: The manufacturer offers a rebate on this product.
simple_zh: 製造商對該產品提供回扣。
toeic: Volume rebates reward customers for purchasing in larger quantities.
toeic_zh: 數量回扣獎勵以更大數量購買的客戶。

en: an additional charge or fee
simple: There is a surcharge for expedited shipping.
toeic: Fuel surcharges are added during periods of high energy prices.
toeic_zh: 在能源價格高時期增加燃料附加費。

en: a charge for a service
simple: There is a handling fee for this service.
toeic: Transaction fees apply to all credit card payments.
toeic_zh: 交易費適用於所有信用卡付款。

en: an offer to purchase at a specific price
simple: Our bid was accepted by the vendor.
simple_zh: 我們的出價被賣方接受。
toeic: Competitive bids help businesses obtain the best prices.
toeic_zh: 競爭性出價幫助企業獲得最佳價格。

en: a detailed description of requirements
toeic: Purchase orders include detailed specifications for quality and performance.
toeic_zh: 採購訂單包括品質和性能的詳細規格。

en: to prove or confirm the truth of something
simple: We verify all orders before shipping.
simple_zh: 我們在運送前驗證所有訂單。
toeic: Staff verify that shipment contents match the packing list.
toeic_zh: 員工驗證貨運內容與包裝清單相符。

en: to confirm the correctness or accuracy of something
toeic: Orders are validated before processing to prevent errors.
toeic_zh: 訂單在處理前經過驗證以防止錯誤。

en: stock keeping unit for inventory tracking
simple: Each product has a unique SKU.
simple_zh: 每個產品都有獨特的庫存單位。
toeic: SKU codes enable accurate inventory management and tracking.
toeic_zh: 庫存單位代碼使準確的庫存管理和追蹤成為可能。

en: a machine-readable code with parallel bars
toeic: Barcodes improve inventory accuracy and speed up warehouse operations.
toeic_zh: 條碼提高庫存準確性並加快倉庫操作。

en: how heavy something is
simple: What is the weight of this package?
simple_zh: 這個包裹的重量是多少？
toeic: Shipping costs are calculated based on package weight and dimensions.
toeic_zh: 運送成本根據包裹重量和尺寸計算。

en: a measurable extent such as length or width
simple: Check the dimensions of this box.
toeic: Package dimensions determine warehouse storage space and shipping rates.
toeic_zh: 包裹尺寸決定倉庫存儲空間和運送費率。

en: a structure designed to hold goods
toeic: Shipping containers are standardized for efficient cargo handling.
toeic_zh: 運送容器標準化以進行高效的貨物搬運。

en: things held or included in something
simple: List the contents on the box.
toeic: Package contents must be declared for customs clearance.
toeic_zh: 包裹內容物必須為海關清關申報。

en: a document listing items in a shipment
simple: Check the packing slip for contents.
simple_zh: 檢查裝箱單了解內容物。
toeic: Packing slips help verify that all ordered items are included.
toeic_zh: 裝箱單有助於驗證所有訂購物品都已包含。

en: a product order that cannot be fulfilled immediately
toeic: Backorders occur when inventory is insufficient to meet demand.
toeic_zh: 當庫存不足以滿足需求時，會出現缺貨訂單。

en: a situation where goods are completely out of stock
simple: We have a stockout on this item.
toeic: Stockouts result in lost sales and customer dissatisfaction.
toeic_zh: 缺貨導致銷售損失和客戶不滿。

en: excess inventory beyond what is needed
simple: We have overstock in the warehouse.
simple_zh: 我們在倉庫有過度庫存。
toeic: Overstock situations tie up capital and increase storage costs.
toeic_zh: 過度庫存情況佔用資本並增加儲存成本。

en: the time between order and delivery
simple: The lead time is two weeks.
toeic: Longer lead times require careful inventory planning and forecasting.
toeic_zh: 較長的交貨期需要謹慎的庫存計劃和預測。

en: the time needed to complete a process
simple_zh: 快速周轉是必不可少的。
toeic: Fast turnaround times give businesses a competitive advantage.
toeic_zh: 快速的周轉時間給企業競爭優勢。

en: as soon as possible, as quickly as can be done
toeic: Customers request ASAP shipping for urgent business needs.
toeic_zh: 客戶要求盡快運送以滿足緊急業務需求。

en: happening or delivered the next day
toeic: Overnight delivery services command premium shipping rates.
toeic_zh: 隔夜交付服務收取高級運送費率。

en: the distribution or assignment of resources
toeic: Inventory allocation ensures fairness when stock is limited.
toeic_zh: 庫存配置在庫存有限時確保公平。

en: a lack or deficiency of something
toeic: Supply chain disruptions create material shortages.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈中斷造成材料短缺。

en: just-in-time inventory system
simple_zh: 我們使用即時庫存管理。
toeic: JIT systems reduce storage costs but require precise timing.
toeic_zh: 即時系統降低存儲成本但需要精確的時間。

en: a difference or inconsistency
simple: There is a discrepancy in the inventory.
toeic: Discrepancies between orders and receipts must be investigated.
toeic_zh: 必須調查訂單和收據之間的差異。

en: request for quotation from suppliers
simple_zh: 向供應商發送報價請求。
toeic: RFQs allow businesses to compare prices from multiple vendors.
toeic_zh: 報價請求允許企業比較多個賣方的價格。

en: less than truckload shipping
toeic: LTL shipping is ideal for shipments that don't fill a truck.
toeic_zh: 零擔運送適合未填滿卡車的貨運。

en: full truckload shipping
simple_zh: 訂購整車以運送大量貨物。
toeic: FTL shipments are more economical for large quantities.
toeic_zh: 整車運送對大量貨物更經濟。

en: a package or bundle of goods
toeic: Parcel delivery services handle small to medium-sized packages.
toeic_zh: 包裹交付服務處理中等規模的包裹。

en: transporting goods by airplane
toeic: Air freight offers rapid delivery but at premium prices.
toeic_zh: 空運提供快速交付但以高價。

en: transporting goods by ship
simple_zh: 使用海運進行批量運送。
toeic: Ocean freight is economical for large international shipments.
toeic_zh: 海運對大型國際貨運經濟。

en: international commercial terms
simple: Specify the incoterm in the contract.
simple_zh: 在合同中指定貿易術語。
toeic: Incoterms define responsibility for shipping costs and risks.
toeic_zh: 貿易術語定義運送成本和風險的責任。

en: cash on delivery payment
toeic: COD protects both buyers and sellers in transactions.
toeic_zh: 貨到付款在交易中保護買家和賣家。

en: electronic data interchange for business
simple_zh: 我們的系統使用電子數據交換。
toeic: EDI streamlines order processing and reduces paperwork.
toeic_zh: 電子數據交換簡化訂單處理並減少文書。

en: radio-frequency identification technology
simple_zh: 在產品上安裝射頻識別標籤。
toeic: RFID technology improves inventory accuracy and supply chain visibility.
toeic_zh: 射頻識別技術改進庫存準確性和供應鏈可見性。

en: transferring goods directly from incoming to outgoing
toeic: Cross-docking reduces storage time and inventory holding costs.
toeic_zh: 直轉減少存儲時間和庫存持有成本。

en: arranging transportation of goods
toeic: Freight forwarders specialize in complex international shipments.
toeic_zh: 貨物代理專門從事複雜的國際貨運。

en: using machines to improve warehouse operations
toeic: Warehouse automation increases efficiency and reduces labor costs.
toeic_zh: 倉庫自動化提高效率並降低勞動成本。

en: a mechanical system for moving goods
toeic: Conveyor systems speed up package sorting and loading.
toeic_zh: 傳送帶系統加快包裹分類和裝載。

en: materials used to protect goods during shipping
toeic: Packing materials prevent damage and ensure product safety.
toeic_zh: 包裝材料防止損壞並確保產品安全。

en: protective plastic with air bubbles
simple: Use bubble wrap for fragile items.
simple_zh: 使用氣泡膜包裝易碎物品。
toeic: Bubble wrap provides excellent protection against breakage.
toeic_zh: 氣泡膜提供優異的破損保護。

en: packing peanuts for cushioning
toeic: Foam peanuts cushion items and prevent shifting in transit.
toeic_zh: 泡沫粒墊圈物品並防止運輸中移動。

en: adhesive strip for sealing boxes
toeic: Quality packing tape prevents boxes from opening in transit.
toeic_zh: 優質包裝膠帶防止盒子在運輸中打開。

en: binding material for securing bundles
toeic: Strapping keeps pallets secure and prevents load shift.
toeic_zh: 捆紮保持棧板穩定並防止載重移動。

en: substance that absorbs moisture
toeic: Desiccants prevent moisture damage to sensitive products.
toeic_zh: 乾燥劑防止對敏感產品的水分損壞。

en: the act of touching or managing something
toeic: Proper handling procedures minimize product damage.
toeic_zh: 適當的搬運程序最小化產品損壞。

en: putting goods onto a vehicle
toeic: Efficient loading procedures maximize truck capacity.
toeic_zh: 高效的裝載程序最大化卡車容量。

en: removing goods from a vehicle
toeic: Unloading and verification must be done carefully.
toeic_zh: 卸載和驗證必須小心進行。

en: to send out or arrange for delivery
toeic: Orders are dispatched to customers within 24 hours.
toeic_zh: 訂單在24小時內派遣給客戶。

en: repairing or redoing faulty work
toeic: Quality rework can increase costs significantly.
toeic_zh: 品質返工可能會大幅增加成本。

en: discarded material or waste
toeic: Scrap rates indicate manufacturing quality issues.
toeic_zh: 廢料率表示製造品質問題。

en: to ask customers to return faulty goods
toeic: Product recalls require coordinated logistics and communication.
toeic_zh: 產品召回需要協調的物流和溝通。

en: controlling stock levels and flow
toeic: Effective inventory management balances costs and availability.
toeic_zh: 有效的庫存管理平衡成本和可用性。

en: the sequence of processes to deliver goods
toeic: Supply chain efficiency impacts profitability and competitiveness.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈效率影響盈利能力和競爭力。

en: the process of obtaining goods or services
toeic: Strategic procurement reduces costs and improves quality.
toeic_zh: 戰略性採購降低成本並提高品質。

en: transferring cargo from one vehicle to another
toeic: Transshipment hubs consolidate and distribute shipments efficiently.
toeic_zh: 轉運中心有效地合併和分配貨運。

en: specialist handling international customs
toeic: Customs brokers expedite clearance of international shipments.
toeic_zh: 報關行加快國際貨運的清關。

en: a company that combines shipments
toeic: Consolidators combine multiple orders to save shipping costs.
toeic_zh: 整合商合併多個訂單以節省運送成本。

en: ability to track the history of goods
toeic: Traceability is critical for food and pharmaceutical products.
toeic_zh: 可追蹤性對食品和藥品至關重要。

en: reduction or lessening of something
toeic: Risk mitigation planning prevents supply chain disruptions.
toeic_zh: 風險緩解計劃防止供應鏈中斷。

en: greenhouse gas emissions from activities
toeic: Minimizing carbon footprint is becoming increasingly important.
toeic_zh: 最小化碳足跡變得越來越重要。

en: predicting future demand or trends
toeic: Accurate forecasting reduces inventory excess and shortages.
toeic_zh: 準確預測減少庫存過度和短缺。

en: software for tracking shipments
toeic: Visibility platforms provide real-time tracking of shipments.
toeic_zh: 可見性平台提供貨運的實時追蹤。

en: finding the most efficient delivery path
toeic: Route optimization reduces fuel costs and delivery times.
toeic_zh: 路線優化降低燃油成本和交付時間。

en: happening immediately, not delayed
toeic: Real-time data enables better decision-making.
toeic_zh: 實時數據使更好的決策成為可能。

en: making something to specific requirements
toeic: Customization services meet individual customer preferences.
toeic_zh: 客製化服務滿足個人客戶偏好。

en: making things uniform or according to standards
simple_zh: 在整個運營中實施標準化。
toeic: Standardization improves efficiency and quality consistency.
toeic_zh: 標準化改進效率和品質一致性。

en: disturbance or problems with normal operations
toeic: Supply chain disruptions require rapid response and adaptation.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈中斷需要快速反應和適應。

en: ability to move quickly and adapt
toeic: Supply chain agility enables rapid response to market changes.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈靈活性使快速響應市場變化成為可能。

en: ability to adjust to changing conditions
toeic: Supply chain flexibility enables quick response to demand changes.
toeic_zh: 供應鏈靈活性使快速響應需求變化成為可能。

en: providing good value for money
simple_zh: 找到成本有效的解決方案。
toeic: Cost-effective logistics strategies maximize profitability.
toeic_zh: 成本有效的物流策略最大化盈利能力。

en: putting a plan or system into action
toeic: Implementation of new logistics systems requires careful planning.
toeic_zh: 新物流系統的實施需要謹慎規劃。

en: seeking expert advice
toeic: Expert consultation improves supply chain strategy.
toeic_zh: 專家諮詢改進供應鏈策略。

en: basic systems and facilities
toeic: Robust infrastructure supports efficient operations.
toeic_zh: 強大的基礎設施支持高效運營。

en: available means and assets
toeic: Resource allocation affects supply chain efficiency.
toeic_zh: 資源分配影響供應鏈效率。

en: power or ability to do something
toeic: Supplier capability assessment ensures quality standards.
toeic_zh: 供應商能力評估確保品質標準。

en: interconnected system or group
toeic: Global logistics networks ensure worldwide coverage.
toeic_zh: 全球物流網絡確保全球覆蓋。

en: control and organization of something
toeic: Effective management ensures smooth supply chain operations.
toeic_zh: 有效的管理確保供應鏈運營順利。

en: a large quantity purchase
simple_zh: 我們有效處理大宗訂單。
toeic: Bulk orders receive special pricing and handling arrangements.
toeic_zh: 大宗訂單獲得特殊定價和處理安排。

en: a label showing shipping information
simple: Attach the shipping label to the box.
simple_zh: 將運送標籤附加到盒子上。
toeic: Each shipping label contains address and tracking information.
toeic_zh: 每個運送標籤包含地址和追蹤信息。

en: cost of transporting goods
toeic: Freight charges are calculated based on weight and destination.
toeic_zh: 貨運費根據重量和目的地計算。

en: process of choosing suppliers
toeic: Vendor selection criteria include price, quality, and reliability.
toeic_zh: 賣方選擇標準包括價格、品質和可靠性。

en: the date when goods arrive
toeic: Delivery dates must be specified in purchase agreements.
toeic_zh: 採購協議中必須指定交付日期。

en: monitoring shipment progress
toeic: Shipment tracking provides real-time visibility of packages.
toeic_zh: 貨運追蹤提供包裹的實時可見性。

en: statement of goods for customs
toeic: Customs declarations must include accurate product descriptions.
toeic_zh: 海關申報必須包括準確的產品說明。

en: a batch of goods sent or delivered to someone
simple_zh: 這批託運貨物搭火車抵達了。
toeic: Each consignment must be signed for by a manager.
toeic_zh: 每批託運貨物都必須由經理簽收。
family: consign (v); consignee (n); consignor (n); on consignment 寄售

en: the keeping of goods in a place until they are needed
simple: We keep winter clothes in storage.
simple_zh: 我們把冬季衣物放在倉儲。
toeic: The storage fees increase if goods stay longer than a month.
toeic_zh: 如果貨物存放超過一個月，倉儲費就會增加。
family: store (v/n); storage space 儲存空間；cold storage 冷藏；storage unit 儲物間

en: the amount or number of something
toeic: Please specify the quantity of each item on the order form.
toeic_zh: 請在訂購單上註明每項商品的數量。

zh: 積壓的工作；未處理訂單
en: work or orders that are waiting to be done
simple: We have a backlog of work.
toeic: The team is working to clear the backlog of customer orders.
toeic_zh: 團隊正努力清除積壓的客戶訂單。
family: backlog of A 積壓的某物；clear the backlog 消化積壓

en: an amount that is more than what is needed
simple: We have a surplus of rice.
toeic: The factory sold its surplus stock at a discount.
toeic_zh: 工廠把剩餘庫存打折出售。
family: surplus (adj); surplus stock 剩餘庫存；trade surplus 貿易順差

en: easy to break or damage
simple: Be careful. The glass is fragile.
toeic: Fragile items must be packed with extra protective material.
toeic_zh: 易碎物品必須用額外的保護材料包裝。
family: fragility (n); handle with care 小心輕放

en: to continue an agreement or card for a new period
simple: I need to renew my card.
toeic: The two companies agreed to renew the contract for another year.
toeic_zh: 兩家公司同意再續約一年。
family: renewal (n); renewable (adj); renew a contract 續約

en: likely to go bad quickly, like some food
simple_zh: 牛奶是容易腐壞的食物。
toeic: Perishable goods must be delivered in refrigerated trucks.
toeic_zh: 易腐壞的商品必須用冷藏車運送。
family: perish (v); perishables (n); perishable food 易腐食品

en: to send goods to a customer
toeic: We will ship your order as soon as payment is received.
toeic_zh: 我們一收到款項就會寄出您的訂單。
family: shipment (n); shipping (n); ship A to B 把 A 寄到 B；free shipping 免運費

en: a formal written request for supplies or equipment
simple: I filled out a requisition for pens.
simple_zh: 我填了一張筆的請購單。
toeic: Please submit a requisition before ordering any new office equipment.
toeic_zh: 訂購任何新辦公設備前，請先提交請購單。

en: a person or company that sends goods
simple: The shipper picked up our box.
simple_zh: 託運人來取走了我們的箱子。
toeic: The shipper must label each crate with the destination address.
toeic_zh: 託運人必須在每個板條箱上標示目的地地址。

en: the person or company that receives a shipment
simple: The consignee signed for the box.
simple_zh: 收貨人簽收了那個箱子。
toeic: The consignee is responsible for paying import duties on the goods.
toeic_zh: 收貨人負責支付這批貨物的進口關稅。

en: a company that arranges transport of goods for others
simple: We hired a freight forwarder for the boxes.
simple_zh: 我們請了貨運承攬業者來運這些箱子。
toeic: A freight forwarder can handle the customs paperwork for overseas shipments.
toeic_zh: 貨運承攬業者可以處理海外貨物的報關文件。

en: to complete an order or carry out a promise
toeic: The warehouse can fulfill most online orders within twenty-four hours.
toeic_zh: 倉庫能在二十四小時內完成大部分網路訂單。

en: to place another order for the same goods
simple: Let's reorder the paper next week.
toeic: Customers can reorder their favorite products with a single click.
toeic_zh: 顧客只要點一下就能再訂購喜愛的商品。

en: to fill something up again after it has been used
simple: We replenish the water every morning.
toeic: The supplier will replenish our inventory by the end of the week.
toeic_zh: 供應商將在本週末前補充我們的庫存。

en: a large supply of goods kept for future use
simple: They have a stockpile of food.
simple_zh: 他們有大量囤積的食物。
toeic: The company built a stockpile of components before prices went up.
toeic_zh: 公司在價格上漲前囤積了大量零組件。

en: a large ship used to carry goods
simple: The vessel left the port early.
simple_zh: 那艘船很早就離開了港口。
toeic: The cargo vessel is expected to dock on Thursday morning.
toeic_zh: 貨輪預計週四早上靠港。

en: goods carried by a ship, plane, or truck
toeic: All cargo must be inspected before it is loaded onto the aircraft.
toeic_zh: 所有貨物在裝上飛機前都必須經過檢查。

en: things that are made or grown to be sold
simple: The shop has many goods on sale.
simple_zh: 這家店有很多特價商品。
toeic: The goods will be shipped from our central warehouse this afternoon.
toeic_zh: 這批貨品將於今天下午從我們的中央倉庫出貨。

en: a basic product that is bought and sold in large amounts
toeic: Rising commodity prices have increased our production costs this quarter.
toeic_zh: 大宗商品價格上漲提高了我們本季的生產成本。

en: a place where ships or trucks load and unload goods
simple: The truck is at the dock.
toeic: Please direct all deliveries to the dock at the rear of the building.
toeic_zh: 請將所有送貨引導到大樓後方的裝卸平台。

en: the act of collecting something from a place
simple: We have pickup at noon today.
toeic: We scheduled a pickup for the return shipment on Friday morning.
toeic_zh: 我們安排了週五早上收取退回的貨件。

en: the cost of sending a letter or package by mail
simple: The postage costs two dollars here.
toeic: The price of the catalog does not include postage and handling.
toeic_zh: 目錄價格不含郵資與手續費。

en: a cardboard box used for packing goods
simple: He carried a carton of milk.
toeic: Each carton contains twenty-four units and weighs about ten kilograms.
toeic_zh: 每個紙箱裝有二十四件，重約十公斤。

en: a document listing goods being shipped and their route
toeic: Please attach the waybill to the outside of the package.
toeic_zh: 請將運單貼在包裹外側。

en: a legal document that lists goods being carried by ship
simple: The agent signed the bill of lading.
toeic: The bank requires the original bill of lading before releasing payment.
toeic_zh: 銀行要求在付款前提供提單正本。

en: a document showing that goods arrived safely
simple: I need proof of delivery for this box.
simple_zh: 我需要這個箱子的送達證明。
toeic: The courier will email a proof of delivery once the parcel is signed for.
toeic_zh: 包裹簽收後，快遞業者會寄出送達證明。

en: the place where an order will be sent
simple: Please write your shipping address here.
simple_zh: 請在這裡寫下你的收件地址。
toeic: Customers may enter a different shipping address at checkout.
toeic_zh: 顧客可以在結帳時輸入不同的收件地址。

en: covered by insurance against loss or damage
simple: The package is insured for fifty dollars.
simple_zh: 這個包裹投保了五十美元。
toeic: All overseas shipments are fully insured against loss during transit.
toeic_zh: 所有海外貨運在運送途中遺失皆有完整投保。

en: paid for before a service is used or goods arrive
simple: I have a prepaid phone card.
toeic: A prepaid shipping label is included with every return kit.
toeic_zh: 每份退貨包裹都附有預付運費標籤。

en: an official ban on trade with a country
simple: There is an embargo on that product.
toeic: The embargo has prevented us from exporting machinery to that market.
toeic_zh: 禁運使我們無法向該市場出口機械。

en: covering the whole country
toeic: The retailer launched a nationwide delivery service last month.
toeic_zh: 這家零售商上個月推出了全國配送服務。

en: in or to another country across the sea
toeic: We ship our products overseas through a trusted logistics partner.
toeic_zh: 我們透過可靠的物流夥伴將產品運往海外。

en: a load carried over a distance, or the trip itself
simple: It was a long haul by truck.
simple_zh: 那趟卡車運輸路程很長。
toeic: Long-haul shipments are cheaper by rail than by road.
toeic_zh: 長途運輸走鐵路比走公路便宜。

en: the cost of one single item
toeic: The unit price drops when you order more than five hundred pieces.
toeic_zh: 訂購超過五百件時單價會下降。

en: a list showing the prices of goods
simple: She sent me the price list.
toeic: Our updated price list will take effect on the first of next month.
toeic_zh: 我們更新後的價目表將於下個月一日生效。

en: the smallest amount of goods a customer must buy
simple: The minimum order is ten boxes.
toeic: The factory requires a minimum order of one thousand units.
toeic_zh: 工廠要求最低訂購量為一千件。

en: the money charged for sending goods
simple: The shipping fee is five dollars.
toeic: The shipping fee is waived for purchases over one hundred dollars.
toeic_zh: 購物滿一百美元可免運費。

en: the time when something is expected to arrive
simple: What is the ETA of the truck?
simple_zh: 卡車的預計到達時間是什麼時候？
toeic: The updated ETA for the shipment is Tuesday afternoon.
toeic_zh: 這批貨更新後的預計到達時間是週二下午。

en: a paper listing the goods that were delivered
simple: He gave me the delivery note.
toeic: Please check the goods against the delivery note before signing.
toeic_zh: 簽收前請對照送貨單核對貨品。

en: the process of finding suppliers for goods or materials
simple: Her job is sourcing new products.
simple_zh: 她的工作是尋找新產品的供應來源。
toeic: Our sourcing team is looking for cheaper suppliers in Southeast Asia.
toeic_zh: 我們的採購團隊正在東南亞尋找更便宜的供應商。

en: a company hired by another contractor to do part of a job
simple_zh: 一家分包商修好了屋頂。
toeic: The subcontractor will deliver the parts directly to our assembly plant.
toeic_zh: 分包商將把零件直接送到我們的組裝廠。

en: to send something by a different way
simple: We had to reroute the truck.
toeic: The carrier will reroute the package because of the storm.
toeic_zh: 由於暴風雨，運輸業者將讓包裹改道運送。

en: put in the wrong place and now hard to find
simple_zh: 我有一支放錯地方找不到的鑰匙。
toeic: The misplaced shipment was finally found in the wrong warehouse.
toeic_zh: 走失的貨件最後在錯誤的倉庫被找到。

en: goods carried across the ocean by ship
simple: We use sea freight because it is cheap.
toeic: For large and heavy orders, sea freight is the most economical option.
toeic_zh: 對於大型與重型訂單，海運是最經濟的選擇。

en: done or delivered on the same day
toeic: Orders placed before noon qualify for same-day delivery.
toeic_zh: 中午前下的訂單可享當日送達。

en: the agreed rules about when and how to pay
simple: Please read the payment terms first.
toeic: The supplier offered flexible payment terms for first-time customers.
toeic_zh: 供應商為新客戶提供彈性的付款條件。

en: the day by which something must be paid or finished
toeic: Please pay the invoice before the due date to avoid a late fee.
toeic_zh: 請在到期日前支付發票款項以免收滯納金。

en: a payment of money sent to someone
simple_zh: 我今天收到了你的匯款。
toeic: We will ship the goods as soon as we receive your remittance.
toeic_zh: 一收到您的匯款，我們就會出貨。

en: to buy a large amount of something for later
simple: People stock up before the storm.
simple_zh: 暴風雨前人們會大量囤貨。
toeic: Retailers usually stock up on gifts before the holiday season.
toeic_zh: 零售商通常在假期旺季前大量備貨禮品。

en: an amount that is less than what is needed
simple: We have a shortfall of ten boxes.
toeic: A supplier delay caused a shortfall in our spring inventory.
toeic_zh: 供應商延誤造成我們春季庫存短缺。

en: something new that takes the place of another thing
simple: I need a replacement for this cup.
simple_zh: 我需要這個杯子的替換品。
toeic: We will send a free replacement if the item arrives damaged.
toeic_zh: 如果商品到貨時受損，我們會免費寄送替換品。

en: the store's rules about taking goods back
toeic: Our return policy allows customers to send items back within thirty days.
toeic_zh: 我們的退貨政策允許顧客在三十天內退回商品。

en: dangerous to people or the environment
simple_zh: 那個箱子裝著危險物品。
toeic: Shipping hazardous materials requires special packaging and labeling.
toeic_zh: 危險物品運輸需要特殊的包裝與標示。

en: too large to fit normal size limits
simple: The oversized box did not fit.
toeic: All oversized packages are subject to an additional handling fee.
toeic_zh: 超大包裹需額外支付處理費。

en: coming in from another place
toeic: All inbound shipments are checked at the receiving dock each morning.
toeic_zh: 進貨貨物每天早上都在收貨碼頭檢查。

en: going out to another place
simple: The outbound train leaves at nine.
toeic: All outbound orders are packed and labeled by the afternoon shift.
toeic_zh: 出貨訂單由下午班次負責包裝與貼標。

en: missing while being carried from one place to another
simple: My package was lost in transit.
simple_zh: 我的包裹在運送途中遺失了。
toeic: If your order is lost in transit, we will send a new one at no charge.
toeic_zh: 若您的訂單在運送途中遺失，我們將免費重寄一份。

en: available now and ready to use
simple: We have ten boxes on hand.
toeic: We keep enough spare parts on hand to cover urgent repairs.
toeic_zh: 我們手邊備有足夠的備用零件以應付緊急維修。

en: to take things out of a box or bag
toeic: Staff should unpack and inspect each delivery immediately upon arrival.
toeic_zh: 員工應在貨物到達時立即拆箱並檢查。

en: to put goods into new or different packaging
simple: They repackage the toys in new boxes.
simple_zh: 他們把玩具重新裝進新盒子。
toeic: We had to repackage the fragile items to prevent further damage.
toeic_zh: 我們必須重新包裝易碎品以避免進一步損壞。

en: the total weight including the packaging
simple: Write the gross weight on the box.
toeic: The gross weight of the shipment determines the freight cost.
toeic_zh: 貨物毛重決定運費高低。

en: the weight of goods without the packaging
simple: The net weight is one kilogram.
toeic: Please state both the net weight and the gross weight on the form.
toeic_zh: 請在表格上註明淨重與毛重。

en: picked up and delivered directly to your home or office
simple_zh: 他們提供送貨到府服務。
toeic: The courier provides a door-to-door service for international parcels.
toeic_zh: 快遞業者提供國際包裹的門到門服務。

en: goods or the system for carrying goods by plane
simple: We sent the parts by airfreight.
toeic: Using airfreight is faster than sea freight but costs considerably more.
toeic_zh: 空運比海運快，但費用高出許多。

en: the way in which goods are sent to a customer
simple_zh: 請在下方選擇運送方式。
toeic: Customers can select a shipping method at checkout based on speed and cost.
toeic_zh: 顧客可在結帳時依速度與費用選擇運送方式。

en: a paper or online form used to buy goods
simple: Please fill in the order form.
toeic: Please complete the order form and fax it to our sales department.
toeic_zh: 請填妥訂購單並傳真給我們的業務部門。

en: no longer available because all items were sold
toeic: The new model was sold out within two days of its release.
toeic_zh: 新型號在發售兩天內就售罄了。

en: a lower price given when you buy a large amount
simple: We got a bulk discount on paper.
simple_zh: 我們買紙拿到了大量採購折扣。
toeic: The supplier offers a bulk discount on orders of more than 500 units.
toeic_zh: 供應商對超過五百件的訂單提供大量採購折扣。

en: delivered exactly when needed, with little stock kept
toeic: The factory relies on just-in-time deliveries to keep storage costs low.
toeic_zh: 這家工廠依靠及時配送來降低倉儲成本。

en: a written statement of the price for goods or services
simple: I asked for a quotation today.
toeic: Please send us a quotation for 200 office chairs by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請在週五前寄給我們兩百張辦公椅的報價單。

en: official approval for goods to enter or leave a country
toeic: Delays in customs clearance pushed back the delivery of the machinery.
toeic_zh: 通關延誤使機械設備的交貨延後。

en: a tax paid on goods brought into a country
simple: We paid import duty on the wine.
simple_zh: 我們為葡萄酒繳了進口稅。
toeic: The buyer is responsible for any import duty on the shipment.
toeic_zh: 買方須負責這批貨物的任何進口稅。

en: being carried from one place to another
simple: Your box is in transit now.
simple_zh: 你的箱子現在在運送途中。
toeic: The goods were damaged while they were in transit to the warehouse.
toeic_zh: 貨物在運往倉庫途中受損。

en: products that are broken or spoiled and cannot be sold normally
toeic: Please report any damaged goods within three days of delivery.
toeic_zh: 如有任何受損貨品，請在送達後三天內通報。

en: a group of vehicles or ships owned by one company
simple: The company has a large fleet.
simple_zh: 這家公司有一支龐大的車隊。
toeic: The delivery company is adding ten electric vans to its fleet.
toeic_zh: 這家配送公司正在為其車隊增添十輛電動貨車。

en: money charged for bringing goods to your address
simple: The delivery fee is five dollars.
toeic: The delivery fee is waived for orders over 100 dollars.
toeic_zh: 訂單超過一百美元即免收運費。

en: the money needed to send goods to a buyer
simple: The shipping cost is too high.
toeic: We reduced the shipping cost by switching to a regional carrier.
toeic_zh: 我們改用地區性承運商，降低了運送成本。

en: delivery of goods with no extra charge to the buyer
toeic: Customers receive free shipping when they spend more than 50 dollars.
toeic_zh: 顧客消費超過五十美元即可享免運費。

en: a large ship that carries goods across the sea
simple: The cargo ship arrived this morning.
toeic: The cargo ship will reach the port in Busan on Thursday.
toeic_zh: 這艘貨輪將於週四抵達釜山港。

en: a sticker with an address for sending an item back
simple: Print the return label at home.
toeic: A prepaid return label is included in every package for your convenience.
toeic_zh: 為方便您，每個包裹都附有預付運費的退貨標籤。

en: a message that says your order was received
simple: I got an order confirmation by email.
simple_zh: 我用電子郵件收到訂單確認。
toeic: You will receive an order confirmation within one hour of purchase.
toeic_zh: 您將在購買後一小時內收到訂單確認。

en: to make products in a factory
toeic: The factory manufactures engine components.
toeic_zh: 工廠製造引擎零件。

en: the process of fitting parts together
toeic: The assembly line operates 24/7.
toeic_zh: 組裝線全天運作。

en: the act of making goods
toeic: Production output exceeded targets by 15%.
toeic_zh: 生產產量超過目標15%。

en: machines and equipment collectively
toeic: Modern machinery improves production efficiency.
toeic_zh: 現代機器提高生產效率。

en: a part of a larger system
toeic: Electronic components must meet quality standards.
toeic_zh: 電子零件必須符合品質標準。

en: the process of keeping something in good condition
toeic: Preventive maintenance reduces equipment failures.
toeic_zh: 預防性維護減少設備故障。

en: basic materials before processing
toeic: The factory sources raw materials globally.
toeic_zh: 工廠從全球採購原材料。

en: the amount produced or delivered
toeic: Production output decreased due to machine failure.
toeic_zh: 由於機器故障，生產產出下降。

en: the amount of variation allowed
toeic: Parts must be within tolerance limits.
toeic_zh: 零件必須在誤差範圍內。

en: the process of adjusting instruments to correct values
toeic: Equipment calibration ensures measurement accuracy.
toeic_zh: 設備校準確保測量準確度。

en: careful examination to check quality
toeic: Final inspection ensures product quality.
toeic_zh: 最終檢查確保產品品質。

en: unwanted material or by-products
toeic: Minimizing waste improves profitability.
toeic_zh: 最小化廢料提高獲利。

en: a group of products made together
toeic: Each batch undergoes quality testing.
toeic_zh: 每批都要進行品質測試。

en: a person who operates machinery
toeic: Skilled operators ensure consistent quality.
toeic_zh: 熟練的操作員確保一致的品質。

en: the condition of being safe from danger
toeic: Factory safety protocols protect employees.
toeic_zh: 工廠安全協議保護員工。

en: a position where work is performed
toeic: Assembly workstations must be ergonomic.
toeic_zh: 組裝工作站必須符合人體工程學。

en: a vehicle for lifting and moving materials
toeic: Forklift operators must be certified.
toeic_zh: 叉車操作員必須獲得認證。

en: the process of wrapping products
toeic: Protective packing prevents shipping damage.
toeic_zh: 保護性包裝防止運輸損傷。

en: goods sent or to be sent
toeic: Weekly shipments go to distribution centers.
toeic_zh: 每週出貨到分銷中心。

en: the time taken to complete one production cycle
toeic: Reducing cycle time increases productivity.
toeic_zh: 減少週期時間增加生產力。

en: a point of congestion or delay
toeic: Identifying bottlenecks improves flow.
toeic_zh: 識別瓶頸改善流程。

en: the coordination of processes
toeic: Production line synchronization ensures efficiency.
toeic_zh: 生產線同步確保效率。

en: the power to regulate something
toeic: Process control maintains consistent output.
toeic_zh: 過程控制保持一致的產出。

en: to fit parts together to make something
toeic: Technicians assemble components with precision.
toeic_zh: 技術人員精確組裝零件。

en: to make or generate something
toeic: This plant produces automotive parts.
toeic_zh: 這個工廠生產汽車零件。

en: to run or control a machine
toeic: Only trained staff operate heavy equipment.
toeic_zh: 只有訓練有素的員工操作重型設備。

en: to put something new in place of old
toeic: We replace filters every month.
toeic_zh: 我們每月更換過濾器。

en: to adjust an instrument to correct values
toeic: Technicians calibrate instruments weekly.
toeic_zh: 技術人員每週校準儀器。

en: to arrange items in order
toeic: Machines sort products by quality level.
toeic_zh: 機器按品質等級分類產品。

en: to put goods onto a vehicle or surface
toeic: Forklifts load pallets onto the delivery truck.
toeic_zh: 叉車將托盤裝載到運輸卡車上。

en: to remove goods from a vehicle
toeic: Workers unload raw materials at the dock.
toeic_zh: 工人在碼頭卸載原材料。

en: to make more efficient by removing unnecessary steps
toeic: Process improvements streamline operations.
toeic_zh: 過程改進簡化運營。

en: to distribute or assign resources
toeic: Managers allocate equipment to work stations.
toeic_zh: 經理為工作站分配設備。

en: to keep something for future use
toeic: Raw materials are stored in designated areas.
toeic_zh: 原材料儲存在指定區域。

en: to get something that was stored
toeic: Workers retrieve components from the warehouse.
toeic_zh: 工人從倉庫取回零件。

en: to combine different things together
toeic: Machines mix raw materials in large tanks.
toeic_zh: 機器在大型油罐中混合原材料。

en: to mix things together smoothly
toeic: Chemical processes blend different materials.
toeic_zh: 化學過程混合不同的材料。

en: to make something hotter
toeic: Industrial ovens heat materials to specified temperatures.
toeic_zh: 工業烤箱將材料加熱到指定溫度。

en: to make something colder or reduce temperature
toeic: Products cool in designated cooling zones.
toeic_zh: 產品在指定冷卻區冷卻。

en: to press something into a smaller space
simple: Compress the air in the tank.
toeic: Hydraulic presses compress metal sheets.
toeic_zh: 液壓機壓縮金屬板。

en: to divide something with a sharp tool
toeic: Laser machines cut precision parts.
toeic_zh: 激光機切割精密部件。

en: to make a hole with a drill
toeic: CNC machines drill hundreds of holes daily.
toeic_zh: CNC機器每天鑽數百個孔。

en: to join metal pieces by heating
toeic: Welders join steel components together.
toeic_zh: 焊工將鋼元件連接在一起。

en: to join metal pieces with molten metal
toeic: Electronics technicians solder microchips.
toeic_zh: 電子技術人員焊接芯片。

en: to cover with a layer of substance
toeic: Paint machines coat products uniformly.
toeic_zh: 噴漆機均勻塗膜產品。

en: to make smooth and shiny
toeic: Polishing machines create smooth surfaces.
toeic_zh: 拋光機創建光滑表面。

en: to smooth by rubbing with sandpaper
toeic: Automated sanders prepare surfaces for coating.
toeic_zh: 自動砂磨機準備表面塗膜。

en: to shape something in a mold
simple: Mold the plastic at high temperature.
toeic: Injection machines mold parts rapidly.
toeic_zh: 注射機快速模製零件。

en: to force liquid into something under pressure
simple: Inject the polymer into the mold.
toeic: Injection molding produces precision parts.
toeic_zh: 注射成型生產精密部件。

en: to pour liquid into a mold to form an object
simple: Cast the metal into the mold.
toeic: Foundries cast metal components.
toeic_zh: 鑄造廠鑄造金屬零件。

en: to impress a design onto a surface
simple: Stamp the logo on each product.
simple_zh: 在每個產品上衝壓徽標。
toeic: Metal stamping presses create shapes quickly.
toeic_zh: 金屬衝壓機快速創建形狀。

en: to apply force to flatten or shape
toeic: Hydraulic presses shape metal sheets.
toeic_zh: 液壓機形成金屬板。

en: to pass something through rollers to flatten
toeic: Rolling mills flatten metal strips.
toeic_zh: 軋機軋製金屬條。

en: to force through a shaped opening
simple: Extrude the polymer through the die.
toeic: Extruders produce plastic profiles.
toeic_zh: 擠出機生產塑料型材。

en: to rotate rapidly around a center
simple: Spin the mold at high speed.
toeic: Centrifugal machines spin materials.
toeic_zh: 離心機旋轉材料。

en: having a mechanical problem
toeic: Faulty machinery stops production.
toeic_zh: 故障的機器停止生產。

en: harmed or spoiled by physical force
toeic: Damaged parts are sent for rework.
toeic_zh: 受損的零件送去返工。

en: damaged by use over time
toeic: Worn components reduce equipment efficiency.
toeic_zh: 磨損的零件降低設備效率。

en: made impure by mixing with harmful substance
toeic: Contaminated materials are discarded.
toeic_zh: 被污染的材料被丟棄。

en: the process of gradual destruction by chemical action
toeic: Protective coatings prevent corrosion.
toeic_zh: 保護塗膜防止腐蝕。

en: the reddish-brown coating on iron
toeic: Stainless steel resists rust formation.
toeic_zh: 不銹鋼防止生銹。

en: a line where something breaks without separating
simple: There is a crack in the part.
toeic: Stress cracks appear in metal parts.
toeic_zh: 應力裂縫出現在金屬零件上。

en: an unintended hole allowing fluid to escape
simple: There is a leak in the tank.
toeic: Pressure leaks reduce system efficiency.
toeic_zh: 壓力洩漏降低系統效率。

en: gradual damage from use
toeic: Normal wear requires regular maintenance.
toeic_zh: 正常磨損需要定期維護。

en: the deformation produced by stress
toeic: Materials undergo strain during processing.
toeic_zh: 材料在加工過程中經受應變。

en: the force or pressure applied to something
toeic: Materials must withstand operational stress.
toeic_zh: 材料必須承受工作應力。

en: a rapid movement back and forth
toeic: Machine vibration indicates mechanical problems.
toeic_zh: 機器振動表示機械問題。

en: the force resisting relative motion
toeic: Friction heat can damage components.
toeic_zh: 摩擦熱會損壞零件。

en: the application of a substance to reduce friction
toeic: Proper lubrication extends equipment life.
toeic_zh: 適當的潤滑延長設備壽命。

en: a difference from a standard
toeic: Standard deviation measures variability.
toeic_zh: 標準差測量變異性。

en: the quality of being exact and correct
toeic: High accuracy ensures customer satisfaction.
toeic_zh: 高準確度確保客戶滿意度。

en: the degree of exactness and refinement
toeic: Precision manufacturing requires skilled workers.
toeic_zh: 精密製造需要熟練的工人。

en: the quality of always behaving the same way
toeic: Production consistency is a key metric.
toeic_zh: 生產一致性是關鍵指標。

en: the state of being uniform or identical
toeic: Uniformity standards ensure product quality.
toeic_zh: 統一性標準確保產品品質。

en: the introduction of an impurity or pollutant
toeic: Particle contamination affects product quality.
toeic_zh: 顆粒污染影響產品品質。

en: the act of refusing to accept something
toeic: High rejection rates reduce profitability.
toeic_zh: 高拒絕率降低獲利能力。

en: compliance with established standards
toeic: Product conformance is verified before release.
toeic_zh: 產品符合性在發布前被驗證。

en: failure to comply with requirements
toeic: Nonconformities are documented and tracked.
toeic_zh: 不符合被記錄和跟蹤。

en: the identification of the nature of a problem
simple_zh: 技術人員診斷發現問題。
toeic: Equipment diagnosis prevents breakdowns.
toeic_zh: 設備診斷防止故障。

en: the process of identifying and solving problems
toeic: Systematic troubleshooting resolves issues quickly.
toeic_zh: 系統的故障排除快速解決問題。

en: a change made to something
toeic: Equipment modifications improve performance.
toeic_zh: 設備改造改善性能。

en: a replacement with something worse
toeic: Equipment downgrade affects production.
toeic_zh: 設備降級影響生產。

en: the imitation of something
toeic: Manufacturing simulations predict outcomes.
toeic_zh: 製造模擬預測結果。

en: the study of differences from planned outcomes
simple_zh: 差異分析幫助識別問題。
toeic: Managers conduct variance analysis monthly.
toeic_zh: 經理每月進行差異分析。

en: a machine for lifting and moving heavy objects
toeic: Industrial cranes handle steel beams.
toeic_zh: 工業起重機處理鋼梁。

en: a device for raising something
toeic: Chain hoists lift components safely.
toeic_zh: 鏈式提升機安全地提升零件。

en: a wheeled platform for moving goods
toeic: Material trolleys transport components.
toeic_zh: 材料小車運輸零件。

en: a framework for storing items
toeic: Storage racks organize inventory efficiently.
toeic_zh: 儲存架有效地整理庫存。

en: a horizontal surface for placing items
toeic: Shelving units maximize storage space.
toeic_zh: 架子單元最大化儲存空間。

en: a large container for storage
toeic: Waste bins separate recyclables.
toeic_zh: 廢料箱分離可回收物。

en: a device for holding something in place
simple: Use the correct fixture for assembly.
simple_zh: 使用正確的夾具進行組裝。
toeic: Precision fixtures ensure accurate alignment.
toeic_zh: 精密夾具確保準確對齐。

en: a device for holding items tightly
toeic: C-clamps secure workpieces during machining.
toeic_zh: C型夾子在加工過程中固定工件。

en: a clamping tool for holding workpieces
simple: Place the part in the vise.
toeic: Bench vises hold materials securely.
toeic_zh: 台鉗牢固地夾住材料。

en: a measuring instrument
toeic: Digital gauges measure dimensions precisely.
toeic_zh: 數字量規精確測量尺寸。

en: a device for measuring
toeic: Digital meters display real-time data.
toeic_zh: 數字儀表顯示實時數據。

en: a device that detects changes
toeic: IoT sensors monitor equipment performance.
toeic_zh: 物聯網傳感器監控設備性能。

en: a device for identifying the presence of something

toeic: Quality detectors identify contamination.
toeic_zh: 品質探測器識別污染。

en: a device that controls motion
toeic: Pneumatic actuators control robot movements.
toeic_zh: 氣動執行器控制機器人運動。

en: a machine that produces motion
toeic: Electric motors power production equipment.
toeic_zh: 電動馬達為生產設備供電。

en: a device that converts fuel into power
toeic: Internal combustion engines power vehicles.
toeic_zh: 內燃引擎為車輛提供動力。

en: a device for moving fluids
toeic: Hydraulic pumps provide system pressure.
toeic_zh: 液壓泵提供系統壓力。

en: a device that compresses air or gas
toeic: Air compressors supply pneumatic systems.
toeic_zh: 空氣壓縮機供應氣動系統。

en: a device for controlling flow
toeic: Control valves regulate system pressure.
toeic_zh: 控制閥調節系統壓力。

en: a device for turning something on/off

toeic_zh: 緊急開關立即停止機器。

en: a switch between two states
toeic: Toggle switches control machine functions.
toeic_zh: 切換開關控制機器功能。

en: a screen showing information
toeic: Digital displays show production metrics.
toeic_zh: 數字顯示屏顯示生產指標。

en: a flat piece of material or circuit board
toeic: Circuit boards control machine functions.
toeic_zh: 電路板控制機器功能。

en: a thick cord for transmitting power or signals
toeic: Heavy-duty cables supply power to equipment.
toeic_zh: 重型電纜為設備供電。

en: a thin strand of metal for conducting electricity

toeic_zh: 電線安全地傳輸電流。

en: a device for joining two things together
toeic: Standardized connectors simplify assembly.
toeic_zh: 標準化連接器簡化組裝。

en: a device connecting two shafts

toeic_zh: 柔性耦合吸收振動。

en: a place where two things connect

toeic_zh: 球接頭允許運動靈活性。

toeic_zh: 滾珠軸承大大減少摩擦。

en: a thin sleeve inserted to reduce friction
