toeic_zh: 墊片創建防水連接。

en: a fastener with a helical thread
toeic: Stainless screws resist corrosion.
toeic_zh: 不銹螺絲防止腐蝕。

en: a thick fastener with a nut
toeic: Grade 8 bolts meet strength requirements.
toeic_zh: 8級螺栓符合強度要求。

en: a threaded fastener that fits on a bolt
toeic: Lock nuts prevent vibration loosening.
toeic_zh: 防鬆螺帽防止振動鬆動。

en: a thin ring placed under bolts
simple: Add a washer under the bolt.
toeic: Spring washers prevent fastener loosening.
toeic_zh: 彈簧墊圈防止緊固件鬆動。

en: a device that stores mechanical energy
toeic: Compression springs absorb impact forces.
toeic_zh: 壓縮彈簧吸收衝擊力。

en: a series of loops of wire or rope
toeic: Electrical coils generate magnetic fields.
toeic_zh: 電圈產生磁場。

en: the state of being stretched
toeic: Belt tension affects equipment performance.
toeic_zh: 皮帶張力影響設備性能。

en: the rotational force applied to an object
toeic: Torque specifications vary by bolt size.
toeic_zh: 扭矩規格因螺栓大小而異。

en: energy supply or strength
toeic: Three-phase power operates large motors.
toeic_zh: 三相電力運行大型馬達。

en: the capacity to do work
toeic: Renewable energy reduces operating costs.
toeic_zh: 可再生能源降低運營成本。

en: the force applied over a surface
toeic: System pressure is monitored continuously.
toeic_zh: 系統壓力持續被監控。

en: the degree of heat or cold
toeic: Operating temperature affects product quality.
toeic_zh: 工作溫度影響產品品質。

en: a set period of time when a group of workers is at work
toeic: Employees on the evening shift must clock in by 4 p.m.
toeic_zh: 晚班員工必須在下午四點前打卡上班。
family: night/day shift 夜班／日班；shift supervisor 班長；shift (v) 轉移；改變

en: a liquid put on machine parts so they move smoothly
simple: We put lubricant on the wheels.
simple_zh: 我們在輪子上塗潤滑油。
toeic: Apply lubricant to the moving parts every week.
toeic_zh: 每週都要在移動零件上塗抹潤滑油。
family: lubricate (v) 潤滑；lubrication (n) 潤滑；industrial lubricant 工業潤滑油

en: strong and not easily broken
simple: This table is old but sturdy.
simple_zh: 這張桌子很舊但很堅固。
toeic: We chose a sturdy frame to support the heavy equipment.
toeic_zh: 我們選用堅固的框架來支撐重型設備。
family: sturdily (adv) 堅固地；sturdy frame 堅固的框架；sturdy construction 結實的結構

en: to take a machine or structure apart into pieces
toeic: Workers had to dismantle the press before moving it to the new site.
toeic_zh: 工人必須先拆解沖壓機，才能把它搬到新廠址。
family: dismantling (n) 拆解；dismantle a machine 拆解機器；dismantled (adj) 已拆解的

en: the materials used to wrap or protect products
simple: The packaging is made of paper.
toeic: Eco-friendly packaging helps the company reduce its waste.
toeic_zh: 環保包裝有助於公司減少廢棄物。
family: package (n/v) 包裹；包裝；packaging materials 包裝材料；packaging line 包裝線

en: the first model of a new product, used for testing
simple: He made a prototype of the toy.
simple_zh: 他做了一個玩具的原型。
toeic: The engineers will present a working prototype at next week's meeting.
toeic_zh: 工程師將在下週的會議上展示可運作的原型機。
family: build/test a prototype 製作／測試原型；working prototype 可運作的原型機

en: perfect, with no mistakes or damage
toeic: The new machine produces flawless parts at high speed.
toeic_zh: 新機器能高速生產無瑕疵的零件。
family: flaw (n) 瑕疵；flawlessly (adv) 完美地；flawless finish 完美的表面處理

en: to use machines or computers to do work without people
simple: They want to automate the work.
simple_zh: 他們想讓這項工作自動化。
toeic: The plant plans to automate its packaging process next year.
toeic_zh: 工廠計畫明年讓包裝流程自動化。
family: automation (n) 自動化；automatic (adj) 自動的；automated (adj) 自動化的

en: to examine and repair or change something completely
simple: They will overhaul the old engine.
simple_zh: 他們會徹底檢修這具舊引擎。
toeic: The company will overhaul its assembly line to cut waste.
toeic_zh: 公司將全面改造其裝配線以減少浪費。
family: overhaul (n) 大修；全面改革；major overhaul 大幅改造

en: a building where goods are made in large amounts
simple: My father works in a factory.
toeic: The new factory will employ more than 500 workers by next spring.
toeic_zh: 新工廠明年春天前將僱用超過五百名員工。

en: a factory or large site for producing goods or power
simple: The plant is near the river.
toeic: Our assembly plant in Vietnam doubled its output last year.
toeic_zh: 我們在越南的組裝廠去年產量增加了一倍。

en: a factory that makes materials like paper, steel, or cloth
simple: The paper mill is very old.
toeic: The textile mill announced plans to modernize its equipment.
toeic_zh: 這家紡織廠宣布計畫將設備現代化。

en: a factory where metal is melted and shaped
toeic: The foundry supplies engine parts to several automobile makers.
toeic_zh: 這間鑄造廠供應引擎零件給數家汽車製造商。

en: a worker with special skills to operate or fix machines
simple_zh: 技術人員修好了我的電腦。
toeic: A technician will inspect the production line every Monday morning.
toeic_zh: 技術人員每週一早上會檢查生產線。

en: to add new parts to an older machine or building
simple: They will retrofit the old bus.
simple_zh: 他們會改裝這輛舊巴士。
toeic: We plan to retrofit the machines with energy-saving motors this year.
toeic_zh: 我們計畫今年為機器加裝節能馬達。

en: strong and able to last a long time
toeic: The company is known for making durable products at fair prices.
toeic_zh: 這家公司以平價製造耐用產品而聞名。

en: an object used to do a particular job
simple: I need a tool to fix this.
simple_zh: 我需要一個工具來修這個。
toeic: Each worker must return every tool to the shelf after the shift.
toeic_zh: 每位工人在下班後必須把每件工具放回架上。

en: a metal made by mixing two or more metals
simple: This ring is made of alloy.
toeic: The aircraft parts are made from a light but strong aluminum alloy.
toeic_zh: 這些飛機零件由輕而堅固的鋁合金製成。

en: wood that has been cut into boards for building
simple: We bought lumber for the fence.
simple_zh: 我們買了木材來做圍籬。
toeic: Rising lumber prices have increased the cost of furniture production.
toeic_zh: 木材價格上漲提高了家具生產的成本。

en: cloth or fabric made by weaving or knitting
simple: She works in the textile business.
toeic: The textile exports from our region rose by eight percent this quarter.
toeic_zh: 本季我們地區的紡織品出口成長了百分之八。

en: cloth made by weaving or knitting threads
simple_zh: 我喜歡這種柔軟的布料。
toeic: The fabric is tested for color and strength before it is cut.
toeic_zh: 這種布料在裁剪前會先檢測色牢度與強度。

en: a sticky substance used to make plastics and glue
simple: The toy is made of resin.
toeic: Plastic resin is the main raw ingredient in our bottle production.
toeic_zh: 塑膠樹脂是我們瓶子生產的主要原料。

en: a light man-made material that can be shaped easily
simple: The cup is made of plastic.
toeic: The firm plans to reduce plastic use in all its packages.
toeic_zh: 該公司計畫減少所有包裝中的塑膠使用。

en: a stretchy material used for tires and seals
toeic: The plant imports natural rubber from Southeast Asia every month.
toeic_zh: 這間工廠每月從東南亞進口天然橡膠。

en: to save useful parts or goods from something damaged
simple: We can salvage some old wood.
simple_zh: 我們可以回收一些舊木頭。
toeic: Workers managed to salvage most of the stock after the flood.
toeic_zh: 水災後，工人設法搶救出大部分庫存。

en: something extra made while making the main product
simple: Sugar has a byproduct called molasses.
simple_zh: 糖有一種副產品叫糖蜜。
toeic: The factory sells its byproduct to a nearby fertilizer company.
toeic_zh: 工廠把副產品賣給附近的肥料公司。

en: gas or smoke sent into the air
simple: Car emission makes the air dirty.
toeic: New rules require the plant to cut carbon emission by thirty percent.
toeic_zh: 新規定要求工廠將碳排放減少百分之三十。

en: a harmful substance that makes air or water dirty
toeic: The filter removes every pollutant before the water leaves the factory.
toeic_zh: 過濾器在水離開工廠前去除所有污染物。

en: tight glasses that protect your eyes at work
simple: He wears goggles in the lab.
toeic: All visitors must wear goggles when entering the machine area.
toeic_zh: 所有訪客進入機器區域時都必須戴護目鏡。

en: a worker who leads a group of other workers
simple: The foreman gave us the plan.
simple_zh: 領班把計畫交給了我們。
toeic: The foreman reported that the night crew had finished all the orders.
toeic_zh: 領班回報夜班人員已完成所有訂單。

en: a person learning a skill by working with an expert
simple: He is an apprentice at a bakery.
toeic: Each apprentice spends two years training with an experienced machinist.
toeic_zh: 每位學徒花兩年時間跟著資深機械工訓練。

en: to hire another firm to do part of a job
simple_zh: 我們把油漆工作轉包出去。
toeic: The builder will subcontract the wiring to a licensed electrical company.
toeic_zh: 營造商會把配線工程轉包給有執照的電力公司。

en: a legal right to be the only maker of an invention
simple: She has a patent for her toy.
toeic: The company filed a patent for its new cooling system last month.
toeic_zh: 該公司上個月為其新冷卻系統申請了專利。

en: made by hand, not by a machine
toeic: Our handmade furniture is more expensive than factory-made products.
toeic_zh: 我們的手工家具比工廠製品更貴。

en: a group of items made or sold together
simple: I bought a lot of apples.
toeic: Every lot is checked before it leaves the warehouse.
toeic_zh: 每一批貨在離開倉庫前都會受檢。

en: not working or not being used
toeic: Half of the equipment sat idle during the strike.
toeic_zh: 罷工期間有一半設備閒置。

en: a machine that can do tasks automatically
simple_zh: 一個機器人打掃我們的地板。
toeic: A welding robot now does the work that three people used to do.
toeic_zh: 現在一台焊接機器人做原本三個人做的工作。

en: a closed path that electricity flows through
toeic: Each printed circuit is tested twice before it is installed.
toeic_zh: 每片印刷電路在安裝前都會測試兩次。

en: a material used to make computer chips
toeic: The semiconductor shortage slowed the production of new cars worldwide.
toeic_zh: 半導體短缺拖慢了全球新車的生產。

en: a first test of a machine or system
simple: We did a trial run today.
toeic: The engineers will complete a trial run of the new line on Thursday.
toeic_zh: 工程師將在週四完成新生產線的試運轉。

en: a thin layer of paint or other material on a surface
simple: The pan has a special coating.
simple_zh: 這個平底鍋有特殊的塗層。
toeic: A protective coating prevents the metal parts from rusting.
toeic_zh: 保護塗層可防止金屬零件生鏽。

en: a wheel with teeth that moves parts in a machine
toeic: A worn gear caused the conveyor to stop at noon.
toeic_zh: 一個磨損的齒輪使輸送帶在中午停了下來。

en: the flat sharp part of a cutting tool
toeic: The cutting blade must be replaced after every ten thousand uses.
toeic_zh: 切割刀片每使用一萬次後必須更換。

en: a small tube at the end of a pipe that controls flow
simple: Water comes out of the nozzle.
toeic: A blocked nozzle left the paint uneven on the car doors.
toeic_zh: 噴嘴堵塞使車門上的油漆不均勻。

en: an object made by pouring melted metal into a mold
toeic: Each casting is X-rayed to find hidden cracks.
toeic_zh: 每件鑄件都會用X光檢查是否有隱藏裂縫。

en: using few resources and producing little waste
simple_zh: 他們經營一家精實的公司。
toeic: Our lean manufacturing approach helped the firm cut waste and speed up delivery.
toeic_zh: 精實製造幫助該公司減少浪費並加快交貨。

en: a strong hat that protects the head at work
simple: He put on a hard hat.
toeic: A hard hat is required in all areas of the construction site.
toeic_zh: 建築工地所有區域都必須戴安全帽。

en: an extra part kept to replace a broken one
simple: We keep a spare part here.
simple_zh: 我們在這裡備有一個備用零件。
toeic: Please order every spare part before the stock runs out.
toeic_zh: 請在庫存用完前訂購每一種備用零件。

en: the amount made in one continuous period of production
simple: The production run starts at nine.
simple_zh: 這一批生產在九點開始。
toeic: The first production run of the new model sold out within a week.
toeic_zh: 新款的第一批量產在一週內就銷售一空。

en: a strong table used for making or fixing things
simple: The tools are on the workbench.
toeic: Each workbench is equipped with a lamp and a small vise.
toeic_zh: 每張工作檯都配有一盞燈和一個小虎鉗。

en: a factory that cleans raw oil or sugar
simple: The refinery is by the sea.
toeic: The oil refinery was closed for two weeks for safety checks.
toeic_zh: 這座煉油廠因安全檢查停工兩週。

en: a hard material made by baking clay
simple: This cup is made of ceramic.
toeic: The ceramic tiles are baked at very high temperatures.
toeic_zh: 這些陶瓷磚是在極高溫下燒製的。

en: a hard clear material used for windows and bottles
simple: The glass is on the table.
toeic: Our factory recycles old glass into new bottles every day.
toeic_zh: 我們工廠每天把舊玻璃回收製成新瓶子。

en: a gray powder that becomes hard when mixed with water
simple_zh: 他們把水泥和水混在一起。
toeic: Demand for cement rose as new roads were built across the region.
toeic_zh: 隨著區域內興建新道路，水泥需求上升。

en: a light silver-colored metal
simple: The can is made of aluminum.
toeic: The company switched to aluminum to make its products lighter.
toeic_zh: 該公司改用鋁材以讓產品更輕。

en: a reddish metal that carries electricity well
simple: The pipe is made of copper.
toeic: The price of copper wire is a major cost in cable manufacturing.
toeic_zh: 銅線是電纜製造業的一大成本。

en: something burned to make heat or power
simple_zh: 這輛卡車需要更多燃料。
toeic: Higher fuel costs reduced the plant's profit this quarter.
toeic_zh: 較高的燃料成本減少了工廠本季的利潤。

en: a very hot closed space used to heat or melt materials
toeic: The steel furnace runs day and night to meet the order.
toeic_zh: 鋼鐵熔爐日夜運轉以趕上訂單。

en: a machine that heats water to make steam
simple_zh: 鍋爐為我們的房子供暖。
toeic: The old boiler was replaced with a more efficient model.
toeic_zh: 舊鍋爐被更有效率的機型取代了。

en: a machine with blades that turn to make power
toeic: The company manufactures turbine parts for power stations in Asia.
toeic_zh: 該公司為亞洲的發電廠製造渦輪機零件。

en: a small device that stores and gives electric power
simple_zh: 我的手機電池快沒電了。
toeic: The factory produces a battery for electric vehicles every ninety seconds.
toeic_zh: 這座工廠每九十秒生產一顆電動車電池。

en: a device that removes unwanted things from liquid or air
toeic: Please replace the air filter every three months to keep machines clean.
toeic_zh: 請每三個月更換一次空氣濾網，以保持機器乾淨。

en: a machine that turns wood or metal to cut it
simple: He uses a lathe at work.
toeic: The new lathe can shape a metal part in under one minute.
toeic_zh: 這台新車床能在一分鐘內加工出一個金屬零件。

en: done inside a company, not by outside firms
simple_zh: 我們有一位公司內部的廚師。
toeic: The in-house design team developed the prototype within three weeks.
toeic_zh: 內部設計團隊在三週內開發出原型。

en: a change from making one product to another
toeic: A faster changeover between products reduced idle time on the line.
toeic_zh: 產品之間更快的換線縮短了生產線的閒置時間。

en: the tools and machines needed to make a product
simple_zh: 這些工具設備非常昂貴。
toeic: New tooling must be ready before the launch of the next model.
toeic_zh: 新模具必須在下一款上市前準備好。

en: the distance between two opposite sides of something
simple: Check the thickness of the board.
toeic: The thickness of each steel sheet is measured at three points.
toeic_zh: 每片鋼板的厚度會在三個點測量。

en: an exact copy of something
simple: This is a replica of the statue.
simple_zh: 這是那座雕像的複製品。
toeic: The firm was sued for selling a replica of a famous brand.
toeic_zh: 這家公司因販售知名品牌的仿製品而被控告。

en: the area of a factory where goods are made
simple: He works on the shop floor.
toeic: The manager walks through the shop floor to talk with workers each morning.
toeic_zh: 經理每天早上走過生產現場和工人交談。

en: skill in making things well by hand
simple: I love the craftsmanship of this chair.
simple_zh: 我喜歡這張椅子的手藝。
toeic: The brand is famous for its fine craftsmanship and attention to detail.
toeic_zh: 這個品牌以精湛工藝與注重細節而聞名。

en: making large numbers of the same product in a factory
simple: Cars are cheaper with mass production.
simple_zh: 有了大量生產，汽車更便宜。
toeic: The new model will go into mass production next spring.
toeic_zh: 新款機型將於明年春天進入大量生產。

en: machines and workers that make a product step by step
simple: He works on the production line.
toeic: A sensor stopped the production line when it detected a faulty part.
toeic_zh: 感測器偵測到有問題的零件時，便讓生產線停止運作。

en: to put oil on machine parts so they move smoothly
toeic: Technicians must lubricate the machines every week to prevent wear.
toeic_zh: 技術人員必須每週為機器上潤滑油以防磨損。

en: the process of building something
simple: Construction of the new office started last month.
simple_zh: 新辦公室的建造上個月開始了。
toeic: The construction project is scheduled to be completed by next quarter.
toeic_zh: 建造項目計劃在下一季度完成。

en: the process of restoring something to good condition
toeic: The office underwent a complete renovation to improve employee comfort.
toeic_zh: 辦公室進行了全面翻新以改善員工舒適度。

en: a detailed plan or design
simple: The architect showed us the blueprint of the building.
simple_zh: 建築師向我們展示了建築物的藍圖。
toeic: The blueprint outlined all structural specifications and safety requirements.
toeic_zh: 藍圖列出了所有結構規格和安全要求。

en: a person or company hired to do specific work
simple: The contractor finished the job on time.
simple_zh: 承包商按時完成了工作。
toeic: We selected an experienced contractor with excellent project management skills.
toeic_zh: 我們選擇了一位具有優秀項目管理技能的經驗豐富的承包商。

en: to make or become larger
simple: The company plans to expand the warehouse.
toeic: The facility will expand its operational capacity to accommodate increased demand.
toeic_zh: 設施將擴大其運營能力以滿足增加的需求。

en: the base on which a building rests
simple: A strong foundation is essential for any building.
simple_zh: 強有力的基礎對任何建築物都至關重要。
toeic: The foundation of the building must be reinforced to support the additional weight.
toeic_zh: 建築物的基礎必須加固以支撐額外的重量。

en: a temporary structure used during building work
simple: Workers used scaffolds to reach the roof.
toeic: Temporary scaffolding was erected to support workers during the renovation.
toeic_zh: 在翻新期間豎起臨時鷹架以支撐工人。

en: to destroy or tear down a building
simple: They will demolish the old building next month.
simple_zh: 他們下個月將拆除舊建築。
toeic: The company plans to demolish the obsolete warehouse and build a modern facility.
toeic_zh: 公司計劃拆除過時的倉庫並建造現代設施。

en: to dig or unearth material from the ground
simple: Workers excavated the site for the new foundation.
simple_zh: 工人為新地基挖掘了該場地。
toeic: The team will excavate the area to a depth of 15 meters for the basement.
toeic_zh: 團隊將將該區域挖掘到15米深度以用作地下室。

en: a hard building material made from cement and aggregate
simple: The building uses reinforced concrete for structural support.
simple_zh: 建築物使用鋼筋混凝土作為結構支撐。
toeic: Concrete foundations must cure for at least 28 days before construction proceeds.
toeic_zh: 混凝土地基在施工繼續之前必須固化至少28天。

en: a strong metal alloy made from iron and carbon
simple: The roof is supported by steel beams.
toeic: High-grade steel was selected for the structural framework to ensure durability.
toeic_zh: 選擇了高品質的鋼材用於結構框架以確保耐用性。

en: a small rectangular block used in building
simple: The wall is made of red brick.
toeic: Premium bricks were imported from Europe to match the architectural design.
toeic_zh: 高級磚從歐洲進口以匹配建築設計。

en: a thin rectangular piece used to cover floors or walls
toeic: Marble tiles were selected for the lobby to create an elegant appearance.
toeic_zh: 為大廳選擇了大理石瓷磚以創造優雅的外觀。

en: the system of pipes and fixtures for water and drainage
simple: The plumbing in the old building needs repair.
simple_zh: 舊建築物中的水管需要修理。
toeic: Modern plumbing systems reduce water consumption and improve efficiency.
toeic_zh: 現代管道系統減少了水消耗並提高了效率。

en: relating to electricity or electric systems
simple: The electrical system needs to be updated.
toeic: Electrical wiring throughout the facility must comply with safety standards.
toeic_zh: 整個設施的電氣佈線必須符合安全標準。

en: heating, ventilation, and air conditioning system
simple: The HVAC system keeps the office at a comfortable temperature.
simple_zh: 暖通空調系統使辦公室保持舒適的溫度。
toeic: The facility upgraded its HVAC system to improve energy efficiency and indoor air quality.
toeic_zh: 設施升級了暖通空調系統以改善能源效率和室內空氣質量。

en: an official document granting permission to do something
simple: You need a permit to start construction.
simple_zh: 你需要許可證才能開始建造。
toeic: Building permits must be obtained from the municipal authority before construction begins.
toeic_zh: 在施工開始之前必須從市政當局獲得建築許可證。

en: a system of rules or standards that must be followed
simple: The building must meet the fire code requirements.
simple_zh: 建築物必須符合消防法規要求。
toeic: Compliance with local building codes is mandatory for all construction projects.
toeic_zh: 遵守當地建築法規對於所有建築項目都是強制性的。

en: the division of an area into zones for specific uses
simple: The property is in a commercial zoning district.
toeic: The city's zoning regulations restrict industrial facilities in residential areas.
toeic_zh: 該市的分區法規限制了住宅區的工業設施。

en: designed to carry or support weight
simple: The load-bearing wall cannot be removed.
toeic: Load-bearing walls must be reinforced to support the additional floors.
toeic_zh: 承重牆必須加固以支撐額外的樓層。

en: relating to the framework or overall form of something
simple: The building has some structural damage.
simple_zh: 建築物有一些結構損傷。
toeic: A structural engineer assessed the damage and recommended immediate repairs.
toeic_zh: 結構工程師評估了損傷並建議立即進行維修。

en: the supply of fresh air to a space
simple: The ventilation system improves air quality.
simple_zh: 通風系統改善了空氣質量。
toeic: Proper ventilation is essential to maintain healthy indoor air quality.
toeic_zh: 適當的通風對於保持健康的室內空氣質量至關重要。

en: material used to prevent heat or cold from passing through
toeic: High-quality insulation reduces heating and cooling costs significantly.
toeic_zh: 高質量的隔熱顯著降低了供暖和冷卻成本。

en: a panel of plaster or gypsum between sheets of paper
simple: The walls are covered with drywall.
toeic: Drywall installation must be completed before painting can begin.
toeic_zh: 必須在開始繪畫之前完成石膏板安裝。

en: a liquid applied to surfaces for color or protection
simple: We chose a light blue paint for the bedroom.
simple_zh: 我們為臥室選擇了淺藍色油漆。
toeic: Premium paint products provide better durability and coverage than standard options.
toeic_zh: 高級油漆產品比標準選項提供更好的耐用性和覆蓋範圍。

en: the surface or material of a floor
simple: The flooring in the kitchen is made of tile.
simple_zh: 廚房的地板由瓷磚製成。
toeic: Durable flooring materials were selected to withstand heavy foot traffic.
toeic_zh: 選擇了耐用的地板材料以承受大量人流。

en: the materials and structure that form a roof
simple: The roofing needs to be replaced soon.
toeic: Weather-resistant roofing materials were installed to prevent water damage.
toeic_zh: 安裝了防水屋頂材料以防止水損傷。

en: a vertical structure that encloses or divides a space
simple: There is a crack in the wall.
toeic: The structural walls support the weight of all upper floors.
toeic_zh: 結構牆支撐所有上層樓的重量。

en: the upper inner surface of a room
simple: The ceiling is ten feet high.
toeic: Dropped ceiling panels provide easy access to utilities and improve acoustics.
toeic_zh: 下垂的天花板面板提供了對公用設施的便捷訪問並改善了音效。

en: a movable barrier that opens and closes an entrance
toeic: Fire-rated doors must be installed in the emergency exits.
toeic_zh: 必須在緊急出口處安裝防火門。

en: an opening in a wall that allows light and air in
toeic: Energy-efficient windows significantly reduce heating and cooling expenses.
toeic_zh: 節能窗戶顯著降低供暖和冷卻費用。

en: a series of steps for going up or down between floors
simple: The staircase is in the corner of the building.
simple_zh: 樓梯位於建築物的角落。
toeic: The main staircase must meet safety requirements including handrails and proper dimensions.
toeic_zh: 主樓梯必須符合安全要求，包括扶手和適當的尺寸。

en: a platform or compartment that moves vertically between floors
simple: The elevator is out of order today.
toeic: The building is equipped with high-speed elevators for efficient vertical transportation.
toeic_zh: 建築物配備了高速電梯以實現高效的垂直運輸。

en: a sloping surface connecting two different levels
simple: The wheelchair ramp makes the entrance accessible.
simple_zh: 輪椅坡道使入口可以訪問。
toeic: Accessible ramps with proper grades ensure compliance with disability accommodation standards.
toeic_zh: 具有適當坡度的無障礙坡道確保符合殘疾人住宿標準。

en: a rail held by hand for support on stairs or slopes
simple: Hold onto the handrail when climbing the stairs.
toeic: Sturdy handrails must be installed on all staircases for safety.
toeic_zh: 必須在所有樓梯上安裝牢固的扶手以確保安全。

en: the arrangement or effect of artificial or natural light
simple: The office lighting is too bright.
toeic: LED lighting systems provide energy-efficient illumination throughout the facility.
toeic_zh: LED照明系統在整個設施中提供節能照明。

en: the system of electric wires in a building
simple: The wiring in the old house is outdated.
toeic: Updated electrical wiring ensures safety and supports modern power requirements.
toeic_zh: 更新的電氣布線確保安全並支持現代電源要求。

en: a socket for inserting an electrical plug
simple: I need an outlet to charge my phone.
simple_zh: 我需要一個插座來給手機充電。
toeic: Multiple outlets are conveniently located throughout the office for employee use.
toeic_zh: 整個辦公室中都方便地放置了多個插座供員工使用。

en: a device that stops electrical current in an emergency
simple: The circuit breaker tripped during the storm.
simple_zh: 暴風雨期間斷路器跳閘了。
toeic: Circuit breakers protect electrical systems from overload and fire hazards.
toeic_zh: 斷路器保護電氣系統免受過載和火災危害。

en: a machine that produces electricity
simple: The generator provides backup power during outages.
simple_zh: 發電機在停電期間提供備用電源。
toeic: Backup generators ensure continuous operations during power interruptions.
toeic_zh: 備用發電機確保電源中斷期間的持續運營。

en: a tube used for conveying water, gas, or other material
simple: The pipe carries water from the main source.
toeic: Copper piping provides superior durability and corrosion resistance.
toeic_zh: 銅管提供了卓越的耐用性和耐腐蝕性。

en: a tube or channel for conveying air or other fluids
simple: The air duct is clogged with dust.
toeic: Air ducts should be cleaned annually to maintain system efficiency.
toeic_zh: 應每年清潔風道以保持系統效率。

en: an opening that allows air or gas to escape
simple_zh: 烘乾機通風口需要清潔。
toeic: Proper venting ensures adequate air circulation and prevents moisture buildup.
toeic_zh: 適當的通風確保充分的空氣循環並防止濕氣積累。

en: impervious to water or not allowing water to pass through
toeic: High-quality waterproof membranes protect foundations from groundwater damage.
toeic_zh: 高質量的防水膜保護地基免受地下水損傷。

en: the process of wearing away by exposure to weather
simple: The weathering of the stone is visible on the facade.
simple_zh: 石頭的風化在立面上是可見的。
toeic: Weathering damage requires protective coatings and regular maintenance.
toeic_zh: 風化損傷需要保護塗層和定期維護。

en: the gradual wearing away of rock or soil
simple: Soil erosion threatens the building's foundation.
simple_zh: 土壤侵蝕威脅建築物的基礎。
toeic: Erosion control measures protect the construction site from water damage.
toeic_zh: 侵蝕控制措施保護施工現場免受水損傷。

en: the process of rotting or gradual deterioration
simple: Wood decay affects the structural integrity.
simple_zh: 木材腐爛影響結構完整性。
toeic: Advanced decay in wooden beams requires immediate replacement.
toeic_zh: 木樑的高度腐爛需要立即更換。

en: a small insect that eats wood and damages buildings
toeic: Regular pest inspections detect termite damage before it becomes severe.
toeic_zh: 定期害蟲檢查在白蟻損傷變得嚴重之前檢測到它。

en: an insect or other animal that harms crops or property
simple: The facility has a pest control problem.
toeic: Integrated pest management prevents infestations and protects the facility.
toeic_zh: 綜合害蟲管理防止害蟲入侵並保護設施。

en: a fungus that grows on damp or decaying matter
simple_zh: 黴菌出現在潮濕的牆上。
toeic: Regular ventilation prevents mildew growth and maintains indoor air quality.
toeic_zh: 定期通風防止黴菌生長並保持室內空氣質量。

en: a break or crack in something hard
simple: A concrete fracture appeared after the earthquake.
simple_zh: 地震後出現了混凝土斷裂。
toeic: Critical fractures in structural elements require immediate engineering assessment.
toeic_zh: 結構元素中的關鍵斷裂需要立即進行工程評估。

en: the gradual sinking of a structure or ground
toeic: Building settlement monitoring prevents structural failure and safety risks.
toeic_zh: 建築物沉降監測防止結構故障和安全風險。

en: the sudden sinking or gradual settling of the ground
simple: Subsidence affected the stability of the structure.
simple_zh: 下沉影響了結構的穩定性。
toeic: Geological subsidence can be monitored through advanced surveying technology.
toeic_zh: 地質下沉可以通過先進的測量技術進行監測。

en: a sudden failure or breakdown of a structure
simple: The bridge collapse shocked the city.
toeic: Structural collapse prevention requires rigorous design and engineering standards.
toeic_zh: 結構塌陷預防需要嚴格的設計和工程標準。

en: weakness or failure of a material under repeated stress
simple_zh: 材料疲勞影響橋樑安全。
toeic: Metal fatigue in structural supports requires preventive maintenance.
toeic_zh: 結構支撐中的金屬疲勞需要預防性維護。

en: the action of pressing or squeezing something
simple_zh: 壓縮測試測量材料強度。
toeic: Compression forces in columns must be calculated for structural stability.
toeic_zh: 必須計算柱中的壓縮力以確保結構穩定性。

en: the action of twisting or the state of being twisted
simple_zh: 扭轉力影響結構穩定性。
toeic: Torsional analysis ensures buildings can withstand wind and seismic forces.
toeic_zh: 扭轉分析確保建築物能夠抵禦風和地震力。

en: a force that causes two parts to slide past each other
toeic: Shear walls provide lateral support and prevent structural failure.
toeic_zh: 剪力牆提供側向支持並防止結構故障。

en: the state of being steady and not likely to change
simple: The bridge stability is constantly monitored.
simple_zh: 橋樑穩定性得到持續監測。
toeic: Long-term structural stability requires proper maintenance and inspection.
toeic_zh: 長期結構穩定性需要適當的維護和檢查。

en: a state of balance between opposing forces
toeic: Force equilibrium analysis determines structural safety factors.
toeic_zh: 力平衡分析確定結構安全因子。

en: exactly vertical or in a perfectly straight line
simple: The wall must be plumb before installation.
toeic: Plumb measurements ensure structural elements are properly aligned.
toeic_zh: 垂直測量確保結構元素正確對齐。

en: having a flat, even surface without bumps or slopes
simple: The floor must be perfectly level.
toeic: Level surfaces ensure safe equipment placement and worker safety.
toeic_zh: 水平表面確保設備安全放置和工人安全。

en: having four equal sides and four right angles
simple: The corner must be perfectly square.
toeic: Square measurements verify structural perpendicularity and alignment.
toeic_zh: 方形測量驗證結構垂直度和對齐度。

en: the arrangement of items in a line or correct position
simple: Door alignment is important for proper function.
simple_zh: 門對齐對正確功能很重要。
toeic: Structural alignment verification prevents equipment malfunctions and safety issues.
toeic_zh: 結構對齐驗證防止設備故障和安全問題。

en: the arrangement of ground levels or the rating process
simple_zh: 場地分級影響排水模式。
toeic: Proper grading ensures adequate surface drainage and structural stability.
toeic_zh: 適當的分級確保充分的地表排水和結構穩定性。

en: a surface or line that is not vertical or horizontal
simple: The roof slope prevents water pooling.
toeic: Adequate slope measurement ensures proper drainage on flat surfaces.
toeic_zh: 充分的坡度測量確保平坦表面的適當排水。

en: the final layer or coating applied to a surface
simple: The floor finish is durable and attractive.
simple_zh: 地板飾面耐用且有吸引力。
toeic: High-quality finishes enhance durability and aesthetic appeal.
toeic_zh: 高質量的飾面增強了耐用性和美學吸引力。

en: having an uneven or irregular surface
simple: The concrete surface is still rough.
toeic: Rough surfaces provide better traction and safety for pedestrians.
toeic_zh: 粗糙的表面為行人提供了更好的牽引力和安全性。

en: having an even surface without roughness or bumps
simple: The polished floor is smooth and shiny.
simple_zh: 拋光的地板光滑而有光澤。
toeic: Smooth surfaces reduce friction and facilitate equipment movement.
toeic_zh: 光滑表面降低摩擦力並促進設備移動。

en: concerned with beauty or the appearance of something
simple_zh: 美學設計給訪客留下深刻印象。
toeic: Aesthetic considerations influence material selection and architectural design.
toeic_zh: 美學考慮影響材料選擇和建築設計。

en: designed to be practical and useful
simple_zh: 功能設計優先考慮易用性。
toeic: Functional requirements drive architectural and structural decisions.
toeic_zh: 功能要求推動建築和結構決策。

en: designed for practical use rather than attractiveness
simple: The building has a utilitarian design.
toeic: Utilitarian approaches maximize cost-effectiveness in facility design.
toeic_zh: 功利方法最大化了設施設計的成本效益。

en: relating to business, trade, or commerce
toeic: Commercial facility requirements differ significantly from residential standards.
toeic_zh: 商業設施要求與住宅標準明顯不同。

en: designed for living in or relating to where people live
toeic: Residential facilities must meet specific safety and comfort standards.
toeic_zh: 住宅設施必須符合特定的安全和舒適標準。

en: relating to factories, mills, or manufacturing
simple_zh: 工業設施需要專業設計。
toeic: Industrial buildings must accommodate heavy machinery and materials handling.
toeic_zh: 工業建築必須容納重型機械和物料搬運。

en: relating to an institution such as a school, hospital, or government
simple_zh: 機構建築物服務於公共目的。
toeic: Institutional facilities must meet stringent accessibility and code requirements.
toeic_zh: 機構設施必須符合嚴格的可訪問性和代碼要求。

en: relating to a city or town government
toeic: Municipal building codes establish minimum construction and safety standards.
toeic_zh: 市政建築法規制定了最低建築和安全標準。

en: belonging to or for use by all people
toeic: Public facility maintenance is a municipal responsibility.
toeic_zh: 公共設施維護是市政責任。

en: owned or controlled by a person rather than by the public
simple: Private facilities are owned by individuals.
toeic: Private property maintenance is the owner's responsibility.
toeic_zh: 私人財產維護是業主的責任。

en: rented under a lease agreement for a fixed period
simple: The leased office space is in the downtown area.
simple_zh: 租賃的辦公空間在市中心。
toeic: Leased facility maintenance responsibilities must be clearly defined in contracts.
toeic_zh: 租賃設施維護責任必須在合同中明確定義。

en: hired or used by paying a regular fee
simple: The rented warehouse serves our storage needs.
simple_zh: 租賃的倉庫滿足我們的存儲需求。
toeic: Rented facilities require clear maintenance and responsibility agreements.
toeic_zh: 租賃設施需要明確的維護和責任協議。

en: possessed or held as one's own property
simple_zh: 擁有的建築物很有價值。
toeic: Owned facilities provide long-term control and value appreciation.
toeic_zh: 自有設施提供長期控制和價值增值。

en: a detailed investigation into a particular subject
simple: The feasibility study analyzed project viability.
simple_zh: 可行性研究分析了項目可行性。
toeic: Comprehensive studies precede major capital investments.
toeic_zh: 全面研究先於重大資本投資。

en: designed to stop something bad from happening
toeic: Preventive maintenance programs extend facility lifespan significantly.
toeic_zh: 預防性維護計劃大大延長了設施的使用壽命。

en: intended to fix or remedy a problem
toeic: Corrective maintenance addresses identified problems and failures.
toeic_zh: 糾正性維護解決已識別的問題和故障。

en: occurring or recurring at intervals
simple_zh: 定期測試確保系統可靠性。
toeic: Periodic maintenance programs optimize long-term facility performance.
toeic_zh: 定期維護計劃優化長期設施性能。

en: relating to sight or things that can be seen
simple: Visual inspection is the first step.
toeic: Visual inspections identify obvious defects and potential hazards.
toeic_zh: 目視檢查識別明顯的缺陷和潛在危害。

en: Americans with Disabilities Act - legislation ensuring accessibility
simple: ADA compliance is required in public buildings.
toeic: ADA accessibility standards ensure facilities serve all visitors.
toeic_zh: ADA可訪問性標準確保設施為所有訪客服務。

en: the quality of being easy to reach or use
simple_zh: 可訪問性對每個人都很重要。
toeic: Universal accessibility design includes ramps, elevators, and accessible restrooms.
toeic_zh: 通用可訪問性設計包括坡道、電梯和無障礙衛生間。

en: relating to, done by, or involving all people, things, or places
simple_zh: 通用設計對每個人都有益。
toeic: Universal design principles create inclusive facilities accessible to all.
toeic_zh: 通用設計原則創造了對所有人都可訪問的包容性設施。

zh: 人體工程學的；符合人體工程的
en: designed to provide comfort and prevent injury or strain
simple_zh: 人體工程學工作空間設計提高了生產力。
toeic: Ergonomic workplace design reduces injury and improves employee satisfaction.
toeic_zh: 人體工程學工作場所設計減少了傷害並提高了員工滿意度。

en: the way something is arranged or organized
toeic: Strategic layout design optimizes workflow and operational efficiency.
toeic_zh: 戰略佈局設計優化了工作流程和運營效率。

en: a diagram showing the layout of a floor in a building
simple: The floor plan shows all rooms.
simple_zh: 平面圖顯示了所有房間。
toeic: Detailed floor plans guide construction and facility planning.
toeic_zh: 詳細的平面圖指導施工和設施規劃。

en: a front or side view of a building
simple: The elevation shows the building's appearance.
simple_zh: 立面顯示了建築物的外觀。
toeic: Architectural elevations illustrate building design and structural features.
toeic_zh: 建築立面說明了建築設計和結構特徵。

en: a rough calculation or judgment of something
toeic: Accurate estimates ensure budget accuracy and project planning.
toeic_zh: 準確的估計確保預算準確和項目規劃。

en: an official permission or permit to do something
simple: A license is required to operate the facility.
toeic: Professional licenses verify contractor qualifications and competence.
toeic_zh: 專業執照驗證承包商的資格和能力。

en: official authorization or approval of something
toeic: Industry accreditation demonstrates commitment to quality and standards.
toeic_zh: 行業認可證明了對質量和標準的承諾。

en: the action of watching and directing someone or something
toeic: Professional supervision ensures construction quality and safety compliance.
toeic_zh: 專業監督確保施工質量和安全合規。

en: responsible management or an unintentional mistake
simple: Oversight is critical for project success.
simple_zh: 監督對項目成功至關重要。
toeic: Project oversight ensures adherence to timelines and budgets.
toeic_zh: 項目監督確保遵守時間表和預算。

en: the organization and coordination of activities or operations
simple_zh: 團隊之間的協調至關重要。
toeic: Effective coordination ensures smooth project implementation.
toeic_zh: 有效的協調確保順利的項目實施。

en: the arrangement of work or events for specific times
simple_zh: 項目日程安排確定完成日期。
toeic: Strategic scheduling optimizes resource allocation and project efficiency.
toeic_zh: 戰略日程安排優化了資源分配和項目效率。

en: the process of planning how to spend money
toeic: Careful budgeting ensures projects stay within financial limits.
toeic_zh: 謹慎的預算編制確保項目在財務限制內。

en: the management of project expenses to prevent overspending
simple_zh: 成本控制使項目保持盈利。
toeic: Effective cost control is essential for project profitability.
toeic_zh: 有效的成本控制對項目盈利至關重要。

en: the process of ensuring that products or work meet required standards
simple_zh: 質量控制檢查每個組件。
toeic: Rigorous quality control ensures construction meets specifications.
toeic_zh: 嚴格的質量控制確保施工符合規格。

en: the evaluation of something to check its quality or performance
toeic: Comprehensive testing validates facility systems before occupancy.
toeic_zh: 全面測試在佔用前驗證設施系統。

en: the process of preparing a building or system for operation
toeic: Building commissioning verifies all systems operate correctly.
toeic_zh: 建築物調試驗證所有系統正常運作。

en: formal approval or acceptance of something
toeic: Project sign-off requires approval from all stakeholders.
toeic_zh: 項目簽收需要所有利益相關者的批准。

en: voluntary agreement or compliance with something
simple: Consent from both parties is required.
toeic: Informed consent ensures stakeholder agreement with project plans.
toeic_zh: 知情同意確保利益相關者同意項目計劃。

en: the voluntary relinquishment of a right or claim
simple: A waiver allowed construction to proceed.
toeic: Code waivers require justification and formal documentation.
toeic_zh: 代碼豁免需要正當理由和正式文件。

en: a person or thing that is not included in a general statement
simple: This case is an exception to the rule.
simple_zh: 這種情況是規則的例外。
toeic: Building code exceptions require approval from regulatory authorities.
toeic_zh: 建築法規例外需要監管當局的批准。

en: a request for a decision to be reconsidered
simple: An appeal was filed against the decision.
toeic: Appeals processes provide recourse for unfavorable decisions.
toeic_zh: 上訴程序為不利決定提供了救濟。

en: a long piece of steel or other material used as a main structural support
toeic: Load-bearing beams distribute weight throughout the structure.
toeic_zh: 承重梁在整個結構中分配重量。

en: a vertical structure used to support weight
simple: Concrete columns hold up the building.
simple_zh: 混凝土柱支撐著建築物。
toeic: Structural columns must be properly aligned and anchored.
toeic_zh: 結構柱必須正確對齐和固定。

en: a rigid framework used to support a roof or bridge
simple_zh: 屋頂桁架均勻分配重量。
toeic: Engineered trusses optimize strength while minimizing material costs.
toeic_zh: 工程桁架在最小化材料成本的同時優化了強度。

en: a story of a building that is largely or entirely below ground level
toeic: Basement waterproofing prevents moisture infiltration.
toeic_zh: 地下室防水防止了水分入侵。

en: the underlying material that supports the finished floor
toeic: Proper subflooring preparation ensures level and stable finished floors.
toeic_zh: 適當的基層地板準備確保了水平和穩定的完成面。

en: boards or planks forming the floor of a platform or structure
simple_zh: 木製甲板提供了室外空間。
toeic: Weather-resistant decking materials ensure durability and safety.
toeic_zh: 防風雨甲板材料確保了耐用性和安全性。

en: a level, rank, or degree of quality
toeic: Grade specifications ensure consistent material quality standards.
toeic_zh: 級別規格確保了一致的材料質量標準。

en: thin material used to prevent water leaks at joints or edges
simple_zh: 屋頂防水層防止水滲入。
toeic: Properly installed flashing prevents water infiltration at vulnerable points.
toeic_zh: 正確安裝的防水層防止了脆弱點的水滲入。

en: the action of making something secure or watertight
simple_zh: 密封裂隙防止空氣泄漏。
toeic: Proper sealing reduces energy costs and improves comfort.
toeic_zh: 適當的密封降低了能源成本並提高了舒適度。

en: the action of filling cracks or gaps with a sealant
simple: Caulking seals door and window edges.
toeic: Regular caulking maintenance prevents air infiltration and water leaks.
toeic_zh: 定期填縫維護防止空氣滲入和水泄漏。

en: a thin mortar or cement used to fill gaps or bind materials
simple_zh: 灌漿填充瓷磚之間的空間。
toeic: Quality grout installation prevents water seepage in tile work.
toeic_zh: 高質量的灌漿安裝防止了瓷磚工程中的水滲漏。

en: a mixture used to bind bricks or stones together
toeic: High-strength mortar ensures durable brick and stone masonry.
toeic_zh: 高強度灰漿確保了耐用的磚石砌體。

en: the building work done with brick, stone, or cement
simple_zh: 砌體形成了建築物的牆。
toeic: Quality masonry provides structural strength and durability.
toeic_zh: 高質量的砌體提供了結構強度和耐用性。

en: the lowest part of a foundation that spreads weight over a large area
toeic: Adequate footings distribute building loads onto stable soil.
toeic_zh: 充分的基礎將建築物負載分配到穩定的土壤上。

en: a long post driven into the ground for structural support
simple: Piles support the structure on soft soil.
toeic: Deep piles transfer building weight to stable soil layers.
toeic_zh: 深樁將建築物重量轉移到穩定的土壤層。

en: a structure built adjacent to something else for support
toeic: Abutment design must accommodate earth pressure and loads.
toeic_zh: 橋台設計必須承受土壓力和負載。

en: a structure extending into water or a support column
simple_zh: 海洋碼頭經歷波浪應力。
toeic: Pier foundations must resist scour and corrosion in marine environments.
toeic_zh: 橋墩基礎必須抵抗海洋環境中的沖刷和腐蝕。

en: a beam or structure supported at one end only
simple: Cantilever balconies extend from the building.
simple_zh: 懸臂陽台從建築物延伸。
toeic: Cantilever design maximizes usable space without additional supports.
toeic_zh: 懸臂設計最大化了可用空間，無需其他支撐。

en: a curved structure that spans an opening
toeic: Arch structures efficiently distribute weight and span large openings.
toeic_zh: 拱形結構有效地分配重量並跨越大開口。

en: a rounded roof or ceiling shaped like an upside-down bowl
toeic: Dome design provides large open interior spaces without columns.
toeic_zh: 穹頂設計提供了沒有柱子的大型開放式內部空間。

en: an arched or barrel-shaped roof or an underground storage
toeic: Barrel vaults span wide areas while reducing material requirements.
toeic_zh: 筒形拱跨越寬闊區域，同時減少材料需求。

en: a low protective wall at the edge of a roof or balcony
simple: Parapets prevent falls from the roof.
simple_zh: 女兒牆防止從屋頂跌落。
toeic: Safety parapets meet code requirements for fall protection.
toeic_zh: 安全女兒牆符合跌落保護的代碼要求。

en: a row of decorative posts supporting a rail
toeic: Ornamental balustrades combine aesthetics with safety compliance.
toeic_zh: 裝飾欄杆結合了美學和安全合規。

en: the underside of a part of a building such as a roof overhang
toeic: Properly ventilated soffits prevent moisture accumulation.
toeic_zh: 適當通風的短檐防止了水分積聚。

en: a board covering the ends of rafters or forming the edge of a roof
toeic: Quality fascia installation improves weatherproofing and appearance.
toeic_zh: 高質量的飾邊安裝改善了防水性和外觀。

en: decorative or protective strips along edges or joints
toeic: Finish trim selection significantly impacts architectural aesthetics.
toeic_zh: 飾邊選擇顯著影響建築美學。

en: a long narrow passage inside a building with rooms on each side
simple: The office is down this corridor.
simple_zh: 辦公室在這條走廊的盡頭。
toeic: Please keep the corridor clear of boxes and equipment.
toeic_zh: 請保持走廊暢通，不要堆放箱子和設備。
family: corridor (n) 走廊; main corridor 主走廊; hallway 走道

en: services such as water, gas and electricity
simple_zh: 租金包含所有水電瓦斯費。
toeic: The monthly rent covers utilities, but not Internet service.
toeic_zh: 每月租金包含水電瓦斯費，但不含網路服務。
family: utility (n) 公用事業; utility bill 水電帳單; utility company 公用事業公司

en: a person who pays rent to use a room or building
simple: The tenant pays rent every month.
toeic: Each tenant must report any damage to the building manager.
toeic_zh: 每位承租人都必須向大樓管理員通報任何損壞。
family: tenancy (n) 租期; commercial tenant 商業租戶; tenant and landlord 房客與房東

en: a person who owns a building and rents it to others
toeic: The landlord agreed to repaint the office before we moved in.
toeic_zh: 房東同意在我們搬進來之前重新粉刷辦公室。
family: landlady (n) 女房東; landlord and tenant 房東與房客

en: a legal agreement to rent a building or land for a period of time
toeic: The company signed a three-year lease for the new office space.
toeic_zh: 公司簽下了新辦公空間的三年租約。
family: lease (v) 租賃; lessee 承租人; lessor 出租人; renew a lease 續約

en: empty and not being used
toeic: There are two vacant offices on the fifth floor.
toeic_zh: 五樓有兩間空辦公室。
family: vacancy (n) 空缺；空房; vacate (v) 騰出; a vacant position 職缺

en: having a lot of room inside
simple: The kitchen is bright and spacious.
toeic: Our new meeting room is spacious enough for fifty people.
toeic_zh: 我們的新會議室寬敞得足以容納五十人。
family: space (n) 空間; spaciously (adv); spacious office 寬敞的辦公室

en: a large open area just inside the entrance of a building
toeic: Visitors must sign in at the front desk in the lobby.
toeic_zh: 訪客必須在大廳的櫃檯登記。
family: hotel lobby 飯店大廳; lobby (v) 遊說; lobbyist (n) 說客

en: to live or work in a room or building
simple: Our team will occupy this floor.
simple_zh: 我們的團隊將使用這一層樓。
toeic: The marketing department will occupy the third floor next month.
toeic_zh: 行銷部門下個月將進駐三樓。
family: occupation (n) 職業；佔用; occupant (n) 居住者; occupied (adj) 已被佔用的

en: the land and buildings a business uses
toeic: Visitors are not allowed to enter the premises without a badge.
toeic_zh: 訪客沒有識別證不得進入場所。
family: premises (恆為複數) 場所; on the premises 在場內; business premises 營業場所

en: the digging of a large hole in the ground
simple: The excavation is near the school.
toeic: The excavation for the new parking garage will begin next Monday.
toeic_zh: 新停車場的開挖工程將於下週一開始。

en: a black material used to cover roads
simple: The road is made of asphalt.
toeic: The city will lay new asphalt on Main Street this weekend.
toeic_zh: 市政府本週末將在主街鋪設新的柏油。

en: a hard surface for people to walk on beside a road
toeic: The contractor repaired the cracked pavement outside our main entrance.
toeic_zh: 承包商修補了我們主入口外破裂的人行道。

en: a system that carries away extra water
toeic: Poor drainage caused flooding in the basement of the office building.
toeic_zh: 排水不良導致辦公大樓地下室淹水。

en: waste water and waste carried away in pipes
simple: The sewage goes into a big pipe.
toeic: The new plant will treat sewage from the whole industrial district.
toeic_zh: 新廠將處理整個工業區的汙水。

en: made to stay safe in rain, wind, or snow
toeic: All outdoor signs must be weatherproof to meet the building standards.
toeic_zh: 所有戶外招牌都必須防風雨，才符合建築標準。

en: a person who makes and repairs things made of wood
toeic: We hired a carpenter to build shelves in the new storage room.
toeic_zh: 我們僱了一位木工在新儲藏室裡做架子。

en: a person who designs buildings
simple: The architect drew a new house.
simple_zh: 建築師畫了一棟新房子。
toeic: The architect presented three design options for the company headquarters.
toeic_zh: 建築師針對公司總部提出了三種設計方案。

en: a box for keeping and carrying tools
simple: He keeps a hammer in his toolbox.
simple_zh: 他把鐵鎚放在工具箱裡。
toeic: Every maintenance worker must carry a toolbox with basic safety gear.
toeic_zh: 每位維修人員都必須攜帶裝有基本安全裝備的工具箱。

en: a very tall building in a city
toeic: Our firm rents three floors in a skyscraper downtown.
toeic_zh: 我們公司在市中心的一棟摩天大樓租了三層樓。

en: a long passage built under the ground or a mountain
simple: The train goes through a tunnel.
toeic: The new tunnel will cut the commute between the two cities by half.
toeic_zh: 新隧道將使兩城之間的通勤時間減半。

en: to clean and improve a place so it looks new
toeic: The hotel will close in March to refurbish its lobby and rooms.
toeic_zh: 飯店將於三月休館，整修大廳與客房。

en: the front of a building
simple: The facade of the bank is old.
simple_zh: 這間銀行的正面很老舊。
toeic: The glass facade of the new tower reflects the afternoon sun.
toeic_zh: 新大樓的玻璃外牆反射著午後陽光。

en: a thin wall that divides a room into parts
toeic: We installed a glass partition to create a quiet meeting area.
toeic_zh: 我們裝設了玻璃隔間，打造出安靜的會議區。

en: a small work space inside a large office
simple: My cubicle is next to the window.
simple_zh: 我的小隔間在窗戶旁邊。
toeic: New employees will be assigned a cubicle on the third floor.
toeic_zh: 新進員工將被分配到三樓的辦公小隔間。

en: the outside top surface of a building
simple: We eat lunch on the rooftop.
toeic: Solar panels will be installed on the rooftop of the warehouse.
toeic_zh: 倉庫的屋頂將安裝太陽能板。

en: an open space surrounded by walls or buildings
toeic: The reception will be held in the courtyard of the conference center.
toeic_zh: 招待會將在會議中心的中庭舉行。

en: a small platform on the outside wall of a building
toeic: Each suite in the new hotel has a private balcony with a sea view.
toeic_zh: 新飯店的每間套房都有可看海景的私人陽台。

en: a public room with a toilet and sink
toeic: The restroom on the second floor is closed for cleaning.
toeic_zh: 二樓的洗手間因清潔而關閉。

en: a place in a workplace where people buy and eat meals
simple: We eat lunch in the cafeteria.
simple_zh: 我們在自助餐廳吃午餐。
toeic: The company will renovate the cafeteria to add more seating.
toeic_zh: 公司將翻修員工餐廳以增加座位。

en: a large hall where people watch talks or shows
simple: The show is in the auditorium.
toeic: The auditorium can seat up to five hundred guests for the product launch.
toeic_zh: 這座禮堂可容納多達五百位賓客參加產品發表會。

en: a platform where trucks load and unload goods
simple: The truck is at the loading dock.
toeic: Please keep the loading dock clear during the morning delivery period.
toeic_zh: 早上送貨時段請保持裝卸平台暢通。

en: a device that controls the temperature of a room
toeic: The new thermostat lets us set different temperatures for each floor.
toeic_zh: 新的恆溫器讓我們能為每一層樓設定不同溫度。

en: a device that sprays water to stop a fire
simple: The sprinkler started in the hall.
toeic: The fire code requires a sprinkler system on every floor of the building.
toeic_zh: 消防法規要求大樓每層樓都要有灑水系統。

en: a metal tool that sprays chemicals to put out fires
simple: The extinguisher is by the door.
toeic: Each extinguisher must be checked once a year by a licensed inspector.
toeic_zh: 每個滅火器都必須由合格檢查員每年檢查一次。

en: a large building where aircraft are kept
simple: The plane is in the hangar.
toeic: The airline is building a new hangar to repair its larger aircraft.
toeic_zh: 航空公司正在興建新機庫，以維修較大型的飛機。

en: the careful watching of a place for safety
simple: There is surveillance in the store.
toeic: The parking garage now has surveillance cameras for better security.
toeic_zh: 停車場現在裝有監視攝影機以加強保全。

en: a gate that turns to let one person pass at a time
simple: Please pass the turnstile one by one.
simple_zh: 請一個一個通過旋轉閘門。
toeic: Employees must scan their badges at the turnstile to enter the lobby.
toeic_zh: 員工必須在旋轉閘門刷識別證才能進入大廳。

en: giving bright light, often from a long tube
simple: The room has a fluorescent light.
simple_zh: 這個房間有一盞日光燈。
toeic: We are replacing every fluorescent light with an energy-saving LED.
toeic_zh: 我們正把所有日光燈換成節能的 LED 燈。

en: a small part that stops electricity when it is too strong
toeic: The electrician replaced the blown fuse and restored power to the office.
toeic_zh: 電工更換了燒斷的保險絲，辦公室恢復供電。

en: a channel along a roof that carries rain away
simple: The gutter is full of leaves.
toeic: Leaves blocked the gutter and caused water to leak into the storage room.
toeic_zh: 落葉堵住排水槽，導致水滲進儲藏室。

en: a strong metal bar that supports a building or bridge
simple: A girder holds up the roof.
toeic: A crane lifted the steel girder into place above the main hall.
toeic_zh: 起重機將鋼樑吊到主大廳上方就定位。

en: small stones used to make roads and paths
simple: The path is covered with gravel.
toeic: A truck delivered ten tons of gravel to the construction site.
toeic_zh: 一輛卡車把十噸碎石送到工地。

en: a soft mix that dries hard on walls and ceilings
simple: The wall is covered in plaster.
toeic: Workers will apply fresh plaster to the walls before painting begins.
toeic_zh: 工人將在開始粉刷前先在牆面抹上新灰泥。

en: a heavy machine that pushes earth and rocks
toeic: The crew used a bulldozer to level the ground for the new factory.
toeic_zh: 施工人員用推土機整平新工廠的地面。

en: a group of people who work together on a job
toeic: A repair crew arrived within an hour to fix the broken water pipe.
toeic_zh: 維修小組一小時內就趕到，修理破裂的水管。

en: the start of building, often marked by a ceremony
toeic: The mayor will attend the groundbreaking for the new medical center.
toeic_zh: 市長將出席新醫療中心的動土典禮。

en: a list of small jobs to finish before a project ends
simple: The punch list has ten items.
simple_zh: 收尾清單上有十個項目。
toeic: The builder must complete every item on the punch list before final payment.
toeic_zh: 建商必須完成收尾清單上的每一項，才能領取尾款。

en: the legal right to use another person's land
simple: The easement lets us use the road.
simple_zh: 通行權讓我們可以使用那條路。
toeic: The utility company has an easement to run cables across our property.
toeic_zh: 公用事業公司有權在我們的土地上架設電纜。

en: the required distance a building must keep from a boundary
simple: The house needs a ten-foot setback.
simple_zh: 這棟房子需要十英尺的退縮距離。
toeic: The city requires a twenty-foot setback from the street for new buildings.
toeic_zh: 市政府要求新建築與街道保持二十英尺的退縮距離。

en: made in a factory and put together later at a site
toeic: The builder used prefabricated walls to finish the clinic two months early.
toeic_zh: 建商使用預製牆板，提早兩個月完成診所。

en: made of separate parts that can be joined together
simple_zh: 這是一間模組化辦公室。
toeic: The firm chose modular furniture so it can change the layout easily.
toeic_zh: 公司選擇模組化家具，以便輕易改變配置。

en: a flat device that turns sunlight into electricity
simple: The roof has a solar panel.
simple_zh: 屋頂上有一片太陽能板。
toeic: Each solar panel on the roof produces power for the factory.
toeic_zh: 屋頂上的每片太陽能板都為工廠發電。

en: the space in a building that holds the stairs
toeic: Please do not store boxes in the stairwell because it is an emergency route.
toeic_zh: 請勿將箱子堆放在樓梯間，因為那是緊急逃生路線。

en: a safety bar along a road or high place
simple: A guardrail is beside the road.
toeic: Inspectors found that the guardrail on the bridge was loose.
toeic_zh: 檢查人員發現橋上的護欄鬆脫了。

en: a tall strong post that holds up a building
simple: A pillar stands by the door.
toeic: Engineers found a crack in the main pillar of the parking structure.
toeic_zh: 工程師在停車結構的主柱上發現一道裂縫。

en: a tall pipe that carries smoke out of a building
toeic: The factory must install filters on its chimney to reduce air pollution.
toeic_zh: 工廠必須在煙囪上安裝過濾器以減少空氣汙染。

en: official rules about how buildings must be designed and built
simple: The house follows the building code.
simple_zh: 這棟房子遵守建築法規。
toeic: The new office must meet the city's building code before it opens.
toeic_zh: 新辦公室在啟用前必須符合市府的建築法規。

en: the person in charge of a construction site
simple: The site manager wears a yellow hat.
simple_zh: 工地經理戴著黃色帽子。
toeic: Please report all safety problems to the site manager immediately.
toeic_zh: 請立即向工地經理回報所有安全問題。

en: a time when electricity stops working in a place
simple: A power outage hit our street.
simple_zh: 停電影響了我們那條街。
toeic: A power outage delayed work at the construction site for two hours.
toeic_zh: 停電使工地的工作延誤了兩小時。

en: a door used to leave a building quickly in danger
toeic: Boxes must never block an emergency exit in the warehouse.
toeic_zh: 倉庫裡的緊急出口絕不可被箱子擋住。

en: a device that makes a loud sound when it detects fire
toeic: Inspectors will test the fire alarm in every office on Tuesday.
toeic_zh: 檢查人員將於週二測試每間辦公室的火災警報器。

en: a temporary frame of poles and boards used while building
toeic: The scaffolding will be removed once the exterior painting is finished.
toeic_zh: 外牆油漆完成後，鷹架就會拆除。
